chapters.title: Chapter 3651 - Breaking through
paragraphs: Breaking through
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t know that every time he leaped over a Celestial Gate, heaven and earth would exert a power on him, causing his soul to become much stronger.
Leaping three times over a Celestial Gate, and his Spiritual Power had become at least a hundred times stronger.
The leaves of the trees in the entire forest fluttered. Sha, sha, sha! The leaves collided, creating a strange sound.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was completely confused. His soul was once again dragged up, soaring through the boundless galaxy

He couldn’t help but curse. First, it was a bronze Celestial Gate, then a silver Celestial Gate, and then it was a golden Celestial Gate. Next, would there be a purple Celestial Gate, crimson Celestial Gate, green Celestial Gate?
Just as his thoughts were running wild, his soul had already stopped.
Yi?

There was indeed another Celestial Gate ahead of him, but it was not tall or majestic at all. Instead, it was an incomplete door. That was a stone door, and the upper half had already been corroded and weathered. It could not be more than six meters tall, and looked like a damaged wall that was standing there. Ling Han thought that this was a stone door because that was his first impression, but the upper half was already gone.
Yi, why were the first three Celestial Gates completely unscathed, while this one was damaged?
After the Golden Celestial Gate, shouldn’t it be a Celestial Gate of Divine Metal, or a Celestial Gate of Origin Gold?
‘A stone door?’
Ling Han was filled with curiosity. He walked over, and initially thought that he would immediately be expelled, but when he got close enough, he still did not feel any power pushing him over.
Ah?
Since there was no obstruction, Ling Han naturally placed his hand on the stone door. Instantly, a primitive aura flooded over, letting him know that this stone door should be incredibly ancient.
Perhaps it was as ancient as this galaxy, or perhaps it had already existed before this galaxy had been created.
However, why was it damaged?
Being the fourth Celestial Gate, shouldn’t it be immortal and indestructible?
Lmg Han rubbed it for a while, but there were no veined patterns on the stone door. It was only ancient and aged, and nothing could be seen.
Forget it, he had best just directly leap over the Celestial Gate.
Ling Han leaped lightly over the stone door. There was no difficulty or pressure at all.
However, there was also no change.
There was no power to pull him away, nor did was he sent back. He was just standing here awkwardly like this.
F***, what was this?

Lmg Han frowned. This wasn’t right. Moreover, the fourth Celestial Gate was too easy to leap over, wasn’t it? Previously, when he had leaped over the Golden Celestial Gate, though he had also leaped over it, he had only barely managed to leap over it even if he had used all his power.
This stone door had already been destroyed, so its true height shouldn’t be just a few meters. Thus, his leap didn’t count?𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
But it had nothing to do with him. It was your business to destroy it, so why should I bear this responsibility?
Lmg Han grumbled in his mind. However, there was nowhere he could vent his grievances at this moment, so he could only come up with another plan.
He strode forwards. After taking a few steps, he walked towards the stone door, wanting to push it open and pass through.
This was an unconscious action, but when he pushed open the stone door, a force stopped him. He felt that the stone door was incredibly heavy, and he had only pushed it open a little.
Lmg Han, on the other hand, smiled. There was a chance.

He pushed with all his might, inch by inch, inch by inch, but before he had even reached half a foot, the power increased greatly. Peng, it forced his hands back, and the stone door closed tightly again.
‘Do you think I’m afraid of you?’
Ling Han came to his senses, and once again began to push open the doors.
It was still the same. After pushing Ling Han away for less than half a foot, that power suddenly soared, wanting to push Ling Han back.

Lmg Han channeled his full power and forcefully withstood the attack. However, this power was also endless, and did not dissipate. Instead, it was resisting him, and was slowly increasing. It still wanted to push him back.
Half an inch, half an inch, Ling Han slowly retreated.
He couldn’t help but frown. His Spiritual Power was only this powerful, so there was no way he could unleash it again.
It would be great if he could use mystical power.
Hold on, why couldn’t he?
Could it be that it was because he was a soul?
Let’s give it a try.
Ling Han made a comeback, and with a loud roar, channelled power madly. Boom, a miraculous scene appeared. He exploded with even stronger power. Mystical power… could be used!
He aggressively advanced, breaking through half a foot of distance, but the more he pushed open the door, the stronger the force of the counter rebuke would be, and very soon, he was pushed back.
Since that was the case.
Ling Han used the Demonic Monkey Fists, channeled Destructive Energy, and stacked 100 overlapping layers of power to form Frequency Attack.
-After advancing into Mystery Realm Tier, Ling Han’s mastery of the Demonic Monkey Fists had naturally improved further.
Boom, the stone door suddenly opened.

Ling Han smiled, and strode through. However, he immediately discovered that though the stone door had opened, there seemed to be an invisible barrier blocking him. It was not as sturdy as the stone door, but was incredibly elastic. Furthermore, it was pressing down on him from all directions, and he was still unable to pass through.
Boom!

However, though the power of his punch was domineering, his head, torso, and legs were all bearing the force, causing him to be extremely unbalanced in the force of the blow. He stumbled and landed solidly on the ground.
Even though he was a soul, he still felt pain.
The repulsive force assaulted him from all directions. How could he block it?
No, that’s not right. Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He was a soul now, and since he was a soul, why was he stuck in human form?
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his body suddenly changed shape, leaving behind only his head. Then, two arms grew out of his head, waving his fists as he charged towards the stone door.
‘Open!’
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han swung his fists rapidly. With Destructive Energy and Demonic Monkey Fists, he was extremely domineering, forcefully opening up a path.
He charged into the stone door for about five meters, but there was still a force stopping him.

Now, he could clearly see that there was a layer of light on the stone door, which had a strong flexibility and elasticity. Now, he had pushed it back five meters, and the compressive power had also reached the peak, wanting to bounce him back by force.
If he wanted to pass through the stone door, he would have to break through this light screen.
Break, break, break! Ling Han roared in his mind as he swung his fists even more rapidly. Destructive Energy smashed into the barrier of light.
This light screen was a little terrifying. Just how powerful was Destructive Energy? Yet, it was actually unable to succeed time and time again.
Lmg Han was completely unconcerned. There was only one thought left in his mind, and that was to deliver a punch.
If one punch couldn’t deal with it, then two punches. If two punches couldn’t deal with it, then ten punches, a hundred punches, a thousand punches…
Ka, ka, ka! Multiple white lines appeared on the screen of light, as dense as a spider’s web.
He was about to break through!

However, the more this was the case, the greater the resistance created by the light screen was. In fact, it even looked like it was about to push Ling Han back. Though it was only a sliver, a few white lines immediately disappeared.
Clearly, the light screen had been repaired.
Ling Han roared in fury, his fists raining down like rain. The speed far exceeded his limits.
He was a soul, and would not be restricted by the body.
Ka, ka, ka! More and more white lines appeared, and finally, with a bang, the light screen shattered.
Ling Han stumbled through the stone door.
Success!
Ling Han hadn’t come back to his senses yet, when a massive power began to drag him downwards rapidly. Right at this moment, he suddenly saw a figure appear, appearing where he had previously been.

The other party had also discovered Ling Han’s presence, and looked towards him. However, the dragging force was too strong, and Ling Han’s speed was too fast. Neither of them seemed to have seen how the other looked like.
Ling Han’s heart clenched. Aside from him, there was actually another person that could come to the fourth Celestial Gate!
He had not even finished the thought, when it was as if his soul had become weightless, and rapidly fell. Then, in the forest, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open..

chapters.title: Chapter 3652 - Building the Celestial Foundation
paragraphs: Building the Celestial Foundation
Translator. Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han opened his eyes, and two pillars of light instantly shot out from his eyes. Pa, pa, pa! The surrounding trees immediately crumbled.

This was not because he had cultivated some Mystical Power, but rather because after he had leaped over the Celestial Gate, his Spiritual Power and mystical power had both improved astonishingly, and he was still unable to adapt to his present power. With a sweep of his gaze, he had broken down the trees.
He had leaped over the Celestial Gate, yet had yet to reach the Foundation Building Tier. Right now, he could be considered a Pseudo Celestial Path elite.
However, at this moment, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t give up halfway.
He continued to build his Celestial Foundation.

Doubt flashed through his mind. Why was there a damaged Celestial Gate? He had never heard of this before. Could it be that it had appeared because he had cultivated the mortal level to perfection?𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
However, he also saw another person appear in front of the stone door. Could it be that someone had also cultivated the mortal level to perfection?
Was this possible?
He could cultivate a flawless body because countless dimensions had nurtured in his body. How could it be that this kind of good fortune would happen to a second person?
Let’s not think about this first. If he had the chance to encounter “that person-
in the future, he would get to know him better.
However, there was a sea of people, so where was he supposed to find him? En, that must be a supreme prodigy, so hewould just have to search in this direction.

Ling Han began to build his Celestial Foundation. He didn’t use the Foundation Building Divine Stone, since he already knew that it was formed from the blood of a Great Emperor. If he wanted to walk out his own path to become an Emperor, he couldn’t walk the same path as the other.
Moreover, he had previously been immersed in the Sea of True Blood, so the benefits he had received were far superior to any Foundation Building Divine Stone.
What foundation should I build?

Ling Han buried a belief in invincibility, a fighting spirit that would never be defeated, and used it as the foundation of the Celestial Path. Then, he wrapped it with his Spiritual Power, and nourished it with his mystical power, continuously strengthening it.

He thought of the Stone Celestial Gate, and couldn’t help but have a thought. He intentionally shaped it into that shape. Even the material was the same, possessing the rough veined patterns of stone.
That’s right, there was also the primitive aura.

Kuang, right at this moment, a sudden clap of thunder suddenly sounded in the heaven and earth. Dark clouds rolled out, densely gathered above the mountains and forests. Flashes of light intertwined, as if they could strike down at any moment.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel shocked. He imitated the Stone Celestial Gate to construct the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, and it actually made heaven and earth furious?
F***, where had this Stone Celestial Gate come from? The heaven and earth actually considered it a taboo?
But the more this was the case, the more determined Ling Han was to do it.
If he were to build a Celestial Foundation like this, he would definitely be incredibly powerful.
■Come, so what if the heavens are furious? If you have the ability, strike down
the lightning.’
Kuang, the lightning really struck down. Just a few meters away from Ling Han, a large tree was instantly severed, and crashed towards him.
Ling Han casually waved his hand, and this broken tree was sent flying.
Are you trying to scare me!
He continued to construct his Celestial Foundation. Kuang, kuang, kuang! The thunder became even louder, and more lightning struck down, but not a single bolt struck him.
The heaven’s calamity descended from the skies, only striking great evils. Ling
Han had nothing to do with that.
Heavenly Dao was merciless, letting all things perish or emerge of themselves, so how could it now treat him with prejudice?
However, right at this moment, a bolt of purple lightning suddenly struck down, directly sinking into Ling Han’s mind.

The purple lightning took the form of a human figure that was filled with dignity. He shouted loudly, “How dare you, you actually dare to oppose the heaven and earth. Without any respect or fear, this god will come and kill you!’ Shua, the purple figure charged over at an incredibly fast speed.
It was an internal demon.
Ling Han immediately thought. It was not that this world did not have heaven’s calamity, but it did not mean destroying a person physically, but rather destroying a person’s soul.
The internal demons would cause chaos, and cause one to become a demon. Thus, the Heavenly Dao would have a reason to send down a heaven’s calamity to eliminate them.

And Ling Han’s internal demon was even more direct. It was not going to disturb him, but rather directly destroy his spirit. Without his divine sense, his physical body would be an empty shell. No matter how awesome his Celestial Foundation was, what was the use?
The internal demon attacked, wanting to penetrate Ling Han’s mind and strike his spirit.
“An!” Ling Han suddenly spoke up. Weng, the sound of Buddha boomed out. Crack! Cracks instantly appeared on the purple figure’s body, but there was only one crack.
“An!” Ling Han roared again. His voice was like a deep and thought-provoking bell.
Ka, another crack appeared on the purple figure.
Ling Han charged over, unleashing an intense battle.
Peng, peng, peng! He naturally had to rely on his Spiritual Power to sever his internal demons. This mystical power wouldn’t be of much use.

The internal demon was extremely powerful. This was not the internal demon tribulation that Ling Han had formed after cultivating the Celestial Foundation. Instead, it was because the Celestial Foundation that he wanted to build was too extraordinary. The heaven and earth had descended the internal demon tribulation ahead of time to prevent him from being so “treasonous”. However, Ling Han had mastered the Six Characters Bright King Curse, which was specifically used to kill evil and subdue internal demons. Even if there was only one word, it was still very effective.
Two more cracks appeared on the internal demon’s body, and its battle prowess naturally fell drastically. It was completely suppressed by Ling Han.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
Ling Han shouted repeatedly, and more and more cracks appeared on the internal demon. Finally, it shattered with a bang.

As expected, the Buddhist Race specialized in subduing internal demons. Just the An character alone was already so awesome, so if it was complete with six all six characters, just how powerful would it be?
Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and continued to construct the Celestial Foundation.
Kuang! Another bolt of purple lightning struck down, manifesting in Ling Han’s mind and launching an attack.
Ling Han shook his head. The Six Characters Bright King Curse continued to be shouted out, and the internal demonic entity couldn’t threaten him at all.

He was multitasking. This time, he was only suppressing the internal demon in his heart but not disintegrating it. On the other side, he was speeding up the process of building the Celestial Foundation. Obviously, if he did not interrupt or complete it, this internal demon from this heaven’s calamity would have no end.
Fight, fight, fight! Ling Han remained calm and confident.
A day later, the Celestial Foundation was completed!

The Foundation of Human Dao was only the size of a fist, yet it exuded a grand and majestic aura. There was also a sense of a primitive aura, as if this was the cornerstone of heaven and earth when it was first created, and could support heaven and earth.
In the skies, the dark clouds dispersed. The heaven and earth could no longer stop him, so the tribulation clouds naturally could only disperse.
However, the dark clouds had not dispersed completely, but in the next instant, the dark clouds gathered again.
‘Heaven’s calamity again?

This naturally was not to stop Ling Han from building his Celestial Foundation, but rather because he had successfully built his Foundation, and the heaven and earth would send down a punishment of tribulation. This was a routine matter.
However, in comparison, this internal demon was too weak. Ling Han only shouted ten consecutive times of the An character, and the internal demon was completely resolved.

Ling Han was just about to stand up, when he suddenly realized that all the apertures in his body had been opened. The power of heaven and earth surged towards him, greatly boosting his mystical power. It was the same even for Spiritual Power.
Only after taking this step would he truly step out of the mortal level. Ling Han hurriedly sat down and channeled the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, absorbing the benefits with all his might.

The Mystery Realms created by other Foundation Building Tiers wouldn’t be very big. Perhaps they would be filled up in a short while, but Ling Han’s Mystery Realms were like bottomless pits. No matter how the power of heaven and earth was stuffed into his hands, he would take them all.
Unfortunately, only half a day had passed, and peace returned to heaven and earth.
“What level has my strength reached now?” Ling Han stroked his chin in anticipation.
However, the most important thing now was not to be curious about his own strength, but to release the empress and the others!

It was not that this world did not have heaven’s calamity, but it did not mean destroying a person physically, but rather destroying a person’s soul.
The internal demons would cause chaos, and cause one to become a demon.
Thus, the Heavenly Dao would have a reason to send down a heaven’s calamity to eliminate them.
And Ling Han’s internal demon was even more direct.
It was not going to disturb him, but rather directly destroy his spirit.
Without his divine sense, his physical body would be an empty shell.
No matter how awesome his Celestial Foundation was, what was the use?
The internal demon attacked, wanting to penetrate Ling Han’s mind and strike his spirit.
“An!” Ling Han suddenly spoke up.
Weng, the sound of Buddha boomed out.
Crack!
Cracks instantly appeared on the purple figure’s body, but there was only one crack.
“An!” Ling Han roared again.
His voice was like a deep and thought-provoking bell.
Ka, another crack appeared on the purple figure.
Ling Han charged over, unleashing an intense battle.
Peng, peng, peng!
He naturally had to rely on his Spiritual Power to sever his internal demons.
This mystical power wouldn’t be of much use.
The internal demon was extremely powerful.
This was not the internal demon tribulation that Ling Han had formed after cultivating the Celestial Foundation.
Instead, it was because the Celestial Foundation that he wanted to build was too extraordinary.
The heaven and earth had descended the internal demon tribulation ahead of time to prevent him from being so “treasonous”.
However, Ling Han had mastered the Six Characters Bright King Curse, which was specifically used to kill evil and subdue internal demons.
Even if there was only one word, it was still very effective.
Two more cracks appeared on the internal demon’s body, and its battle prowess naturally fell drastically.
It was completely suppressed by Ling Han.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
Ling Han shouted repeatedly, and more and more cracks appeared on the internal demon.
Finally, it shattered with a bang.
As expected, the Buddhist Race specialized in subduing internal demons.
Just the An character alone was already so awesome, so if it was complete with six all six characters, just how powerful would it be?
Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and continued to construct the Celestial Foundation.
Kuang!
Another bolt of purple lightning struck down, manifesting in Ling Han’s mind and launching an attack.
Ling Han shook his head.
The Six Characters Bright King Curse continued to be shouted out, and the internal demonic entity couldn’t threaten him at all.
He was multitasking.
This time, he was only suppressing the internal demon in his heart but not disintegrating it.
On the other side, he was speeding up the process of building the Celestial Foundation.
Obviously, if he did not interrupt or complete it, this internal demon from this heaven’s calamity would have no end.
Fight, fight, fight!
Ling Han remained calm and confident.
A day later, the Celestial Foundation was completed!
The Foundation of Human Dao was only the size of a fist, yet it exuded a grand and majestic aura.
There was also a sense of a primitive aura, as if this was the cornerstone of heaven and earth when it was first created, and could support heaven and earth.
In the skies, the dark clouds dispersed.
The heaven and earth could no longer stop him, so the tribulation clouds naturally could only disperse.
However, the dark clouds had not dispersed completely, but in the next instant, the dark clouds gathered again.
‘Heaven’s calamity again?

This naturally was not to stop Ling Han from building his Celestial Foundation, but rather because he had successfully built his Foundation, and the heaven and earth would send down a punishment of tribulation.
This was a routine matter.
However, in comparison, this internal demon was too weak.
Ling Han only shouted ten consecutive times of the An character, and the internal demon was completely resolved.
Ling Han was just about to stand up, when he suddenly realized that all the apertures in his body had been opened.
The power of heaven and earth surged towards him, greatly boosting his mystical power.
It was the same even for Spiritual Power.
Only after taking this step would he truly step out of the mortal level.
Ling Han hurriedly sat down and channeled the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, absorbing the benefits with all his might.
The Mystery Realms created by other Foundation Building Tiers wouldn’t be very big.
Perhaps they would be filled up in a short while, but Ling Han’s Mystery Realms were like bottomless pits.
No matter how the power of heaven and earth was stuffed into his hands, he would take them all.
Unfortunately, only half a day had passed, and peace returned to heaven and earth.
“What level has my strength reached now?” Ling Han stroked his chin in anticipation.
However, the most important thing now was not to be curious about his own strength, but to release the empress and the others!

chapters.title: Chapter 3653 - Heavenly Venerable Tier elites appear
paragraphs: Heavenly Venerable Tier elites appear
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was filled with anticipation. He would be able to release those Heavenly Venerates in his body once he had stepped onto the Celestial Path. This was something that he had always guessed.
Now that he had finally become a Foundation Building cultivator, he was also nervous about whether he could succeed or not.
For this day, he had long since prepared himself.

A long time ago, he had already set his eyes on a Heavenly Venerable Tier elite. He was an extremely evil person, and should have died long ago. However, Ling Han had imprisoned him and not killed him all this while just for the sake of performing an experiment now.
This was a First Tier Heavenly Venerate.
With a thought, he forcibly extracted the other from his body.
“Ah-” This Heavenly Venerable Tier elite screamed in agony. Passing through the inner world was no joke. There was an incredibly strong resistance, and even with his physique, he could not bear it.
However, how could Ling Han care? He forcefully pushed him out.

Pa, that Heavenly Venerable Tier elite fell onto the ground, all his clothes completely damaged. He had withstood the massive pressure to pass through the passageway of the “Two Realms”, but his clothes could not. Furthermore, the suppression of this heaven and earth on him was too great. At present, he was like an infant bom prematurely, incredibly weak.
He was indeed weak, but in the end, he had stiU come out safely.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. He had succeeded.
“Where is this?” the Heavenly Venerable Tier elite asked in a stuttering voice. He couldn’t open his eyes, and he only knew that he had lost all of his divine power. He was as fragile as an infant.
In truth, he was like an infant bom prematurely at that.
“And who are you?” the Heavenly Venerable Tier elite continued to ask. Ling
Han’s strength terrified him. He was a Heavenly Venerable Tier elite, yet he had actually been captured here for no reason.
“You don’t need to know. Just die.” Ling Han shot out a punch, and the Destructive Energy swept past. That Heavenly Venerable Tier elite was immediately annihilated.
The reason why he hadn’t killed him, but rather directly erased him was because Ling Han still wanted to release the empress and the others later.
They had reunited after such a long time, yet there was a corpse that was an eyesore. How troublesome would that be?
Ling Han communicated with the empress and the others, telling them to make preparations.
“Husband, we are already prepared.”
“Ling Han, Niu really wants to see you!”
The women were all eager to give it a try.
Ling Han nodded. He first fetched the empress, who was the strongest among the women.

Even if he was in charge of his world, Ling Han had no way to directly elevate others to Heavenly Venerable Tier-level. He could only try his best to make things as convenient as possible, and it was the same for those who had advanced into Heavenly Venerable Tier-level. They would have to comprehend appreciation on their own.

Ling Han could only rapidly make them Celestial Kings. With a single thought, he could make a mortal become a Ninth Heaven Celestial King. Furthermore, there were no aftereffects, and the price was that he would have to expend a portion of his power.
After all, only two years had passed, and now, with the passing of time, even if the empress received special treatment from Ling Han, she had only reached Sixth Tier.
Sixth Tier Heavenly Venerates were already very strong, and even First Tier Heavenly Venerates could safely come out, so what more a Sixth Tier Heavenly Venerate?
However, Ling Han was still a little nervous at this moment, and he carefully escorted the empress out.
In just a short while, the empress “appeared”.

Ling Han hurriedly drew out a blanket that he had long since prepared, and draped it over the empress. Though there were no outsiders here, the empress’s body was extraordinarily weak compared to this heaven and earth. It was very easy for her to catch a cold.
“Ling Ling Han!” the empress stammered. She tried her best to open her eyes, and only after glancing at Ling Han did she finally close them and rest in peace.
With Ling Han by her side, even if she came to this new world, she would be extremely at ease.
Ling Han also breathed a sigh of relief, and began to guide Hu Niu out.
“Niu is here!”
Pa, Hu Niu was Hu Niu. Even if she was as weak as a newborn, she still called out happily.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. Then, among his beautiful wives, there was actually no third wife that had reached the Heavenly Venerable Tier.

It could not be helped. Aside from the empress and Hu Niu, the other women’s natural talent was not all that impressive. Though he had opened the back door for them, how could two years’ time be enough?

Thankfully, as long as they were inside Ling Han’s body, that was another world. There was another set of Regulations, and as long as they had become Celestial Kings, everyone would not have to worry about their lifespans and Immortal’s Calamity.
Thus, as long as Ling Han didn’t die, the people in his body wouldn’t have to worry about their lifespans.
Ling Han continued to let them go. Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, the Karmic Life Heavenly Venerable, the large black dog, and so on all came out of his body as long as they had reached Heavenly Venerable Tier.
Actually, this was a weakening effect on him. After all, every person that came out of the entity would mean one less supply of Spiritual Power, but Ling Han naturally wouldn’t care.
All of a sudden, several hundred people had appeared in the forest. Thankfully, Ling Han had prepared enough clothes. Otherwise, it would have been so much ‘fun’.
Ling Han wrapped them up with the Essence Nurturing Gourd, but the internal space was limited, and one time wasn’t enough, so he could only come back and pack them up a few more times.
He bought a large courtyard, and placed everyone inside.

Four days later, Lin Luo and the other former Seventh Tier Heavenly Venerates were the first to be able to get out of bed. They had also obtained the cultivation techniques that Ling Han had prepared for them, alchemical pills, and support formations. They had already begun to cultivate.
With their talent, it wouldn’t be long before they could step into the Blood Transformation Tier. The help that Ling Han could provide them now was really too great.

A Seventh Tier Heavenly Venerate needed only four days to recover, a Sixth Tier needed six days, a Fifth Tier needed eight days, and a Fourth Tier needed eleven days. In short, the weaker they were, the later they would be able to get out of bed.
After more than 20 days, everyone finally recovered.
After so many days, Ling Han was naturally familiar with his current cultivation level.
His strength had undergone an earthshaking change.

Firstly, it was Spiritual Power. Though being able to release everyone out of the inner world was already the most direct reflection, if used in battle, he could already instantly compress the Heavenly Pattern Jade into a few grams.

There was completely no need to instill mystical power into it. The moment Spiritual Power moved, it could be shot out at 30 times the speed of sound. Probably, killing a Heavenly Dao Foundation cultivator would only need a single strike, and it was not impossible for a Heavenly Dao Foundation cultivator to be killed instantly either.
As for the details, it would still have to depend on actual battle.

On the other hand, his Spiritual Power was finally strong enough to form a connection with the Heavenly Pattern Jade. In other words, unless he was much stronger than his Spiritual Power, no one else would be able to use the Heavenly Pattern Jade even if he obtained it.
Secondly, his mystical power was strong enough, and his level of being also had a qualitative change. It could already withstand the burden of channelling a celestial technique.
At present, he could channel the Imminent Skyline for a long time, about an hour or so. Only then would his body become so hot that it was about to burn, and he would not be able to continue.

However, he could only channel the Three Styles of the God of War once. Of course, the might of these three styles was also terrifyingly powerful. The power of the Demonic Monkey Fists had also reached one hundred and eight layers. This was the limit, and there was no way to increase it further. The Eye Technique could also be maintained for a long time, and only after continuously activating for half a day would his eyes feel dry.
In short, his improvement was much, much too great.
“I really want to fight with Hong Tianbu,” Ling Han murmured. However, he stiU needed to take care of the others, so he didn’t have the energy to play around for the time being.
He had already made up his mind. When they could stand on their own two feet, he would seek out the Second Prince and the others, and give them a good beating.

However, after advancing into Celestial Path, that supplementary cultivation technique of his became useless. It was also the same for the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique. It seemed Uke they were not suitable for Celestial Path.
There were pros and cons. However, in comparison, these cons could be ignored.

chapters.title: Chapter 3654 - A perfect match
paragraphs: A perfect match
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Ling Han, play with Niu!” Hu Niu jumped over, a youthful smile on her face.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and pulled this beautiful wife that had not grown up into his arms, “Wait a few more days, and I will give you a few children to play with.”

“Sure, sure.” Hu Niu giggled. Others were seizing the time to understand this world’ but she did not feel the slightest bit of nervousness. It was as if as long as Ling Han was here, everything was enough.
She had no ambitions, and would act as she pleased, taking things as they
came.

Another few days later, everyone was equipped with the ability to walk freely, and Lin Luo and the others, who had started cultivating the earliest, had already reached the peak stage of Meridian Opening Tier. They only had to open all their Meridians, and they would be able to step into Blood Transformation Tier in a perfect state.

Ling Han believed that these people were all prodigies. After all, they had been accumulated by Genesis World for who knew how many years. Although they didn’t have an inner world inside them, so they couldn’t step onto the Seventh Change, Seventh Extreme, and so on, it wasn’t difficult for them to become three-star geniuses.

Everyone discussed for a while. Lin Luo and the others all expressed that they would stay temporarily in the Imperial Capital. This planet had just awakened, and for beginners like them, it was a paradise. After they set foot on Celestial Path, it would not be too late for them to go to the other great planets.
Ling Xi, Ling Jianxue and the other children also expressed their desire to train on the Celestial Sea Planet first, so they would not accompany Ling Han to the Holy Land of Metal Element.
What were they going to do? Just stand by and watch?

Ling Han had already prepared enough alchemical pills for everyone, and added with the accumulation from selling alchemical pills previously, his wealth was extraordinarily abundant. It was completely no problem for him to supply these people.

Moreover, with the awakening of heaven and earth, Treasured Fruits of Life also appeared one after another. At least, for those below the Celestial Path, they weren’t all that valuable. They could be bought as long as one could pay.
After resolving this most important matter, Ling Han decided to set out for the Holy Land of Metal Element.
This time, he planned to bring the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and Wally. After all, he was only going for the Metal Element Fruit Gathering. He wouldn’t be staying there for too long.
It was the large black dog’s own choice, while Wally’s calculation ability was highly valued by Ling Han.
He accompanied the two women, and brought the large black dog and Wally to the Foreign Affairs Department.
The large black dog’s mouth was wide open. He wanted to say something, but all he could say was, “Woof, woof, woof.”
In this world, it was just an ordinary dog, so how could it possibly open its mouth to speak?
At the very least, it had to reach the Blood Transformation Tier and consume the Transformation Fruit to be able to speak human language, and even transform into human form.
Though so many days had passed, the large black dog was still not used to it. It barked endlessly, yet could not say anything, which made it feel extremely uncomfortable.
Ling Han was naturally very familiar with it, and said with a smile, “Are you trying to say that I’m doing quite well now?”
The large black dog hurriedly nodded. There was no need for its intelligence to awaken again. However, it was still too weak now, so it couldn’t even speak.
However, it couldn’t be stopped even if it couldn’t speak. The large black dog still raised a paw, as if he was giving Ling Han a thumbs up.
Ling Han wore a strange expression, and said, “Say, when you came out of the inner world, didn’t your iron underwear shatter? What’s up with this one now?”
The large black dog was currently wearing a pair of purple underpants, and as he walked, he would twist his behind. This was truly an eyesore.
“Woof, woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog barked repeatedly, as if he was complaining.
Ling Han could just barely understand. It should be because its present physique was still unable to wear iron underwear, so it could only wear cloth. It was a dog that knew shame.
As for where this pair of underpants had come from, Ling Han didn’t want to know. He kept feeling that this inside story was too dirty.

“Yi, Ling Han, you’re finally back!” Xuanyuan Dingguo walked out. He swept an eye over the empress and Hu Niu, and a stunned expression appeared on his face. Thankfully, the two women had covered their faces, and he could only see their figures. Otherwise, he would not be stunned, but rather dumbfounded.

Then, when he saw the large black dog, he couldn’t help but drool. “Where did you get this mutt from? It’s so fat, are you eating dog meat tonight?” The large black dog was enraged. He actually dared to say that he wanted to eat dog meat in front of Grandpa Dog? And eat Grandpa Dog?
It scuttled out, and opened its mouth to bite.
See if I won’t bite you to death, b@stard.
“Let go! Let go!” Xuanyuan Dingguo shouted loudly. With his strength, he naturally couldn’t be bitten by the large black dog. However, being dragged around by a dog was humiliating enough.

Ling Han laughed loudly, “Has anything happened these few days?” “No, there are just some rumors saying that you’re not qualified to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering. You don’t live up to your name, and you’re not worthy of being called a prodigy of the Imperial Capital,” Xuanyuan Dingguo said.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He did not take this kind of empty reputation to heart. Moreover, he was not the prodigy of the Imperial Capital, but rather the greatest prodigy of the universe, all right?
“And these two are?” Xuanyuan Dingguo approached and asked softly. His eyes drifted to the empress and Hu Niu.
“Your elder sisters-in-law,” Ling Han replied.

“Pei, it’s younger sisters-in-law!” Xuanyuan Dingguo immediately said. He then shamelessly greeted the two women, saying, “That brat Ling Han is truly good at hiding. He only allowed me to see two sisters-in-law at this moment. He’s treating me like an outsider!”
“It’s elder sisters-in-law!” the empress said proudly. In her heart, she was the most important person in this world. Not counting Ling Han, as that was her husband.
Xuanyuan Dingguo couldn’t help but be startled. Why was this girl so proud? However, though the empress’s appearance was hidden, her aura was astonishing, forcefully suppressing him.

“Father!” At this time, the seven babies also ran over. The little loli followed behind, looking very laidback, while the fat pig was held in her arms. “Handsome Brother, where did you get two great beauties from?” Tang Yun’er was slightly surprised as she looked at the empress and Hu Niu.

Though the appearances of the two women were not apparent, their figures were too perfect. Furthermore, they were enchantingly voluptuous. She was sure that they were definitely great beauties, almost catching up to her – the little loli had never known modesty about her own looks.
Pa, she threw the fat pig onto the ground, and pounced towards the empress. She was too beautiful, and she really wanted to hug her.
The fat pig fell to the ground, and instantly screamed in pain. Though it could not be wounded, it was still very painful, b@stard.
However, Tang Yun’er also missed her target. Ling Han managed to pick up the empress in time, preventing the little loli from succeeding.

The large black dog immediately darted out, and pressed a paw on the fat pig, barking at Ling Han. The meaning was too simple: let’s eat roasted suckling pig tonight, and have a snack.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
On the other side, Hu Niu was also drooling, “Roasted suckling pig! Roasted suckling pig! Roasted suckling pig!”
When the seven babies heard this, they instantly felt an amiable feeling towards Hu Niu. This was one with similar tastes.
“Roasted suckling pig! Roasted suckling pig!” They too called out, their small eyes bright.
The fat pig bore a deep hatred. ‘Do you all have some kind of enmity with pigs? Why do you all want to eat roasted suckling pig when you see me?’ Did a pig offend you guys?
“Gu!” It barked at the large black dog. It was all this despicable dog’s fault for starting it.

“Woof, woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog naturally wasn’t willing to be outdone. He had never been one to suffer losses. One look, and he could tell that this perverted pig was definitely scolding him.
“Gu, gu, gu.”
“Woof, woof, woof.”

sentences.text: A perfect match
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Ling Han, play with Niu!” Hu Niu jumped over, a youthful smile on her face.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and pulled this beautiful wife that had not grown up into his arms, “Wait a few more days, and I will give you a few children to play with.”
“Sure, sure.” Hu Niu giggled.
Others were seizing the time to understand this world’ but she did not feel the slightest bit of nervousness.
It was as if as long as Ling Han was here, everything was enough.
She had no ambitions, and would act as she pleased, taking things as they
came.

Another few days later, everyone was equipped with the ability to walk freely, and Lin Luo and the others, who had started cultivating the earliest, had already reached the peak stage of Meridian Opening Tier.
They only had to open all their Meridians, and they would be able to step into Blood Transformation Tier in a perfect state.
Ling Han believed that these people were all prodigies.
After all, they had been accumulated by Genesis World for who knew how many years.
Although they didn’t have an inner world inside them, so they couldn’t step onto the Seventh Change, Seventh Extreme, and so on, it wasn’t difficult for them to become three-star geniuses.
Everyone discussed for a while.
Lin Luo and the others all expressed that they would stay temporarily in the Imperial Capital.
This planet had just awakened, and for beginners like them, it was a paradise.
After they set foot on Celestial Path, it would not be too late for them to go to the other great planets.
Ling Xi, Ling Jianxue and the other children also expressed their desire to train on the Celestial Sea Planet first, so they would not accompany Ling Han to the Holy Land of Metal Element.
What were they going to do?
Just stand by and watch?
Ling Han had already prepared enough alchemical pills for everyone, and added with the accumulation from selling alchemical pills previously, his wealth was extraordinarily abundant.
It was completely no problem for him to supply these people.
Moreover, with the awakening of heaven and earth, Treasured Fruits of Life also appeared one after another.
At least, for those below the Celestial Path, they weren’t all that valuable.
They could be bought as long as one could pay.
After resolving this most important matter, Ling Han decided to set out for the Holy Land of Metal Element.
This time, he planned to bring the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and Wally.
After all, he was only going for the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
He wouldn’t be staying there for too long.
It was the large black dog’s own choice, while Wally’s calculation ability was highly valued by Ling Han.
He accompanied the two women, and brought the large black dog and Wally to the Foreign Affairs Department.
The large black dog’s mouth was wide open.
He wanted to say something, but all he could say was, “Woof, woof, woof.”
In this world, it was just an ordinary dog, so how could it possibly open its mouth to speak?
At the very least, it had to reach the Blood Transformation Tier and consume the Transformation Fruit to be able to speak human language, and even transform into human form.
Though so many days had passed, the large black dog was still not used to it.
It barked endlessly, yet could not say anything, which made it feel extremely uncomfortable.
Ling Han was naturally very familiar with it, and said with a smile, “Are you trying to say that I’m doing quite well now?”
The large black dog hurriedly nodded.
There was no need for its intelligence to awaken again.
However, it was still too weak now, so it couldn’t even speak.
However, it couldn’t be stopped even if it couldn’t speak.
The large black dog still raised a paw, as if he was giving Ling Han a thumbs up.
Ling Han wore a strange expression, and said, “Say, when you came out of the inner world, didn’t your iron underwear shatter?
What’s up with this one now?”
The large black dog was currently wearing a pair of purple underpants, and as he walked, he would twist his behind.
This was truly an eyesore.
“Woof, woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog barked repeatedly, as if he was complaining.
Ling Han could just barely understand.
It should be because its present physique was still unable to wear iron underwear, so it could only wear cloth.
It was a dog that knew shame.
As for where this pair of underpants had come from, Ling Han didn’t want to know.
He kept feeling that this inside story was too dirty.
“Yi, Ling Han, you’re finally back!” Xuanyuan Dingguo walked out.
He swept an eye over the empress and Hu Niu, and a stunned expression appeared on his face.
Thankfully, the two women had covered their faces, and he could only see their figures.
Otherwise, he would not be stunned, but rather dumbfounded.
Then, when he saw the large black dog, he couldn’t help but drool.
“Where did you get this mutt from?
It’s so fat, are you eating dog meat tonight?” The large black dog was enraged.
He actually dared to say that he wanted to eat dog meat in front of Grandpa Dog?
And eat Grandpa Dog?
It scuttled out, and opened its mouth to bite.
See if I won’t bite you to death, b@stard.
“Let go!
Let go!” Xuanyuan Dingguo shouted loudly.
With his strength, he naturally couldn’t be bitten by the large black dog.
However, being dragged around by a dog was humiliating enough.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Has anything happened these few days?” “No, there are just some rumors saying that you’re not qualified to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
You don’t live up to your name, and you’re not worthy of being called a prodigy of the Imperial Capital,” Xuanyuan Dingguo said.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
He did not take this kind of empty reputation to heart.
Moreover, he was not the prodigy of the Imperial Capital, but rather the greatest prodigy of the universe, all right?
“And these two are?” Xuanyuan Dingguo approached and asked softly.
His eyes drifted to the empress and Hu Niu.
“Your elder sisters-in-law,” Ling Han replied.
“Pei, it’s younger sisters-in-law!” Xuanyuan Dingguo immediately said.
He then shamelessly greeted the two women, saying, “That brat Ling Han is truly good at hiding.
He only allowed me to see two sisters-in-law at this moment.
He’s treating me like an outsider!”
“It’s elder sisters-in-law!” the empress said proudly.
In her heart, she was the most important person in this world.
Not counting Ling Han, as that was her husband.
Xuanyuan Dingguo couldn’t help but be startled.
Why was this girl so proud?
However, though the empress’s appearance was hidden, her aura was astonishing, forcefully suppressing him.
“Father!” At this time, the seven babies also ran over.
The little loli followed behind, looking very laidback, while the fat pig was held in her arms.
“Handsome Brother, where did you get two great beauties from?” Tang Yun’er was slightly surprised as she looked at the empress and Hu Niu.
Though the appearances of the two women were not apparent, their figures were too perfect.
Furthermore, they were enchantingly voluptuous.
She was sure that they were definitely great beauties, almost catching up to her – the little loli had never known modesty about her own looks.
Pa, she threw the fat pig onto the ground, and pounced towards the empress.
She was too beautiful, and she really wanted to hug her.
The fat pig fell to the ground, and instantly screamed in pain.
Though it could not be wounded, it was still very painful, b@stard.
However, Tang Yun’er also missed her target.
Ling Han managed to pick up the empress in time, preventing the little loli from succeeding.
The large black dog immediately darted out, and pressed a paw on the fat pig, barking at Ling Han.
The meaning was too simple: let’s eat roasted suckling pig tonight, and have a snack.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
On the other side, Hu Niu was also drooling, “Roasted suckling pig!
Roasted suckling pig!
Roasted suckling pig!”
When the seven babies heard this, they instantly felt an amiable feeling towards Hu Niu.
This was one with similar tastes.
“Roasted suckling pig!
Roasted suckling pig!” They too called out, their small eyes bright.
The fat pig bore a deep hatred. ‘Do you all have some kind of enmity with pigs?
Why do you all want to eat roasted suckling pig when you see me?’ Did a pig offend you guys?
“Gu!” It barked at the large black dog.
It was all this despicable dog’s fault for starting it.
“Woof, woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog naturally wasn’t willing to be outdone.
He had never been one to suffer losses.
One look, and he could tell that this perverted pig was definitely scolding him.
“Gu, gu, gu.”
“Woof, woof, woof.”
Alright, now that the pig and dog had clashed, they were both shouting at each other.
Though they could not understand each other’s “words”, they definitely could not allow any weakness to show, b@stard.

chapters.title: Chapter 3655 - Charging into the Imperial Prince Manor
paragraphs: Charging into the Imperial Prince Manor
Translator: Henyee Translations I Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone found this interesting.

Whether it was the fat pig or the large black dog, they had clearly developed intelligence, but for various reasons, they could not speak. The pig could only bark at the dog, and the dog would bark at the pig.
All right, no roasted suckling pig, no dog meat, let’s just get something to eat,” Ling Han said with a smile.
They sat down first, and then Ling Han made arrangements.

He was going to leave Celestial Sea Planet. This trip would take at least more than half a year, so he definitely had to make proper arrangements, unlike before, when he had Princess Bixiao to act in his place.
Thinking of this, Ling Han felt that this princess of the Demon Race was still quite useful.

“You’re leaving again?” Xuanyuan Dingguo asked in astonishment. This Chief of the Foreign Affairs Department was far too incompetent. The Foreign Affairs Department had only been established for a short while, yet he had already been absent for 90% of the time.
Ling Han nodded and said, “In the future, I’ll leave the Foreign Affairs Department to you.”
Me? Can I protect the department?” Xuanyuan Dingguo appeared extremely unconfident.

“It’s fine. Now that the ownership of the various great forces has been decided, the Foreign Affairs Department actually doesn’t have much else to do. Furthermore, before I leave, I will do one more thing. I guarantee that no one would dare to trifle with the Foreign Affairs Department in future,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“What do you want to do?” Xuanyuan Dingguo suddenly felt a very bad premonition.

Ling Han cracked a smile, “To make an example. Later, I will go and give the Second Prince, the Third Prince and the others a good beating.” ‘Don’t you mess around!” Xuanyuan Dingguo instantly panicked. ‘Are you trying to get into big trouble?’
Che, he’s just the son of a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite. So what if he is beaten up?” Tang Yun’er licked the toffee with a nonchalant expression.
On the sidelines, Hu Niu was drooling, staring fixedly at the toffee in her hand. She didn’t have the slightest bit of reservedness.
Xuanyuan Dingguo inhaled sharply. How was it that each of these people was fiercer than the last?
If a Spirit Transformation True Lord was nothing, then what would something be?
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. It will be fine,” Ling Han said.
How could Xuanyuan Dingguo relax? However, he couldn’t persuade Ling Han at all, so he could only do nothing.
Ling Han invited Yin Xiujing, Lian Xuerong and the others over for a meal. This could be considered a farewell feast.

Seeing the empress and Hu Niu, even if Yin Xiujing and Lian Xuerong were proud of their exquisite beauty, they still felt ashamed of their own inferiority. And this was still because the two women were wearing veils. If they really revealed their true faces, who knew what kind of commotion it would cause.
Thus, Ling Han’s current strength was still very weak, so he could only tell the two women to keep a low profile.
After eating, Ling Han left the Foreign Affairs Department and headed directly to the manor of the Second Prince.
The empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, the little loli, and the babies all followed behind. They were all people who liked to join in on the excitement, so how could they miss this opportunity?
Thus, this team was also very strange. There were beauties, little beauties, babies, a dog, and a pig. As they passed, everyone was dumbfounded.
What was the prodigy of the Imperial Capital trying to do?
In a short while, Ling Han had already arrived in front of the manor of the Second Prince.

As a dignified Imperial Prince, he was naturally living in a luxurious manor. It occupied an extremely large area, and was dazzling and resplendent. There were even eight large men standing guard at the entrance, looking extremely fierce.
“Hey, stop!” A large man pulled out a section of the saber at his waist, and shouted at Ling Han.
Ling Han snapped his fingers. Xiu! With a flick of his finger, the large man was instantly sent flying. Peng! The door was forcefully pushed open.
“How dare you!” The remaining seven men all drew their sabers and surrounded Ling Han and the others.
“You actually dare to behave atrociously in the residence of the Second
Imperial Prince? Are you tired of living?!”
“Who are you? Tell me your name!”

The seven of them called out one after another. Someone had sent out a signal, summoning helpers. The intruder could send one person flying with a single ’ finger. These abilities were too powerful. Even if the seven of them joined forces, they should not be a match.
‘You don’t even recognize me?’
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh. These people were really too ignorant and ill- informed.
“Woof, woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog barked, holding his stomach and laughing so hard that he was lying down.
What it meant was ‘Little Han, aren’t you boasting that you’re doing very well? Just look, even the guards at the door don’t know who you are, and you still have the nerve.’

Ling Han didn’t make a move either. With a thought, it was as if those seven large men had been grabbed by an invisible hand. They continued to wave their limbs in midair, and all of them looked terrified.
This… had they seen a ghost?

Of course not. Ling Han’s current Spiritual Power was who knew how many times stronger. He could easily lift a rock weighing a hundred to a hundred fifty thousand kilograms, what more grab seven people.
He strode into the manor, and with a wave of his Spiritual Power, the seven large men were all thrown out. They had all fainted from the impact.
This time, he was here to beat up the Second Prince. As for the others, he did not take them to heart either.
“Enemy attack!”
“Enemy attack!”
Amidst a chaotic commotion, groups of soldiers appeared, surrounding Ling Han and the others.

“Humph, Ling Han, how dare you! You even dare to barge into my manor! Do you really think that just because my Imperial Father dotes on you, you can do as you please?” The Second Imperial Prince also appeared, his expression livid.
He, a dignified Imperial Prince, actually had an enemy beating right at his doorstep. Just how humiliating was this?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and nodded, “That’s right.”
Not bad.
The Second Imperial Prince was instantly stunned. Had this brat gone mad? No matter how much you are doted on, you are still a subject, so how could you possibly step on top of your Master?
Treason! Treason!” he said balefully, his killing intent on full display.
Ling Han had delivered himself to his doorstep, so even if he killed him, Chen Fengyan wouldn’t be able to say anything.
Ling Han smiled and said, “You Imperial Princes keep targeting me just because you have someone backing you up. Do you think I don’t have a temper?”

“So what if you have a temper?” The Second Imperial Prince moved, and charged towards Ling Han, “You are a servant, and we are the masters! You are only a mortal, but we are Celestials! In our eyes, you are only an ant.”
He had already charged over in a single step, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han’s head.
Pa!
Ling Han made a move, and delivered a slap, crisp and loud.

The Second Imperial Prince was instantly sent flying back at an even faster speed than he had come. Peng! The wall behind him couldn’t block his advance at all, and a hole was instantly blasted into it. Then, he continued to fly.
Peng, peng, peng! He crashed through nine walls in one go, and only then did he stop, lying on the ground.
The Second Imperial Prince forcibly got back to his feet, his face filled with
shock, “Y-y-you have broken through to Celestial Path!”
There was only one possibility. Otherwise, no matter how awesome a Mystery Realm Tier was, that was still trash in front of a Foundation Building elite.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
Ling Han stood lazily, but his Spiritual Power took form and grabbed the Second Prince, tossing him in his direction.

In terms of absolute power, Spiritual Power definitely couldn’t compete with mystical power. Even if Ling Han’s Spiritual Power was stronger than an ordinary Foundation Building cultivator’s, it was at most 250,000kg. This was inferior to the mystical power that he had even at the Meridian Opening Tier.
The strength of Spiritual Power was invisibility, and there was no speed restriction. If it was used like brute force, that would practically be a waste.

However, the Second Imperial Prince was already severely wounded at this moment, so it was impossible for him to resist. Spiritual Power was more than enough to deal with him. Moreover, wasn’t this showing off a lot?

chapters.title: Chapter 3656 - Beating up the Imperial Princes
paragraphs: Beating up the Imperial Princes
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The hundreds of soldiers all widened their eyes in shock.
Their Second Imperial Prince was picked up from the ground out of nowhere, and then tossed back towards Ling Han, as if there was an invisible giant hand controlling him.
Because of their ignorance, they all knelt down, thinking that the Gods had appeared.
The large black dog raised his head and looked around. This was the feeling he wanted, and he was so excited that he was howling.

Just as the Second Imperial Prince was about to crash into Ling Han, his body suddenly stopped in a strange manner. He hovered in midair, his limbs drooping. He glared furiously at Ling Han, “You dare to hit me, you dare to hit me!”
Pa, Ling Han slapped the Second Imperial Prince again, a crisp slap landing on the Second Imperial Prince’s face.

However, he hadn’t used too much power this time. If he had used the same attack as before, the Second Prince would most likely have been killed. At that time, Chen Fengyan definitely wouldn’t be able to sit still.
Now, however, his uncle was teaching his grand nephew a lesson. What could Chen Fengyan say?
“I’m hitting you. Are you dissatisfied?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“Don’t be arrogant!” the Second Imperial Prince said through gritted teeth. “Even if you’ve advanced to the Celestial Path, this is still the Imperial Capital. The power left behind by my Imperial Father is completely capable of suppressing you!”
“Oh.” Ling Han nodded, and asked in reply, “Don’t you think it’s strange that when I’ve already come to blows, but why isn’t anyone stopping me?”
That’s right.

The Second Imperial Prince was slightly dazed. Previously, when they had made a move on Ling Han, hadn’t the Formation Spirit immediately appeared? And now? Had he gone out to lunch or a washroom break?
“Because I represent justice!” Ling Han said in all seriousness.
“Woof, woof, woof!” The large black dog was the first to burst into laughter. Ling Han represented justice?
This two-faced man, what a joke.
“Justice is invincible,” Ling Han continued, his tone incredibly serious.
The Second Imperial Prince faltered for a moment before almost exploding in fury.
Are you playing with me?
Justice and invincibility? Invincible your sister!
If justice was truly invincible, then who would still cultivate?
However, it was really strange. Where was the Formation Spirit, and why was there still no reaction?
Who exactly was Chen Fengyan’s son here?
Ling Han laughed loudly as he continued to pummel the Second Imperial Prince. Only when he had almost killed the latter did he stop.

He clapped a hand on the Second Imperial Prince’s shoulder, and said with a smile, “Remember this lesson. In future, you have to behave and be good. Otherwise, a righteous uncle like me will still appear and teach you a good lesson.”
The Second Imperial Prince’s face was bruised and battered, and he was already rendered speechless. There was only one question in his mind—was he really Chen Fengyan’s son?
How could he screw his son over like this?

Ling Han exited the Second Imperial Prince’s Residence and headed to the Third Imperial Prince’s manor. Meanwhile, the news of him barging into the Second Imperial Prince’s manor and coming to blows spread even faster than him.

Everyone was filled with disbelief. Firstly, Ling Han didn’t have such courage, and secondly, he didn’t have such powerful strength. Thirdly, even if he did have the courage and strength, how could Chen Fengyan not stop him?
What a joke; who would believe that?
Thus, when Ling Han arrived at the residence of the Third Imperial Prince, this place was completely unguarded.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be reserved. He charged in and forced the Third Imperial Prince out.
“You?” When the Third Imperial Prince saw Ling Han, his face was filled with shock. He could not believe that Ling Han would really dare to charge right up to his doorstep.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Third, are you surprised? Are you surprised?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3657 - Black Moon Planet
paragraphs: Black Moon Planet
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The shuttle passed through one node after another, leaving an endless distance behind it.
Even so, half a year later, the shuttle finally arrived at the Black Moon Planet.

The Black Moon Plane was a great planet Though there had never been an Ancestral King, there had been a considerable number of Saints. Thus, there were a considerable number of Holy Lands on the Black Moon Planet, such as the Holy Land of Metal Element, the Holy Land of Crimson Fire, the Holy Land of Intentionless, and so on.
However, that was all in the past. Whichever Holy Land no longer had a Saint standing guard, they had all long since died.

However, even though the Saints had died, the Saint Tools had still been left behind. It could exist for a very, very long time. Thus, these Holy Lands were still very powerful, and everyone needed to respect them.
That was because once the Saint Tool showed its might, it could even kill Venerate Tier elites.

Furthermore, there would definitely be techniques left behind by Saints in the Holy Lands. One only had to learn a little bit, and his battle prowess would be enough to overwhelm his peers, which naturally made the Holy Lands even more superior.
Peng!
The little loli steered the shuttle to land, but since she was steering it, how could she possibly land safely?
Under the violent collision, Tang Yun’er and Ling Han screamed in excitement.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. How did the adults in her family teach their children?

Tang Yun’er put away the shuttle with a regretful expression. When she saw the structure below, she thought it was some sect, but when she crashed into it, she found out that it was an abandoned place.
Ling Han released the empress and the others. In this half year’s time, none of them had been able to absorb the power of heaven and earth, so their cultivation level had practically stagnated.
From this aspect, it was really good to directly teleport through formations, saving time and effort.
Coincidentally, the sun had just risen, so it was just right for them to cultivate.
The empress and the others all sat down in cross-legged positions, absorbing the power of heaven and earth to boost their cultivation level.
Ling Han didn’t waste any time. Although the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique was no longer all that useful, it still had some effect, no matter how tiny it was. He couldn’t waste it.
He opened all the apertures in his body, extracting the power of heaven and earth.
Yi, the power of heaven and earth here was much denser.
Ling Han nodded. As expected of a great planet. The power of heaven and earth was far richer.

However, it was precisely because the power of heaven and earth was dense here that the resistance that one had to overcome in order to fly here was also greater. Probably, only one in ten Foundation Building Tiers would be able to fly on a Tool at most.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
Furthermore, the mountains and plains would also be much sturdier than Celestial Sea Planet, and would not be destroyed so easily.
Moreover, a considerable number of Saints had appeared here before, so they would definitely strengthen the planet.
The most important thing now was to get a Celestial Path-level cultivation technique, but who would easily teach such a technique?

When it came to urgency, it was definitely the large black dog, who was the most anxious. That was because he belonged to the chatterbox type. It would be uncomfortable even if he did not speak for a moment, what more when it had already been more than half a year, and he could only “woof woof woof woof”?
Thus, it definitely had to cultivate to the Blood Transformation Tier as soon as possible. That way, even if it didn’t ingest the Transformation Fruit, it wouldn’t be a problem for it to speak.
It sat on its knees like a human, its two front paws still clasped together, and added with a pair of eye-catching purple underpants, it was flamboyant to the point of speechlessness.
After everyone finished cultivating, Ling Han and the others set off. They were completely unfamiliar with the Black Moon Planet, so they had to know where the Holy Land of Metal Element was first.

Everyone was still packed into the gourd. Ling Han used the movement technique, and his speed had already broken through 20 times the speed of sound. If he used the Imminent Skyline, it would be even faster. Though this was also very exhausting on mystical power, just how deep was Ling Han’s foundation?
If it was not for the fact that his physique could not keep up, he could completely run for eight to ten years.
In less than half an hour, Ling Han entered into a small town.
He let everyone out first, and they all entered into a restaurant. On one side, they could have a snack, while on the other, they would gather some information.
It wasn’t long before Ling Han grasped some preliminary information.
This was the Shadow Demon Town, and it was named after the nearby Shadow Demon Mountain. Moreover, this place also belonged to the territory of the Holy Land of Metal Element.

However, every Holy Land had once been incredibly prosperous and powerful. Thus, the territory of the Holy Land of Metal Element was even larger than the Celestial Sea Planet. This place only belonged to the outer circle of the Holy Land of Metal Element.

The Metal Element Fruit Gathering was a distinguished gathering of the Holy Land of Metal Element, and would only open once every twenty years. Thus, even the residents of this place had no lack of understanding of this event.
How were the people on the Black Moon Planet supposed to participate in this gathering?
Simple. One only had to enter into the territory of the Holy Land of Metal Element, and pass through one test after another, and one would be qualified.
What kind of test was this?

There were nine-storey towers everywhere in the Holy Land of Metal Element, but they were divided into three levels, Black Iron, Silver and Gold. As long as one could pass through these three types of nine-storey towers, he would be qualified to go to the real Holy Land of Metal Element.

In truth, those like the Eldest Imperial Prince had only obtained the right to go to the Holy Land of Metal Element, and was not directly qualified to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
To Ling Han, as long as he passed through the three towers, he would be standing on the same level as the Eldest Imperial Prince, Hong Tianbu and the others.
Coincidentally, there was a nine-storey tower on the Shadow Demon Mountain, which was Black Iron-level.

Only by passing through the nine-storey tower of Black Iron level could one go to the nine-storey tower of Silver level, and then the nine-storey tower of Gold level. It was said that if one passed through the nine-storey tower in a short enough time, they could also receive rewards, which were basically cultivation techniques or martial arts techniques.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his heart palpitate. Although this kind of reward technique definitely wouldn’t be a high-level technique, he now had zero cultivation technique. No matter how bad it was, it was still better than zero.
Very well!
After eating, Ling Han brought everyone up the Shadow Demon Mountain.

Shadow Demon Mountain was extremely tall. The empress and Hu Niu were only slightly stronger than normal people, and after walking for a short while, they were already panting. However, they saw this as a kind of training exercise, and only when they were completely exhausted did they enter into the Essence Nurturing Gourd.
The little loli, the large black dog, and the fat pig were also slacking off, and followed them in. Only the seven toddlers accompanied Ling Han.
After more than half an hour, Ling Han arrived at the summit. He saw that there was indeed a tall black tower built at the summit. It had a total of nine floors, and there were no windows or doors.
It was very lively at the foot of the tower, with many people queuing up.
The nine-storey tower could only accommodate one person at a time.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry either. He sat at the side and waited. In any case, there were still a few months until the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.

Now that he had advanced into Celestial Path, he was finally qualified to study Celestial level formations. In the half year he had spent in the galaxy, he had not been idle either, and had been flipping through that precious book on formations.
No wonder he had never understood Celestial level formations before, because Celestial level formations required the use of a large amount of Spiritual Power.
For example, the area he was standing in nowwas very normal, but a Grandmaster Formation Master only had to step on it, and he would be able to change the terrain, forming a killing formation.
A formation formed with a single thought; that was the level of Grandmaster.

Of course, there were some heaven and earth powers that were too powerful, and even Grandmaster Formation Masters could not change them with a single thought. Then, they would still need to use formation foundations, and there were incredibly harsh requirements on the ingredients.
Ling Han did have a few One Star materials, but he had not completely grasped the formation foundations yet, and could not make them into formation foundations either. He had to plan slowly.
Multiple formation patterns churned in his mind, changing to the extreme.

The formation patterns were dead, but the power of heaven and earth was alive, so merely leaning formation patterns was useless. One had to learn how to draw inferences from one example, adapting to the situation.
The path of formations was also wide and profound. Merely formation patterns alone had innumerable changes, which was enough to exhaust a whole lifetime of energy.
However, Ling Han was different. He still had Wally, who could help him predict changes.
Just as he was engrossed in his thoughts, he heard a commotion rise up in the crowd.
“Liu Zhenglong has ascended to the eighth level!”
