Now that he had advanced into Celestial Path, he was finally qualified to study Celestial level formations.
In the half year he had spent in the galaxy, he had not been idle either, and had been flipping through that precious book on formations.
No wonder he had never understood Celestial level formations before, because Celestial level formations required the use of a large amount of Spiritual Power.
For example, the area he was standing in nowwas very normal, but a Grandmaster Formation Master only had to step on it, and he would be able to change the terrain, forming a killing formation.
A formation formed with a single thought; that was the level of Grandmaster.
Of course, there were some heaven and earth powers that were too powerful, and even Grandmaster Formation Masters could not change them with a single thought.
Then, they would still need to use formation foundations, and there were incredibly harsh requirements on the ingredients.
Ling Han did have a few One Star materials, but he had not completely grasped the formation foundations yet, and could not make them into formation foundations either.
He had to plan slowly.
Multiple formation patterns churned in his mind, changing to the extreme.
The formation patterns were dead, but the power of heaven and earth was alive, so merely leaning formation patterns was useless.
One had to learn how to draw inferences from one example, adapting to the situation.
The path of formations was also wide and profound.
Merely formation patterns alone had innumerable changes, which was enough to exhaust a whole lifetime of energy.
However, Ling Han was different.
He still had Wally, who could help him predict changes.
Just as he was engrossed in his thoughts, he heard a commotion rise up in the crowd.
“Liu Zhenglong has ascended to the eighth level!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3658 - Toppling the tower
paragraphs: Toppling the tower
Translator: Henyee Translations
Editor: Henyee Translations
As long as there was someone in the nine-storey tower, the corresponding floor would light up.
Previously, the seventh level had lit up for quite a while, and now the eighth level had finally lit up, which meant that the person inside had passed through the seventh level.
“As expected of Liu Zhenglong.”
“I wonder if he can take another step further.”
“If he can reach the ninth level, or even pass through in fact, then his aptitude would be on the level of Black Iron.”
“Although Black Iron-level qualifications does not qualify him to join a Holy Land, it’s still not difficult to enter the Core Formation Tier or even the True Self Tier-level sect.”
“This is a chance for a carp to leap over the Dragon’s Gate.?”
“I’m really envious.”
Everyone was discussing spiritedly, and many people did not hide their jealousy.
Ling Han was surprised. What was there to be envious about joining a True Self Tier or Core Formation Tier-level sect?

Oh, he soon understood. This was not the Celestial Sea Planet. The environment of cultivation here was already incredibly mature and stable, and there were nine levels in the Celestial Path. Every level was clearly defined, with strict hierarchy.
To a True Self Tier cultivator, a Core Formation Tier cultivator was nothing but trash.

Thus, for a Foundation Building Tier cultivator, being able to join a Core Formation Tier-level sect was naturally a great fortune. As long as they felt that their abilities had improved, everyone would seek out a nine-storey tower to undergo a trial.

However, if one failed the challenge after entering into the nine-storey tower, they would not be able to issue another challenge within half a year’s time. It would not cause others to become too engrossed in the matter of challenges. However, not only did this Liu Zhenglong fail to pass through the ninth level, he was not even qualified to set foot on the ninth level. Very soon, the light of the eighth level dimmed, and the doors at the bottom of the tower opened, and a disheveled man walked out.
“Unfortunately, Liu Zhenglonghas still failed.”
“Sigh, it’s already so difficult to reach Black Iron aptitude. I really can’t imagine how powerful those one-star geniuses are.”
“Haha, if you are a one-star genius, you would be qualified to join the Holy Land.”

“Actually, if you’re really a one-star genius, going to a small sect is actually better. You can get more attention. There’s a saying that it’s better to be the head of a chicken than the tail of an ox.”
“No, no, no. Even if he was an ordinary disciple in a Holy Land, he would still have more confidence than the Dao Child of a small sect.”
Everyone began talking again, each having their own opinions.
That was only a one-star genius; was it really that difficult?

Ling Han thought again. In the past, in the Imperial Capital, only the Eldest Imperial Prince and Hong Tianbu could be considered as star-level prodigies. Even Princess Bixiao had only become a one-star genius after Brother Monkey unlocked the power of her bloodline.
With such a comparison, one-star geniuses were indeed rare. It was no wonder that they could be directly taken as disciples by the Holy Lands.

At first, he had thought that the conditions set by the Holy Land of Metal Element were too low, that as long as it was a one-star genius, they would be able to go to the Holy Land. Now that he thought about it, the reason why there had been so many people at that time was completely because too many extraterrestrial visitors had come. They were basically the strongest heirs and descendants of the Sect Master-level forces, so they were naturally awesome. Though Liu Zhenglong had failed to pass the test, he had still gained the support of the masses. Being able to ascend to the eighth level of the tower was already extraordinary, and he was worth befriending.

At this moment, no one dared to challenge the tower again. After all, there was no need for those who were weaker than Liu Zhenglong to join in on the excitement. They would definitely be kicked out of the tournament. Rather than not being able to challenge the tower for the next six months, it would be better to wait until they were stronger to come back.
There was no one else?

“You guys wait here,” Ling Han said to the seven babies. As long as the little guys grew up normally, they would be able to increase their cultivation level. As early as two months ago, when they were still in the galaxy, they had all stepped onto Celestial Path.
There was no test from the heaven’s calamity. It was as if they were Foundation Building Tier cultivators in the first place, and had just cultivated back to this level.
With the strength of the seven babies, without Ling Han’s protection, they were completely fine. Instead, Ling Han was worried that they would cripple someone.

“Yes, Father,” the seven babies replied in their childish voices. Because they had advanced into Celestial Path, even Sixth Baby could control whether she revealed herself or not. Finally, she no longer had to be invisible, and was always overlooked.
Ling Han set off. He had just taken a few steps, when xiu, a figure flew down from the skies and landed at the entrance of the tower.
“Flying on a Tool!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
To fly on the Black Moon Planet, only one out of 10 Foundation Building Tier cultivators could do it. There was basically no one here that could do it, so they were naturally stunned.

That was a young man that looked to be only twenty-four or twenty-five years old, at most. He had just put away a Divine Sword, and there was a haughty expression on his face as he swept an eye over everyone, his expression filled with disdain.
“Hiss, that’s Han Qian!”
“What, Zifang Sect’s Han Qian?”
“He has always been known as a prodigy. I didn’t expect that when he had just stepped into the Foundation Building Tier, he would actually be able to fly on a tool.”
Someone recognized this person, and after he spoke up, it instantly drew a heated discussion from the masses.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He didn’t care who this person was, but he definitely couldn’t jump into his queue.
“Line up at the back!” he said in displeasure.

Han Qian was taken aback. He had just advanced into Celestial Path not too long ago, and had just learnt how to fly on a Tool, so he was very conceited. He thought that all the prodigies in the world were only so, and his self-confidence had soared to the extreme.
But now, someone actually dared to make him queue up at the back?

“Haha!” He sneered, “You really don’t know what you’re talking about! Firstly, there is absolutely no way that you can pass the test of the nine-storey tower, and secondly, what right do you have to command me?”
“Han Qian, you have gone too far.” A voice suddenly rang out.
Everyone turned to look at the person who had spoken. What was going on today? First, there was Ling Han, and now there was this person. They actually dared to challenge Han Qian?
That was a middle-aged man. He was tall and slender, and there was a large bow on his back.
“Huntsman Hu An!” someone exclaimed in shock.
When he heard this name, even Han Qian looked wary.
Hu An was a veteran Foundation Building Tier cultivator, and it was said that he had already formed the foundation of Heavenly Dao, which was far more powerful than him.
“First come, first served. This is the most basic rule. Don’t you even understand this?” Hu An asked calmly.
“Brother Hu is right.” Han Qian clenched his fists, forcefully suppressing his fury.
The cultivation world was very realistic. Whoever was stronger would have the right to speak.
He obediently retreated, and did not try to be brave.

Ling Han nodded at Hu An. In this day and age, it was already very rare to see anyone speaking up for justice. Though he could kill this Han Qian with a single punch, seeing someone step out to speak up for justice still made his heart
He strode into the tower, and the doors immediately closed.
This was a sealed off space, but it wasn’t dark. There was an unknown light source glowing, illuminating the inside.

The space was not small, and was circular in shape. Its radius was about nine meters, and its height was only about three meters. The walls around it seemed to be forged from black iron, exuding the cold light of metal.
Right in the middle of this iron room, there was a human figure that was forged from black iron, and was only five feet tall.
Weng! The black figure’s eyes suddenly lit up, and a powerful aura instantly emanated from its body.
Yi, this was actually a Foundation Building Tier metal figure. It looked a bit like the war colossus, but the war colossus was much more powerful than it.
Ling Han casually snapped his fingers. Pa! The metallic figure was sent flying, crashing into the wall and sliding down.

chapters.title: Chapter 3659 - Great Sun Lotus Technique
paragraphs: Great Sun Lotus Technique
Translator Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was slightly surprised. This was because he had only sent the metallic figure flying with a single finger. However, it hadn’t shattered.
What kind of material was it forged from? It was so powerful.
Just as he was pondering, a flight of stairs appeared out of thin air.

Alright, if this iron man could be easily destroyed, then how many people would the Holy Land of Metal Element have to expend to maintain it? It should be known that there was not just this one Black Iron Tower.
Thus, iron men should have very strong self-healing abilities.
Ling Han walked up to the second floor. Like the first floor, this was also a metallic figure.
With an outsider invading, the iron man immediately revived and launched an attack at Ling Han.
Pa! Ling Han snapped his fingers again, sending the metallic figure flying. He had defeated his opponent in one go.
He continued upwards, and arrived at the third floor. He then went on to the fourth floor, and then to the fifth floor. He had dealt with all of them with a single strike.

Outside, when they saw the Black Iron Tower light up floor after floor, everyone was stunned. This speed was too fast, wasn’t it? It was practically as if he was strolling around. He had not met his match at all.
This guy was so strong?
“Genius!”
It is possible that a Black Iron-level prodigy is about to appear.”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. In a small place like theirs, perhaps a prodigy that had passed through the nine-storey tower would appear only once every ten years or so.

Meanwhile, Han Qian smirked coldly. He too could do the same. The test of these nine levels of the Black Iron Tower was harder and harder with each level. Thus, as long as one’s abilities were strong enough, he would naturally be able to easily pass through the first eight levels.
“The fifth level!”
“He has reached the sixth level.”
“So fast, he’s reached the seventh level.”
“The eighth level!”
As for the ninth level?
In a short while, Ling Han had already arrived at the ninth level.
It was still the same black metal figure. It had just charged over, when it was knocked down with a punch from Ling Han.
Pa, a book fell from the top of his head, and landed on the ground.
Reward?
Ling Han picked up the book and looked at it. There were five words written on it: “Great Sun Lotus Technique”.
He flipped through it, and couldn’t help but look pleased. This was actually a cultivation technique.
Hehe, just what he needed. He was presently lacking a cultivation technique.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sit down and flip through the “Great Sun Lotus Technique”.
Very quickly, he had already flipped through it once, and had a basic understanding.
Unfortunately, it was not time for the sun to rise now, so he could not cultivate.
However, he was too curious, and couldn’t help but channel it. Instantly, the power of heaven and earth materialized in front of him, and he absorbed it, surging it into his body.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
Yi, why was it that this was clearly not the time for the sun to rise, yet he could still cultivate?
So slow.
Ling Han immediately thought. This speed was about the same as him absorbing the power of heaven and earth with his Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique.
With such efficiency at this time, what would it be like to cultivate in the early morning?
As expected, whether there was a suitable cultivation technique or not was too important.

This “Great Sun Lotus Technique” was very short in length, and only corresponded to the Foundation Building Tier. It lacked the parts for Cauldron Forging Tier and the levels after. However, Ling Han didn’t care. He only needed a cultivation technique for now, and in the future, he would definitely find a first-class cultivation technique,
—Since this was used as a reward, and it was only the reward for passing through the Black Iron Tower, how good could it be?
Ling Han stood up and descended to the first floor. There was a mark on his hand, and it disappeared in a flash, invisible to the naked eye.
Did this mean that he had passed through the Black Iron Tower?
This was more or less the same as the Young Dragon Trial. They both liked to leave a mark on others.
Ling Han pushed open the doors and walked out of the tower, strolling slowly.
“Has he passed?”
“Having taken so long, it’ll be tough.”

“I guess he passed. After all, he fought so quickly on the first eight levels.” “That may not be the case. Perhaps it is precisely because he had rushed ahead too quickly, and expended all his battle prowess, so it would not be strange for him not to have passed the ninth stage.”
Everyone was whispering among themselves, while Han Qian smirked coldly. Whether Ling Han had passed or not, the time he had spent was really too long He was definitely not as strong as himself.
“Brat, just watch, and I’ll let you know what a prodigy is!” He entered the Black Iron Tower.

Ling Han had obtained a cultivation technique, so he was in a good mood. How could he possibly pay any attention to him? He directly left. Since he had already passed the Black Iron Tower’s trial, he should go and find the Silver Tower next.
He went to look for the children, yet he was surprised to discover that the seven children had actually gotten along well with Hu An, chatting and laughing.
“Making new friends?” he asked with a smile.
“Father, this uncle is so interesting,” Eldest Baby said with a smile.
“My stomach hurts from laughing.” Sixth Baby clutched her stomach.
Third Baby said coldly, “Childish.”

“Little brother, my place is located at the foot of the mountain. Why don’t you come over for a visit? It’s already late, so why don’t you spend the night at my place?’ Hu An took the initiative to extend an invitation.
Ling Han also admired his righteousness, so he nodded and said, “Thank you for the trouble.”
The two of them descended the mountain with the children. When he saw how energetic the seven children were, Hu An couldn’t help but click his tongue in wonder.
Hu An had a sizable manor at the foot of the mountain, occupying an area of three to four acres. The houses were connected, with rock gardens and a small stream, appearing very serene and elegant.
“Brother Hu is truly a refined person,” Ling Han praised.
“No, no.” Hu An laughed loudly, but his expression was very pleased.

He arranged a dinner for Ling Han and the others. Because it involved the secret of the Essence Nurturing Gourd, Ling Han couldn’t possibly let the empress and the others out. It was fine. Worse come to worst, he could just pack some food for them to eat.
“Come, let’s drink!” Hu An was very cordial, and repeatedly offered Ling Han a toast.

After talking for a while, Ling Han also found out that this Hu An was originally a hunter, but by chance, he came across a fortuitous encounter, allowing him to walk on the path of martial arts. He even leaped over the Celestial Gate, and became a Foundation Building elite.

However, it was hard to change his habits. Hu An still liked to be a hunter, so he settled down in the Shadow Demon Mountain. Occasionally, he would enter the mountains to hunt. Of course, what he was hunting now were not ordinary wild beasts, but powerful Demonic Beasts that had not developed intelligence.
“Had your fill?” Hu An waved the wine pot, and commanded a servant, “Bring me some wine.”
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “More or less.”
“Have another jar of wine. Haha, let’s drink another pot of wine,” Hu An said with a smile.
Ling Han couldn’t convince him otherwise, so he nodded.
The wine was served, and Hu An filled Ling Han’s cup. He then poured a cup for himself, saying, “Come, cheers!”
Ling Han picked up the wine cup, and when he put it to his lips, he paused for a moment.
“What is it? Can’t get drunk?” Juan asked.
Ling Han shook his head, “This wine can’t be drunk.”
“Why?” Hu An was surprised.
“Poison!” Ling Han said calmly.
Hu An faltered for a moment before laughing loudly. “Brother Ling, are you trying to make me laugh?”
“I don’t have that attribute.” Ling Han shook his head.
Only then did Hu An frown. “Are you sure?”
“Positive.”
Hu An nodded, and said, “Liu Qi, come here for a while.”
Zhi, the doors opened, and a servant walked over. He bowed towards Hu An,
“Master, what is your command?”
“Do you know that this wine is poisonous?” Hu An asked calmly, but his voice was baleful and menacing.
Pa, that servant immediately knelt down, his forehead covered with cold sweat.

‘Tve treated you well, yet you’re repaying kindness with ingratitude. Humph!” With a wave of his hand, Hu An struck the top of the servant’s head. Pa! The servant instantly collapsed to the ground, no longer breathing..

It lacked the parts for Cauldron Forging Tier and the levels after.
However, Ling Han didn’t care.
He only needed a cultivation technique for now, and in the future, he would definitely find a first-class cultivation technique,
—Since this was used as a reward, and it was only the reward for passing through the Black Iron Tower, how good could it be?
Ling Han stood up and descended to the first floor.
There was a mark on his hand, and it disappeared in a flash, invisible to the naked eye.
Did this mean that he had passed through the Black Iron Tower?
This was more or less the same as the Young Dragon Trial.
They both liked to leave a mark on others.
Ling Han pushed open the doors and walked out of the tower, strolling slowly.
“Has he passed?”
“Having taken so long, it’ll be tough.”
“I guess he passed.
After all, he fought so quickly on the first eight levels.” “That may not be the case.
Perhaps it is precisely because he had rushed ahead too quickly, and expended all his battle prowess, so it would not be strange for him not to have passed the ninth stage.”
Everyone was whispering among themselves, while Han Qian smirked coldly.
Whether Ling Han had passed or not, the time he had spent was really too long He was definitely not as strong as himself.
“Brat, just watch, and I’ll let you know what a prodigy is!” He entered the Black Iron Tower.
Ling Han had obtained a cultivation technique, so he was in a good mood.
How could he possibly pay any attention to him?
He directly left.
Since he had already passed the Black Iron Tower’s trial, he should go and find the Silver Tower next.
He went to look for the children, yet he was surprised to discover that the seven children had actually gotten along well with Hu An, chatting and laughing.
“Making new friends?” he asked with a smile.
“Father, this uncle is so interesting,” Eldest Baby said with a smile.
“My stomach hurts from laughing.” Sixth Baby clutched her stomach.
Third Baby said coldly, “Childish.”
“Little brother, my place is located at the foot of the mountain.
Why don’t you come over for a visit?
It’s already late, so why don’t you spend the night at my place?’ Hu An took the initiative to extend an invitation.
Ling Han also admired his righteousness, so he nodded and said, “Thank you for the trouble.”
The two of them descended the mountain with the children.
When he saw how energetic the seven children were, Hu An couldn’t help but click his tongue in wonder.
Hu An had a sizable manor at the foot of the mountain, occupying an area of three to four acres.
The houses were connected, with rock gardens and a small stream, appearing very serene and elegant.
“Brother Hu is truly a refined person,” Ling Han praised.
“No, no.” Hu An laughed loudly, but his expression was very pleased.
He arranged a dinner for Ling Han and the others.
Because it involved the secret of the Essence Nurturing Gourd, Ling Han couldn’t possibly let the empress and the others out.
It was fine.
Worse come to worst, he could just pack some food for them to eat.
“Come, let’s drink!” Hu An was very cordial, and repeatedly offered Ling Han a toast.
After talking for a while, Ling Han also found out that this Hu An was originally a hunter, but by chance, he came across a fortuitous encounter, allowing him to walk on the path of martial arts.
He even leaped over the Celestial Gate, and became a Foundation Building elite.
However, it was hard to change his habits.
Hu An still liked to be a hunter, so he settled down in the Shadow Demon Mountain.
Occasionally, he would enter the mountains to hunt.
Of course, what he was hunting now were not ordinary wild beasts, but powerful Demonic Beasts that had not developed intelligence.
“Had your fill?” Hu An waved the wine pot, and commanded a servant, “Bring me some wine.”
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “More or less.”
“Have another jar of wine.
Haha, let’s drink another pot of wine,” Hu An said with a smile.
Ling Han couldn’t convince him otherwise, so he nodded.
The wine was served, and Hu An filled Ling Han’s cup.
He then poured a cup for himself, saying, “Come, cheers!”
Ling Han picked up the wine cup, and when he put it to his lips, he paused for a moment.
“What is it?
Can’t get drunk?” Juan asked.
Ling Han shook his head, “This wine can’t be drunk.”
“Why?” Hu An was surprised.
“Poison!” Ling Han said calmly.
Hu An faltered for a moment before laughing loudly.
“Brother Ling, are you trying to make me laugh?”
“I don’t have that attribute.” Ling Han shook his head.
Only then did Hu An frown.
“Are you sure?”
“Positive.”
Hu An nodded, and said, “Liu Qi, come here for a while.”
Zhi, the doors opened, and a servant walked over.
He bowed towards Hu An,
“Master, what is your command?”
“Do you know that this wine is poisonous?” Hu An asked calmly, but his voice was baleful and menacing.
Pa, that servant immediately knelt down, his forehead covered with cold sweat.
‘Tve treated you well, yet you’re repaying kindness with ingratitude.
Humph!” With a wave of his hand, Hu An struck the top of the servant’s head.
Pa!
The servant instantly collapsed to the ground, no longer breathing..

chapters.title: Chapter 3660 - Man-eating Demon
paragraphs: Man-eating Demon
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The matter was resolved?
Ling Han glanced at Hu An, confusion flashing through his mind.
‘Aren’t you the slightest bit curious why he poisoned you?’
“Sigh!” Hu An sighed. “These servants are all people with blood on their hands. I took them down and let them cultivate their moral character here. I didn’t expect this person to bear a grudge.”
Ling Han smiled and said, “Brother Hu is truly benevolent. I’m impressed.”
“You flatter me,” Hu An said with a shake of his head. “By the looks of it, these people still lack discipline. I’ll definitely be more strict in the future.”

After the incident with the poisoned wine, they were naturally in no mood for any more food and drink. Thus, Hu An escorted them to the guest room. “Father, do you really believe the words of that bearded uncle?” Sixth Baby asked.
Ling Han shook his head, “I don’t know.”
“Then why didn’t you expose him?” Eldest Baby also asked.
“Do we have any proof?” Ling Han said with a smile. “Furthermore, I’m only suspicious now. If it’s really as he said, wouldn’t that be awkward?”
“Oh.” The seven babies all nodded.

“If he really has malicious intentions, there will definitely be a second plan if this plan does not succeed. Just wait and see how he shows his true colours,” Ling Han said. In truth, he too did not want Hu An to be a bad person. After all, there were really too few good people in this era.

They rested, but Ling Han couldn’t sleep. He lay on the bed and studied formations. This path was really wide and profound, making him feel like he couldn’t comprehend it even if he poured his heart and soul into it.

Ling Han felt that he still hadn’t grasped the basics yet. Otherwise, even though formations were ever-changing, they wouldn’t be so difficult to grasp. At the very least, he would be able to get started.
‘Hmm? He’s here.’
Ling Han sighed. He sincerely hoped that he had only misunderstood Hu An. The latter was not the evil person he had imagined, but in truth, he was disappointed.
He saw a secret compartment open, and soundlessly, a thin pipe stretched out. It was currently spewing out smoke.

If he and the kids were already asleep, then it was extremely likely that they wouldn’t have noticed. After all, Foundation Building Tier cultivators weren’t omnipotent gods, but Ling Han was already suspicious, so how could he possibly be unguarded?
He did not attack at the first instant, but rather closed his eyes, and acted as if he had already been hit.
After a while, the doors opened, and a person walked in. He was tall and slender, and under the moonlight, he cast a long shadow.
Hu An walked in. His face was slightly flushed, as if he was under extreme excitement.
“You know how much I hope that the person who comes in isn’t you,” Ling Han suddenly said, sitting up straight.
Hu An couldn’t help but feel surprised. He immediately went into a defensive stance, but in the blink of an eye, he relaxed, and asked, “You were already on guard against me?”
“Do you think that, since I almost drank a cup of poisonous wine, I should sleep so carelessly and foolishly?” Ling Han countered with a question of his own.

“You shouldn’t,” Hu An said with a shake of his head. There was a smile on his face, and he continued, “However, I’m a little confused. Why didn’t you act out earlier? Why did you deliberately pretend that you had been affected by the medicinal effects? Why did you lure me out?”
“Because I hope that this person isn’t you,” Ling Han said calmly.
Hu An was silent for a moment, then broke into a grin, though it was incredibly malevolent. “Unfortunately, I have disappointed you!”
“Why?” Ling Han asked, “Previously, you were still speaking up for justice, and now you want to harm me. This is very contradictory.”
“Does everything have to be logical?” Hu An asked slowly.
“Give me a reasonable explanation. When I make my move, I can be more efficient and give you a quick death,” Ling Han said.

“Hahaha!” Hu An laughed loudly, “You have only built the foundation of human Dao, while I have built the foundation of Heavenly Dao. Young man, do you think that you are a god just because you have passed through the nine-storey tower?”

He had built the Heavenly Dao Foundation, and his level of being had surpassed Ling Han’s. With a single glance, he could determine that Ling Han’s cultivation level was weaker than his. Then, since he was building the foundations of Heavenly Dao, and Ling Han would only be building the foundations of human Dao.
Ling Han merely looked at him, and did not speak.

“Alright, there’s no harm in telling you.” Hu An found a chair and sat down. “I’m only standing up for you because I’m taking this opportunity to have a reasonable chance of getting close to you and those seven children.”

He paused, then continued, “Let me tell you a secret. Previously, when I was still a mortal, I had once been trapped on the snowy mountain with my companion. The strong winds could forcibly tear one’s skin. When we were trapped until the ninth day, we were really unable to bear the hunger.”
“Thus, we began fighting, both wanting to kill the other.”
“Because… that’s precious food!”
“There’s naturally no need for me to explain the outcome, right?”

“Since that time, I have been captivated by human flesh, and feel that it is the most delicious thing in the world. Even if I have advanced into Celestial Path, and merely by absorbing the power of heaven and earth, I would not starve to death or die of thirst, I still want to eat human flesh.”
“Thus, I settled down here, and when I became hungry, I went to the Shadow Demon Mountain. I always managed to bring a few idiots back.”

“Let me tell you, the meat of a cultivator is more fragrant than the meat of a mortal, and after stepping onto Celestial Path, there is another active factor in the meat. Not only does it taste better, it can also help one’s cultivation level.”
“A small part of the reason why I was able to build the foundations of Heavenly Dao so quickly is because of this.”
“Oh, that’s right. The meat of a child is more fragrant. That’s why I’ve set my eyes on you.”
After Hu An finished speaking, he looked at Ling Han, as if he was anticipating him to show an expression of fear.
—Dying in a state of intense fear, one’s muscles would have a unique smell.
But to his disappointment, Ling Han’s expression was calm, and there was not the slightest bit of fluctuation.
This had far exceeded his expectations. Ling Han’s reaction was too illogical.
Ling Han tapped his finger on the table, “You deserve to die.”
“Many people said something similar before I killed them.” Hu An shrugged, “But in the end, I ate them all.”
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and xiu, a powerful force shot towards Hu An.

“A mere Human Dao Foundation!” Juan smirked coldly. “Brat, you’ve just entered Celestial Path, and all your knowledge is still stuck at the mortal level, right? Let me tell you, even a one-star genius can only be invincible at the level of Human Dao Foundation. A two-star genius can just barely match the early stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation, a three-star genius can battle the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation.”
“And I am at the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation!”
He casually sent out a palm strike towards the gust of energy, “Could you possibly be a three-star genius?”
Of course not. If it really was a three-star geniu, the Holy Land would have long since treated him like a treasure and taken him in as a personal disciple.
Pa, the two forces collided, and Hu An’s power instantly crumbled. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s finger was still aimed at Hu An, leaving a trail of blood on his left shoulder.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
“What!” Hu An paled in shock.
Even a three-star genius could only fight him to a tie, but Ling Han actually wounded him with a single strike. What the hell was this?
Could it be… it was a four-star genius? That could be invincible even with a gap of one level!
Ling Han stood up, “Do you have any last words?”
Hu An’s eyes darted around, and he suddenly turned around and fled. A battle hammer had already appeared beneath his feet, bringing him away through the air..

chapters.title: Chapter 3661: Suppression by the cornerstone of the
paragraphs: Chapter 3661: Suppression by the cornerstone of the
Celestial Path
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Unfortunately, since Ling Han was already targeting him, how could he still escape?

Peng! Ling Han threw a punch, and with a burst of power, he quickly caught up to Hu An and sent him flying. The battle hammer smashed into the distance, breaking through several walls and creating a loud sound.
Hu An paled in shock. This was something he hadn’t expected. He couldn’t even escape?

“We can talk things over peacefully.” He suddenly smiled apologetically. The speed of his change was unexpected, but he suddenly retreated rapidly, a longbow appearing in his hands. He drew the bow, nocked an arrow and shot.
Xiu, the arrow shot over at an incredibly fast speed.
With a thought from Ling Han, the Starlight Screen appeared, and the arrow crashed into it. However, it immediately broke, and plummeted.
He was completely unconcerned as he bore down on Hu An.

Hu An gritted his teeth, shooting arrows as he retreated. Xiu, xiu, xiu! He was known as a huntsman, and his archery skills were truly extraordinary. One after another, arrows shot out at tricky angles and extremely fast speeds.
However, for Ling Han, this was completely wasted effort.
Ling Han only had to activate the Starlight Screen, and all of Hu An’s efforts would be wasted.
He approached with large strides. It looked like his steps were calm, but he was rapidly closing the distance between the two of them.

Hu An was terrified. He killed people like they were nothing, and devoured their flesh and blood. However, it was also because of this that he was especially afraid of death. He feared that he would suffer the same fate.

He gritted his teeth, and a stone that was less than the size of a soybean immediately appeared on his forehead. However, it immediately enlarged, and instantly became the size of a human head. It was as if it was forged from bronze, and an indescribable brilliance surged, exuding an indescribable intimidation.
This was the cornerstone of his Heavenly Dao.

Why was the Heavenly Dao Foundation stronger than the Human Dao Foundation? Aside from power, it was the cornerstone of Heavenly Dao, which had an intrinsic crushing effect on the cornerstone of Human Dao.
This was just like how a mortal’s aura would become extremely weak when they saw a high-ranking official.

Of course, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was too precious. Unless absolutely necessary, no one would use it. What if it was shattered? That would be equivalent to having their cultivation level of Foundation Building reduced, and they would have to start back from the beginning again.
Now that he was going all out, he naturally wouldn’t care about this.
“Brat, in the end, you are only a Human Dao Foundation. Kneel!” Hu An shouted loudly.
Boom, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path exuded a powerful might, enough to make 90% of Human Dao Foundation cultivators go weak in the knees, losing their battle prowess.

This wasn’t something that couldn’t be resisted, but it required a cultivator of Human Dao Foundation to expend a lot of effort to resist it. If one used their power on defense, how much power would they still have left when they attacked?
There were nine levels in the Celestial Path, and not only was there a massive suppression between major tiers, it was the same even for minor levels.
Suppression on a fundamental level assaulted him, but Ling Han didn’t need to resist at all. His foundation of the Celestial Path was as steady as a boulder, and he was completely unmoved.
It should be known that this was built in imitation of the Stone Celestial Gate, so how could it be ordinary?
Hu An’s face was filled with disbelief. How was this possible? He had already summoned the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, so why was he still unable to suppress Ling Han?
Could it be that… the other party was also a Heavenly Dao Foundation cultivator, or even an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator in fact?
That was impossible. He could clearly sense that Ling Han’s Celestial Dao aura was inferior to his.
“Suppress! Suppress!” Hu An shouted loudly. He pushed the foundation stone of the Celestial Path towards Ling Han.
With a thought from Ling Han, he summoned his own cornerstone of the Celestial Path.

He knew that the cornerstone of the Celestial Path that he had built was very awesome, but he did not know exactly how awesome it was. Previously, he had not dared to use it recklessly against the Second Imperial Prince and the others, so he could use this Hu An to test it out.

Though there was already more than half a year since he had built the foundations of the Celestial Path, he had only really cultivated for a little over a month. Thus, it was still only the size of his pinky, and could not compare to Hu An’s foundations of the Celestial Path.
However, even though it was small, there was an ancient, primitive aura circulating around it. The Intent Realm was extremely far-reaching.

Hu An stimulated the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to attack, wanting to get closer so that he could overwhelm Ling Han. However, after taking a few steps, he discovered that his cornerstone of the Celestial Path was actually trembling.
How was this possible?
The foundation stones of the Celestial Path did not have life, so why would they tremble?
Moreover, why was it trembling? He was a Heavenly Dao Foundation, and his level of being was above Ling Han’s. If anyone was trembling, it should be Ling Han.
He could feel that his foundation stone of the Celestial Path was afraid, fearful, and did not dare to advance another step further.
He was unwilling to give up, and gritted his teeth as he continued to advance.
Ka, ka, ka, ka! A terrifying scene appeared. Cracks actually appeared on Hu An’s celestial foundation stone, instantly covering the entire foundation stone.

“How could that be!” Hu An was about to collapse. This was the foundation stone of the Celestial Path shattering on its own. It was as if he had forced a loyal subject to assassinate the monarch. That loyal subject would rather shatter than commit blasphemy against the monarch.

He had never heard of it before! A high-level foundation stone of the Celestial Path would suppress a low-level one, and even if they were suppressed, it was impossible that they would shatter on their own.
Peng, Hu An’s foundation of the Celestial Path crumbled.
Hu An was despondent. His cornerstone of the Celestial Path had shattered, and his cultivation level had instantly been severed and he had declined into mortality.
“Trash like you should not exist in this world,” Ling Han stated calmly. He delivered a palm strike, and Destructive Energy surged, enshrouding Hu An.
He had not thought that his foundation stone of the Celestial Path would actually be so awesome, and the reason for it must be that he had imitated the Stone Celestial Gate.
No wonder heaven and earth didn’t tolerate it. Its might was too terrifying; how could other Foundation Building cultivators live?

“Don’t kill me. I can tell you a huge secret,” Hu An shouted. However, the Destructive Energy had already reached him. Although he tried his best to resist, it was useless. He was soon annihilated and dissipated.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned. What great secret would this kind of man-eating demon know?
He returned to his room and entered the Essence Nurturing Gourd, where he truly rested.
Early the next morning, Ling Han and the others all came out of the gourd, cultivating under the morning sun.
Boom! The power of heaven and earth surged over.
Ling Han immediately discovered that compared to Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, the difference was like heaven and earth.

It couldn’t be helped. The Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique only corresponded to the mortal level, and if he switched to cultivating the Great Sun Lotus Technique when he had been in the mortal level, it was guaranteed that the effects wouldn’t be as good as the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique.
In his mind, the dao foundation of Human Dao had slightly enlarged.
The process of Human Dao Foundation was to continuously strengthen the foundation of Human Dao to the extreme. The stronger the foundation of Human Dao was, the stronger the cultivator would be.

In truth, if there really was no Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path could also replace it. However, there was a great risk, because once a crack appeared in the foundation stone, it would need to be repaired at a great cost, and if it shattered, one would be severed from the Foundation Building Tier.
Hence, unless it was absolutely necessary, no one would use the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to smash others. At most, they would only use it as a threat.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂

“My Celestial Dao foundation can also become a secret weapon.” Ling Han broke into a grin, especially now that he had only formed the foundation of Human Dao. His opponents who had Heavenly Dao Foundation and Ultimate Dao Foundation would definitely want to use the foundations of Celestial Dao to suppress him.
If that was really the case… hehe, then the other party would have gone out for wool and come back shorn.
“Little Han, you’re wearing a strange smile. You’re definitely planning to screw someone over again!” the large black dog immediately shouted..

Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, and with a burst of power, he quickly caught up to Hu An and sent him flying.
The battle hammer smashed into the distance, breaking through several walls and creating a loud sound.
Hu An paled in shock.
This was something he hadn’t expected.
He couldn’t even escape?
“We can talk things over peacefully.” He suddenly smiled apologetically.
The speed of his change was unexpected, but he suddenly retreated rapidly, a longbow appearing in his hands.
He drew the bow, nocked an arrow and shot.
Xiu, the arrow shot over at an incredibly fast speed.
With a thought from Ling Han, the Starlight Screen appeared, and the arrow crashed into it.
However, it immediately broke, and plummeted.
He was completely unconcerned as he bore down on Hu An.
Hu An gritted his teeth, shooting arrows as he retreated.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
He was known as a huntsman, and his archery skills were truly extraordinary.
One after another, arrows shot out at tricky angles and extremely fast speeds.
However, for Ling Han, this was completely wasted effort.
Ling Han only had to activate the Starlight Screen, and all of Hu An’s efforts would be wasted.
He approached with large strides.
It looked like his steps were calm, but he was rapidly closing the distance between the two of them.
Hu An was terrified.
He killed people like they were nothing, and devoured their flesh and blood.
However, it was also because of this that he was especially afraid of death.
He feared that he would suffer the same fate.
He gritted his teeth, and a stone that was less than the size of a soybean immediately appeared on his forehead.
However, it immediately enlarged, and instantly became the size of a human head.
It was as if it was forged from bronze, and an indescribable brilliance surged, exuding an indescribable intimidation.
This was the cornerstone of his Heavenly Dao.
Why was the Heavenly Dao Foundation stronger than the Human Dao Foundation?
Aside from power, it was the cornerstone of Heavenly Dao, which had an intrinsic crushing effect on the cornerstone of Human Dao.
This was just like how a mortal’s aura would become extremely weak when they saw a high-ranking official.
Of course, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was too precious.
Unless absolutely necessary, no one would use it.
What if it was shattered?
That would be equivalent to having their cultivation level of Foundation Building reduced, and they would have to start back from the beginning again.
Now that he was going all out, he naturally wouldn’t care about this.
“Brat, in the end, you are only a Human Dao Foundation.
Kneel!” Hu An shouted loudly.
Boom, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path exuded a powerful might, enough to make 90% of Human Dao Foundation cultivators go weak in the knees, losing their battle prowess.
This wasn’t something that couldn’t be resisted, but it required a cultivator of Human Dao Foundation to expend a lot of effort to resist it.
If one used their power on defense, how much power would they still have left when they attacked?
There were nine levels in the Celestial Path, and not only was there a massive suppression between major tiers, it was the same even for minor levels.
Suppression on a fundamental level assaulted him, but Ling Han didn’t need to resist at all.
His foundation of the Celestial Path was as steady as a boulder, and he was completely unmoved.
It should be known that this was built in imitation of the Stone Celestial Gate, so how could it be ordinary?
Hu An’s face was filled with disbelief.
How was this possible?
He had already summoned the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, so why was he still unable to suppress Ling Han?
Could it be that… the other party was also a Heavenly Dao Foundation cultivator, or even an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator in fact?
That was impossible.
He could clearly sense that Ling Han’s Celestial Dao aura was inferior to his.
“Suppress!
Suppress!” Hu An shouted loudly.
He pushed the foundation stone of the Celestial Path towards Ling Han.
With a thought from Ling Han, he summoned his own cornerstone of the Celestial Path.
He knew that the cornerstone of the Celestial Path that he had built was very awesome, but he did not know exactly how awesome it was.
Previously, he had not dared to use it recklessly against the Second Imperial Prince and the others, so he could use this Hu An to test it out.
Though there was already more than half a year since he had built the foundations of the Celestial Path, he had only really cultivated for a little over a month.
Thus, it was still only the size of his pinky, and could not compare to Hu An’s foundations of the Celestial Path.
However, even though it was small, there was an ancient, primitive aura circulating around it.
The Intent Realm was extremely far-reaching.
Hu An stimulated the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to attack, wanting to get closer so that he could overwhelm Ling Han.
However, after taking a few steps, he discovered that his cornerstone of the Celestial Path was actually trembling.
How was this possible?
The foundation stones of the Celestial Path did not have life, so why would they tremble?
Moreover, why was it trembling?
He was a Heavenly Dao Foundation, and his level of being was above Ling Han’s.
If anyone was trembling, it should be Ling Han.
He could feel that his foundation stone of the Celestial Path was afraid, fearful, and did not dare to advance another step further.
He was unwilling to give up, and gritted his teeth as he continued to advance.
Ka, ka, ka, ka!
A terrifying scene appeared.
Cracks actually appeared on Hu An’s celestial foundation stone, instantly covering the entire foundation stone.
“How could that be!” Hu An was about to collapse.
This was the foundation stone of the Celestial Path shattering on its own.
It was as if he had forced a loyal subject to assassinate the monarch.
That loyal subject would rather shatter than commit blasphemy against the monarch.
He had never heard of it before!
A high-level foundation stone of the Celestial Path would suppress a low-level one, and even if they were suppressed, it was impossible that they would shatter on their own.
Peng, Hu An’s foundation of the Celestial Path crumbled.
Hu An was despondent.
His cornerstone of the Celestial Path had shattered, and his cultivation level had instantly been severed and he had declined into mortality.
“Trash like you should not exist in this world,” Ling Han stated calmly.
He delivered a palm strike, and Destructive Energy surged, enshrouding Hu An.
He had not thought that his foundation stone of the Celestial Path would actually be so awesome, and the reason for it must be that he had imitated the Stone Celestial Gate.
No wonder heaven and earth didn’t tolerate it.
Its might was too terrifying; how could other Foundation Building cultivators live?
“Don’t kill me.
I can tell you a huge secret,” Hu An shouted.
However, the Destructive Energy had already reached him.
Although he tried his best to resist, it was useless.
He was soon annihilated and dissipated.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
What great secret would this kind of man-eating demon know?
He returned to his room and entered the Essence Nurturing Gourd, where he truly rested.
Early the next morning, Ling Han and the others all came out of the gourd, cultivating under the morning sun.
Boom!
The power of heaven and earth surged over.
Ling Han immediately discovered that compared to Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, the difference was like heaven and earth.
It couldn’t be helped.

The Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique only corresponded to the mortal level, and if he switched to cultivating the Great Sun Lotus Technique when he had been in the mortal level, it was guaranteed that the effects wouldn’t be as good as the Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique.
In his mind, the dao foundation of Human Dao had slightly enlarged.
The process of Human Dao Foundation was to continuously strengthen the foundation of Human Dao to the extreme.
The stronger the foundation of Human Dao was, the stronger the cultivator would be.
In truth, if there really was no Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, the foundation stone of the Celestial Path could also replace it.

However, there was a great risk, because once a crack appeared in the foundation stone, it would need to be repaired at a great cost, and if it shattered, one would be severed from the Foundation Building Tier.
Hence, unless it was absolutely necessary, no one would use the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to smash others.
At most, they would only use it as a threat.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
“My Celestial Dao foundation can also become a secret weapon.” Ling Han broke into a grin, especially now that he had only formed the foundation of Human Dao.
His opponents who had Heavenly Dao Foundation and Ultimate Dao Foundation would definitely want to use the foundations of Celestial Dao to suppress him.
If that was really the case… hehe, then the other party would have gone out for wool and come back shorn.
“Little Han, you’re wearing a strange smile.
You’re definitely planning to screw someone over again!” the large black dog immediately shouted..

chapters.title: Chapter 3662: Alchemy Apprentice Test
paragraphs: Chapter 3662: Alchemy Apprentice Test
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Cultivate well, don’t talk so much.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively.

Half an hour later, everyone had finished cultivating. The empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog had all improved astonishingly. They were also cultivating Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique. When Ling Han went to the Monkey Valley for the second time, he had already asked Brother Monkey if he could teach this cultivation technique to his family and friends.
Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, supplementary cultivation technique, added with alchemical pills… In just a few days, they had already reached Twelve Meridians.
He was sure that in a few days, they would be able to reach 20 Meridians.
Ling Han had absolute confidence in their natural talent. Which of those who could become Heavenly Venerates in the Genesis World wasn’t a supreme prodigy?
Everyone set out, heading towards White Night City.
The White Night City was the closest city to here. There was a nine-storey tower of Silver Grade there, and it was a stage that Ling Han definitely had to pass.
A day and a half later, they arrived at their destination.
Ling Han found a place to stay first, and then went to find out the whereabouts of the nine-storey tower.

This was naturally not difficult to find. Ling Han arrived very quickly, and saw that this was indeed a completely silvery white nine-storey tower, slightly taller than the Black Iron Tower. Even in the pitch-black night, it was still glowing, and was incredibly eye-catching.
There were benefits to it being night, as there weren’t many people here. Ling Han didn’t need to queue up and directly walked in.
In the first level, the originally black metallic figure had become silver in colour. The moment Ling Han entered, the silver metallic figure immediately revived and launched an attack at him.
En, they were stronger than even those on the ninth level of the Black Iron Tower.
However, compared to Ling Han, this was still insufficient. With a light flick of his finger, the silver metallic figure was sent flying.
He ascended to the second level, and almost immediately left. He charged up to the third level again.

In less than a minute, he had already passed the nine-storey tower, and most of that time, he was actually spending on climbing the tower. The true time of battle added together would only take nine seconds, at most.
Pa, another book fell from the skies, landing in front of Ling Han.
He picked it up and looked at it. There were three words written on it: “Celestial Crossing Finger.”
Ling Han roughly looked over it. This was a finger technique, and it was very powerful. Of course, it was completely incomparable to the Demonic Monkey Fists and the Three Styles of the God of War.
There was no harm in having more techniques. In any case, it wasn’t very difficult to learn. Ling Han planned to practice it when he had the time.
He was leaving.
He returned to the inn. There was still enough time for him to have a good sleep.

Early in the morning, Ling Han finished cultivating and wasn’t in a hurry to leave. The Shadow Demon Town was a small place, so he couldn’t gather much information. However, this place was different—it was a large city.
Ling Han decided to stay here for a few days. In any case, there was still a lot of time, so there was no need to rush.

Regarding this decision, the empress, Hu Niu, and the others also gladly agreed. The two women brought the little loli and the seven toddlers to go shopping. The large black dog also left. He was also a restless guy, and it was fine as long as he did not get killed and cooked.
Wally was still the best, doing his best to help Ling Han deduce formation patterns.
Ling Han also left. He was going to find a place where alchemists would gather, something along the lines of the Alchemist Society.

Because there was a lapse in the cultivation of the Celestial Sea Planet, that included alchemy, and there were pitifully few pill recipes for the mortal level, and there was only one that remained for the level after ascending into the Celestial Path.
That was the Cold Resistance Pill. After ingesting it, one would be able to resist the invasion of the cold air, but it was only limited to the level of Foundation Building Tier.

With Ling Han’s natural talent in alchemy, he had naturally mastered it long ago. In fact, because he had won a bet against those extraterrestrial visitors, he didn’t lack main ingredients, but supplementary ingredients were lacking, so he didn’t start refining.
Not long after, Ling Han found the Alchemy Alliance.

This was an organization similar to the Alchemist Society. Of course, this was only a branch of the alliance, but no matter where it was, alchemists had a unique status. The Alchemist Alliance here occupied a very large territory, and the entire structure was also built in a grand and majestic manner.

Ling Han strode in. He was just about to find someone to ask how he was going to be certified as a Celestial Path alchemist, but he had not even opened his mouth, when he was directly brought to a room. There were actually a great many people inside, and they were all sitting upright.
What was going on here?
“What are you standing around for? Find a place to sit down quickly. The alchemy apprentice test is about to begin,” that person said, and even gave Ling Han a push.
Yi, a test for alchemy apprentices? Oh, he had been misunderstood, and the other party was really too enthusiastic, not even asking him first.

Ling Han faltered, and was just about to turn around and leave, but when he recalled that he was still short of three supplementary ingredients, if he could become an alchemy apprentice, would it be easier to obtain them?
Then let’s just try the test. He too wanted to test out his abilities.
Ling Han walked in and found a place to sit down.

As expected, the exam soon began. A middle-aged man appeared. He distributed a piece of jade to everyone, “The first test is about identifying medicinal ingredients through looking at the diagram. All of you stick the jade on your foreheads. You have one minute to identify each medicinal ingredient.” Ling Han picked up the jade. It was very thin, and its weight was also very light. He pressed it against his forehead as instructed. Instantly, a medicinal herb appeared out of thin air in front of him.
Yi?
Ling Han stretched out his hand to touch it. There was actually the sense of touch, but he could not pick it up.
This was obviously virtual, but it had a very strong deception effect on divine sense. That was why it could be seen, touched, but could not be picked up.
Interesting.
Ling Han sighed with emotion before writing the words “Savage Sand Demonic Grass” on the piece of white paper.
Test his basic knowledge?

Hehe, he had long since begun to study this field, all right? This was the foundation of alchemy. If one did not even know how to recognize herbs, how could he speak of alchemy? As a Grandmaster Alchemist, Ling Han knew this fact.
A minute later, the first herb disappeared, and in its place, there was a red fruit.
“Gen Origin Fruit,” Ling Han wrote another three words.
Another minute later, the red fruit turned into a tall tree.
Ling Han practically didn’t think at all. The moment he saw it, he could write. Ten minutes later, no more medicinal ingredients appeared.
“Don’t forget to write your names on the paper, then leave and wait for the results,” the examiner said.
Everyone stood up and left the room.
They were not idle either, and began to compare their answers.
“Ah, the second question is actually the Gen Origin Fruit? I wrote the Sang Origin Fruit!” a fatso wailed.

“It is indeed very confusing. The Gen Origin Fruit looks very similar to the Sang Origin Fruit, but the Gen Origin Fruit has three very hidden golden threads, but the Sang Origin Fruit does not,” a young man said.
“Aiyo, that’s right!” The fatty pounded his head and stamped his feet, appearing extremely vexed.
“As expected of Second Young Master Sun, too insightful in recognizing herbs,” someone beside him praised.
“The Eldest Young Master of the Sun Clan is a prodigy of martial arts, whereas the Second Young Master has shown his talent in alchemy, and the clan has geniuses of two different fields!”
“This time, the title of Alchemy Apprentice of the Second Young Master is definitely assured.”

Faced with everyone’s praise, that Second Young Master Sun appeared to be very pleased, but still pretended to be modest. Waving his hand, he said, “No, no, you all are flattering me! This time, they are only recruiting three apprentices. There are many talented people here, and I may not be able to pass.”
“Hehe, Sun Shaolong, you do have some self-awareness,” a green-robed man scoffed..

chapters.title: Chapter 3663: Bias
paragraphs: Chapter 3663: Bias
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

Second Young Master Sun was called Sun Shaolong. He glanced at the green-robed man, and couldn’t help but frown. He asked in displeasure, “Tan Bing, I didn’t offend you, so why are you going against me?”
I don’t like the look of you; I don’t have any ulterior motives,” the green-robed man, Tan Bing, said.
All right, all right.” A woman in purple stepped out to play mediator, “We are all from the White Night City, and we will see each other frequently. Just think of it as giving face to me, Zhuo Die.”
Sun Shaolong humphed, and said, “All right. For the sake of Sister Zhuo, I will not argue with him.”
“You speak as if I fear you.” Tan Bing was similarly proud.
“The two of you, speak less.” Zhuo Die lowered her hand.

Sun Shaolong, Tan Bing, Zhuo Die. They are members of the Ten Great Clans of White Night City, and also possess astonishing natural talent in alchemy. They are only taking in three alchemy disciples this time round. Looks like we are all here just as company for their test.”
“F***, if I had known that the three of them had come, I would not have joined in on the excitement.”
Forget it. Since I’m already here, I’ll just treat it as practice.”
Everyone shook their heads. The moment Sun Shaolong and the others appeared, they instantly lost all hope.
Not long after, the examiner came out and announced the candidates that had passed this stage.

“Sun Shaolong, Yang Xuan, Liu Shuang, Tan Bing, Zhuo Die… Ling Han.” Because Ling Han was the last to enter, he was naturally the last name to be read out. “Those who have been called, follow me, and begin the second test.” The others left helplessly. They hadn’t even passed the first test, so staying would only be embarrassing.

The remaining people entered into another room. It was also very big, but because there were more than half of them missing, it appeared very spacious. “This stage is test of recognizing pharmacology. Write down the medicinal characteristics and taboos that you have seen,” the examiner said.
Everyone was still given a piece of jade, then with a command from the examiner, it was placed on their foreheads. Instantly, an image unfolded. Yi, the difficulty level had increased.
Previously, the medicinal ingredients had been fully displayed, but now, the display was a medicinal ingredient that had been processed. It was a medicinal ingredient that had been dried.
However, this naturally was not a problem for him.
Lmg Han quickly wrote down the medicinal ingredients’ name, unique traits, and careful use of the medicine. In just half a minute, he had already finished writing.
A minute later, another set of ingredients appeared.
This time, it was a dried fruit.
After the fruit was dried, it would naturally deform and shrivel, causing a great many features that were originally very obvious to disappear.
Yet Ling Han was very relaxed, and practically did not have the sligthest bit of hesitation. His pen moved skilfully.
The third piece, the fourth piece, the fifth piece. Very soon, his blank piece of paper was filled with words.
Ten minutes soon arrived, and the examiner announced the end. Everyone wrote their names on a piece of paper, then left.

When they arrived outside, everyone began to discuss the answers again, but this time, it was obviously much more difficult. There were a few questions that everyone argued back and forth, all of them thinking that their judgement was correct, arguing so much that their faces were flushed red.
Meanwhile, the three High Level alchemy apprentices who were grading the answers also began a fierce debate.

The two of you, this matter is a little difficult to deal with!” Deng Yingwei said. He pointed at the four answer scripts on the table, “Combined with the results of the two rounds, these four people are the most outstanding, especially this person called Ling Han. He has gotten 100% correct on both tests.”

However, the recruitment of only three apprentices this time has long since been decided. Furthermore, Tan Bing, Zhuo Die and Sun Shaolong are definitely going to be enrolled, so how could there be any spots left?”

Ye Wenbin also frowned deeply, “If the results of the four of them were more or less the same, then we would be able to find some excuse to dismiss this Ling Han, but the crux of the matter is that his results have left the rest behind in the dust.”

“Yes, Zhuo Die and the others all made a mistake in the first round, and in the second round, they all made two mistakes. In total, they made a total of three mistakes, which can’t compare to Ling Han at all.”
Song Tao shook his head, “Then what do we do, among Zhuo Die’s group of three, we take one of them off the list?”
“Do you dare?” Deng Yingwei countered.
I wouldn’t dare!” Song Tao sighed. He was only a High Level alchemy apprentice. In front of the ten great clans in the city, he was not even worth a feather. How could he dare to say no?
Moreover, this was something that was already previously agreed on. If he went back on his word… the consequences would be unimaginable.
Then I can only apologize to this little friend Ling Han,” Deng Yingwei said with a smile.
Ye Wenbin nodded, and said, “In any case, he has the skill, so it’s the same the next time he comes.”
“Who asked him to be so unlucky that he just happened to encounter Zhuo Die and the others this time?” Song Tao also laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3664: Don’t regret it!
paragraphs: Chapter 3664: Don’t regret it!
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Though this smell roughly corresponded to the 13 medicinal ingredients, there were still some differences between these 13 smells after a closer look.
Perhaps others would not be able to distinguish it, but this was not a problem for Ling Han, the Alchemy Emperor.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and said, “This is the horn of a horned-tiger, ground into dust.”
Ye Wenbin was taken aback. F***, that’s right.
Had he guessed correctly, or… had he really managed to distinguish it?
If it was the former, then it could only be said that Ling Han’s luck was really good, but if it was the latter, this brat’s ability to recognize herbs was too terrifying.
However, whether it was the former or the latter, neither of them could allow Ling Han to pass the test.
“Wrong, this is High Firmament Grass.” Ye Wenbin shook his head.

Ling Han couldn’t help but fly into a rage. ‘It’s fine if you’re deliberately making things difficult for me, but I clearly answered correctly, yet you’re deliberately saying that I’m wrong. This is going too far.’
“You dare to trick me?” he asked balefully.
Ye Wenbin was given a fright. He felt as if this person in front of him had transformed into an emperor, his authority boundless, causing a chill to rise up from the bottom of his heart.

However, he immediately flew into a rage out of humiliation. He was a High Level alchemy disciple. If he feared a minor character that could not even be considered an alchemy disciple, what face would he have left?
“If you’re wrong, you’re wrong. Why are you spouting so much nonsense?” he said harshly.
Ling Han looked coldly at Ye Wenbin, and after a long while, he finally said, “Think carefully before you speak. Am I right or wrong?”
“Are you threatening me?” Ye Wenbin shouted angrily.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Whatever you think.”
“Humph, a mistake is a mistake. Even if you have a powerful background, we will not bend the rules for personal gain,” Song Tao slammed a hand on the table, and shouted loudly.
Ling Han looked at Ye Wenbin, Song Tao and Deng Yingwei, and asked, “You all think so?”
“What is the meaning of this? Are you going to threaten the three of us together?” Song Tao shouted loudly.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face, “Don’t regret it.”
“Ling Han, are you a sore loser?” Tan Bing interrupted.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, turned and left, “Since none of you will regret it, just wait and see.”
Ye Wenbin and the others all looked coldly at Ling Han. They naturally would not be concerned about the threat of a minor character.

At first, Ling Han had not planned to take the alchemy disciple test. He was aiming to be certified as an alchemist, so he naturally would not take the title of an alchemy disciple to heart. However, being bullied like this, he could not swallow this anger.
So I am an easy target to bully?
Ling Han walked out of his room and arrived at the main hall. He asked others about the details of the alchemist test.
The test for alchemists was simple. They only needed to concoct alchemical pills on the spot.
However, Celestial pills needed Celestial medicines. If they failed, the price would be huge. If one did not have full confidence, who would come here to burn money?
Thus, the majority would start from Alchemy Apprentice.
—After becoming an Alchemy Apprentice, there would be a chance every year to obtain the ingredients for free, and take the alchemist test.
Looks like this sum of money could not be saved.
Ling Han walked around and bought three sets of ingredients. These were the three supplementary ingredients for concocting the Cold Resistance Pill, and they were what he lacked.

Thankfully, the Cold Resistance Pill was Foundation Building Tier-level in the first place. The main ingredients had to be Celestial medicine, but supplementary ingredients didn’t need to be so precious. Mortal-level was adequate.
Thus, Ling Han used jade seeds to purchase the three supplementary ingredients. Anyways, he wouldn’t have Dao Stones to pay for them.
He found an alchemy apprentice, and requested to take the alchemist test.
It wasn’t long before three alchemists arrived as witnesses.
“What pill will you concoct?” an alchemist asked.
“Cold Resistance Pill.”
“En, a One Star Celestial pill, which conforms to the rules.” The second alchemist nodded, “Little Zhang, record it down.”
“Understood,” an alchemy apprentice hurriedly replied, writing furiously.
“You, begin,” the first alchemist, Alchemist Ma, said to Ling Han.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
There were many alchemy chambers in the Alchemy Alliance, and there were various kinds of formations set up to correspond to alchemical pills of different attributes.
Ling Han chose an alchemy chamber, and began concocting.

He didn’t need the help of alchemy apprentices. He would grind the ingredients into dust on the spot, and then toss the medicinal ingredients into the formation one after another. The amount was controlled very precisely.
Seeing Ling Han’s proficient movements, the three alchemists all smiled.

This was not a person who had come to waste their time. Furthermore, there was something unique about Ling Han’s technique, which caused them to have an idea that they could learn from, and benefit greatly from it.

The Celestial level alchemical pill took a longer time to concoct, and in such a long period of time, one would have to concentrate, and there could not be the slightest bit of break. Otherwise, no matter which step they took wrongly, all their previous efforts would be wasted.
This required the support of a powerful Spiritual Power. Thus, it was absolutely impossible for mortals to concoct Celestial pills. Their Spiritual Power was not enough at all.

The concoction time of this Cold Resistance Pill was about three hours. At first, no one paid attention, but after an hour, when they found out that Ling Han was still concocting, it instantly attracted a considerable number of people to go and watch.

And after two hours, more and more people came here. The majority were alchemy apprentices. They did not need to observe the concoction of high grade alchemical pills. Instead, it was the lowest grade Celestial pill concoction that was most beneficial to them.
“Song Tao, Deng Yingwei, what are you guys still doing here? There’s someone here to take the alchemist test, and he’s about to succeed.”
Song Tao and the others were talking to Tan Bing and the others. These newly advanced alchemy disciples were naturally worth celebrating, but a person suddenly stuck his head in and said to them.
“Yi, then we should go and take a look.” Song Tao hurriedly nodded.

“Quick, quick, quick.” Ye Wenbin hurriedly followed him out. “It takes a few years for an alchemy apprentice to be promoted to alchemist. Taking this step is really difficult. Observing an alchemy apprentice successfully advance to become an alchemist is not only very enlightening for us, but is also a great encouragement.”
“May I know which High Level Apprentice it is?” Deng Yingwei also said, “Could it be Gu Ming? Or Zhong Luo?”
“Neither. A person that I have never seen before, and is not an alchemy disciple either, has directly begun the alchemist examination,” the alchemy disciple that had come to call others said.
“It’s that powerful?”
They all ran out to take a look, and even Tan Bing and the others were no exception.
When they arrived outside the alchemy chamber, they could see that there was already a large crowd of people here. They could not squeeze to the front to look at the observation window at all.

—Of course, one could not be disturbed when concocting alchemical pills. Thus, aside from Ling Han, there were only three alchemists who were bearing witness and one alchemist apprentice who was keeping records. The others could only watch from the outside.
“I can’t see anything,” Deng Yingwei complained.
“That’s right. There’s people all around.” Song Tao nodded as well.

They wanted to squeeze forward, but the people in front of them could not possibly give way, so they could only call out helplessly. They wanted to leave, but they were unwilling to do so, and very much wanted to see this person who was presently undergoing the test.
If they knew that the person inside was Ling Han, they would probably want to turn around and run as far as they could.
Three hours later, Ling Han was done.
He stretched out a hand to grab it, and three alchemical pills that were spinning around appeared in his hand. They were all as red as fire.
“Please appraise.” Ling Han spread out his hands.
The three alchemists who were bearing witness all stepped forward to appraise.
“The three completed pills are all High Grade.”
“Three completed pills, two High Grade ones, and one is close to High Grade.”
“The three completed pills are all High Grade.”
The three alchemists called out respectively, while the alchemy apprentice wrote down the evaluation of the three alchemists.
“With our unanimous conclusion, passed!”

Of course, these three alchemists were witnesses. If it was discovered that Ling Han wasn’t equipped with the skill of an alchemist, then the three of them would also be held responsible.

“Congratulations!” The three alchemists congratulated Ling Han. “Let’s discuss
more often in the future.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
The three alchemists were all very polite towards Ling Han. This man was really young, and his future prospects were boundless.
“Congratulations!”
“Congratulations, Alchemist Ling!”

The alchemy disciples outside also spoke one after another. An alchemy disciple to an alchemist was like a Mystery Realm Tier to a Foundation Building Tier. The gap was like the gap between heaven and earth, so they had no choice but to treat him with respect. Even those old alchemy disciples whose hair had already turned white were no exception, and they bowed.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢

Meanwhile, Ling Han said to an alchemist, “I’ve been learning from a blind alchemist since childhood, so I actually don’t know anything about alchemy at all. I wonder if Brother can explain it to me?”
“No problem.” That person was also looking for a chance to befriend Ling Han, so he naturally agreed immediately, “Come, let’s go somewhere else to talk.”

Yi?

Was there something wrong with you?
He clearly possessed the strength of an alchemist, yet he actually went to take the alchemy disciple test. This was practically baffling.

place.”
He had revealed everything!
When Tan Bing and the others heard this, they naturally did not run.
Otherwise, wouldn’t that be a solid proof of their crime?
“Yi?” “Ah?” “Ya?”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, all of them feeling extreme disbelief.
Who could help me figure out why Ling Han would take the alchemy apprentice test on the same day, and then the alchemist test? They were on two completely different levels, all right?
What kind of person was this!

In any case, I don’t need to spend too much time.”
“In the end, these three people were so awe-inspiring and domineering, forcibly dismissing me from the test.”
After saying this, he looked at Deng Yingwei and the others, causing them to break out in a cold sweat.

When everyone heard Ling Han’s explanation, they all gave an “oh”. Though Ling Han’s move was a little roundabout, it was indeed reasonable when they thought about it. A person that had not yet advanced to become an alchemist, what savings could he possibly have?

Ling Han could become an alchemist, so how could it be that he couldn’t pass the alchemy apprentice test?
‘You people must have teamed up to cheat!

Song Tao.

■’I’m slightly inferior to you, so I answered three wrong questions.” Everyone discussed spiritedly. What else could he say?

Though this could not be considered evidence for the third round, it also showed Ling Han’s ability in recognizing herbs, and added with the fact that he had already become an alchemist, it was enough to prove that Ling Han’s ability in recognizing herbs had surpassed the standards of an alchemy apprentice.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were filled with disdain as they looked at Ye Wenbin and the others. Some were even rejoicing in their misfortune.
The three of them actually dared to trick an alchemist-they were dead for sure!

‘Til report this to the Grandmasters and convict you!” the thick-browed alchemist said calmly. As for Tan Bing and the others, he didn’t even glance at them. Although they hadn’t cheated, Ling Han had exposed such a huge conspiracy, so they naturally would be punished accordingly.
“No! No!” Ye Wenbin and the others all knelt down.
“Grandmaster Ling, we were wrong. Please spare us!” Song Tao kowtowed to Ling Han.
Deng Yingwei and Ye Wenbin were also enlightened, and hurriedly kowtowed to Ling Han as well. The person who had tied the knot still had to be the one to undo the knot.
Ling Han was unmoved, and merely said calmly, “I have warned you before, don’t regret it in future, and now you are begging for mercy? It is too late!”
With a wave of his hand, he strode off.

“Humph, you’ve brought this upon yourself!” The thick-browed alchemist humphed coldly. As an alchemist himself, he was naturally on Ling Han’s side. A mere alchemy disciple actually dared to offend his superior; they truly deserved to die.

Ling Han didn’t need to worry about the subsequent matters. Ye Wenbin, Song Tao, and Deng Yingwei were all stripped of their status as alchemy disciples, and would never be recruited again. Meanwhile, Tan Bing, Zhuo Die, and Sun Shaolong were also stripped of their status as alchemy disciples because they had participated in the cheating. Moreover, they were banned from taking the alchemy disciple test for another three years.
This was greatly satisfying..
