chapters.title: Chapter 3666: You still dare to come?
paragraphs: Chapter 3666: You still dare to come?
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations

Alchemists above Celestial Path and above were categorized in this manner – the three major tiers of Heaven, Earth and Human, and Earth Tier and Human Tier alchemists were further categorized into high, medium and low grade alchemists, but Heaven Tier alchemists were Heaven Tier alchemists, with no categorization of grade.
Thus, Ling Han was now a low grade Human Tier alchemist.

After being newly promoted to become an alchemist, Ling Han could choose a pill recipe of the corresponding level from the Alchemy Alliance’s pill recipe library. If he wanted to obtain more pill recipes, he would have to contribute to the Alchemy Alliance,𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
Ling Han’s purpose for certifying as an alchemist was to obtain the recipe for the pill. He resolutely chose the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill.
If he ingested one, it would be equivalent to several years of hard cultivation. It was what Ling Han needed now.

He looked at the pill recipe. The main ingredient was Foxwood, which was a One Star Celestial medicine. It had to be at least fifty years old, and the more mature it was, the better the effects of the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill would be.
Additionally, he also needed 34 supplementary ingredients, all of which were Mystery Realm Tier-level, so it was not difficult to obtain.
Ling Han soon familiarized himself with the pill recipe. However, Foxwood was not common, and he could not buy it even if he had the money, so he could only set it aside for now.

He sold the three Cold Resistance Pills to the Alchemy Alliance in exchange for three Dao Stones. At the same time, he also had some contribution points. Once he had accumulated enough, he would be able to trade for new pill recipes in the Alchemy Alliance.
After he was done with these matters, it was already evening. Ling Han hurriedly returned to the inn.
On the way, he also bought a geographical record. He wanted to study the Black Moon Planet in detail.
The empress and the others had already returned. They first had dinner then rested.
Ling Han flipped through his geographical record, and gained a basic understanding of the Black Moon Planet.
“In the Holy Land of Crimson Fire, there is a valley of flames. The flames burn brightly, and even Saints would not dare to enter.”
“It’s said that it was originally an ordinary valley, but at some unknown time a great fire was poured from the sky. From then onwards, it burned fiercely and has never stopped.”
“Even Saints have to be wary of it. The possibility of it being the Heavenly Dao Flames is extremely high.”

There are still more than three months until the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, so I’ll first pass through the nine-storey tower and obtain a spot. Then, I’ll make a trip to the Flame Valley and forge the Origin Gold.” “I’m an elite of the Foundation Building Tier, so isn’t it too demeaning of me not to know how to fly on a tool?”
Ling Han finally came to a decision. He would first forge the Origin Gold, and then head to the Holy Land of Metal Element.
The next morning, everyone woke up to cultivate.

Ling Han didn’t join the others. He was a Foundation Building Tier. Once he cultivated, the power of heaven and earth in the surroundings would all be absorbed by him. To say nothing of mortals, even other Foundation Building Tiers would cry from being robbed by him.
Thus, he ran to a farther location to cultivate.
Half an hour later, Ling Han returned to the inn.
Yi?
He was taken aback, because there were actually a great many strangers outside the inn. All of them had expressions of arrogance, but none of them were Celestial Path-level.
Ling Han walked over, but was stopped by those people, “Get lost, go to another place!”
What was going on?
Ling Han casually waved his hand. Pa! Those people instantly collapsed to the ground. How could they possibly stop him?
He strode in, killing intent rising up in his heart. If these people were targeting the empress and the others, he would definitely start a massacre.
“… And your face is covered. What is it? Shameful?” A woman’s voice rang out.
Ling Han immediately recognized that it was Zhuo Die.
She had come to seek revenge.

Ling Han nodded internally. Zhuo Die’s status as an alchemy disciple had been Stripped, so she must be internally displeased. However, Ling Han had not foreseen that his status as an alchemist would not be able to scare her.
Logically speaking, alchemists should have outstanding status, right?
Moreover, this matter had been started by Zhuo Die and the others in the first place, and Ling Han was also a victim.

Ling Han walked into the main hall, and saw that there were a great many people who looked to be servants here. AU of them had fierce expressions, and were dressed in the same tight fitting suit of grey. Only three people were an exception.
Tan Bing, Zhuo Die, Sun Shaolong.
As it turned out, it was not just Zhuo Die. The other two had also come.

They surrounded the empress, Hu Niu, and the babies. However, the empress and the others didn’t take these people seriously at all. They were eating breakfast, and all of them had quite a good appetite. They didn’t seem to be affected at all.
“Looks like the lesson you guys have learnt is still not enough!” Ling Han spoke up, his voice cold.
These people actually dared to extend their claws towards the people by his side; they truly deserved to die!

“Ha, I thought you had fled in fright, and actually dared to come back?” Tan Bing humphed, “It is all because of you, that we have to waste three years’ time! Do you think that just because you are an alchemist, we would not dare to touch you?”
“You’re nothing but a low level Human Grade alchemist. Even if we beat you up would the Alchemy Alliance dare to come to our place and cause trouble?” Sun ’ Shaolong continued.
They belonged to the ten great clans in the city, and they all had a grand elder of the Cauldron Forging Tier standing guard. This was the basis for their arrogance.
“What do you guys want?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“I’ll beat you up first, then make you kneel in front of us to repent!” Tan Bing said.???6
“Don’t worry, we will definitely exert our full effort, and make it so that you will never forget it!” Sun Shaolong also said.
Yet Zhuo Die’s expression was dark, as she said, “And castrate him! Doesn’t this guy have two women? Make it so he can only look at them in future, and cannot touch them!”
Hiss, this woman was so poisonous!
“That’s right!” Tan Bing and Sun Shaolong were stunned for a moment, then both nodded.
Ling Han asked them what they wanted to do, and that was an eye for an eye.
Whatever you guys want to do to me, I will return it to you.

“You’re the one who’s planted the seeds, so you’re the one who’s going to swallow the fruits!” he said calmly. Xiu! He charged forward, unleashing the Imminent Skyline and instantly appearing before Sun Shaolong.

After advancing into Celestial Path, Ling Han was already able to completely grasp this movement technique. It was no longer a matter of crossing 50km with a single stride, but rather a matter of extreme speed.
Sun Shaolong felt his vision blur, and there was already another person in front of him.
As a cultivator, his reaction speed was not slow. Immediately, with a shake of his hands, he delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
However, he was nowhere near as quick as Ling Han.
Pa, Ling Han took out the broken piece of the tombstone, and smashed it onto the top of the other’s head.
Sun Shaolong instantly collapsed to the ground. Fortunately, he was a
Foundation Building Tier cultivator. Otherwise, this smack would have been enough to obliterate his head.

However, he wouldn’t be much better off either. His forehead was bulging, and there was a large bump on his forehead. In the future, he would also be plagued by misfortune, and he would have to suffer.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and looked towards Tan Bing.

Tan Bing couldn’t help but take a step back, a chill in his heart. However he had just taken a step back, when he discovered that Ling Han was already standing where he had been. The stone slab in his hand was raised, and struck down heavily on him.
“Ah!” He released a short scream, and instantly, followed in Sun Shaolong’s
footsteps, he too collapsed onto the ground.
There was only one left.
Zhuo Die paled in shock, and hurriedly screamed, “What are you all standing around for? Go, go!”
Those servants hurriedly drew their weapons and rushed over, but how easy was it for Ling Han to deal with them?

Weng, he released the barrage of murderous aura. Pa, pa, pa, pa! Instantly, these people fell all over the ground, and all of them rolled thier eyes, as if’they had lost consciousness from a massive shock..

They belonged to the ten great clans in the city, and they all had a grand elder of the Cauldron Forging Tier standing guard.
This was the basis for their arrogance.
“What do you guys want?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“I’ll beat you up first, then make you kneel in front of us to repent!” Tan Bing said.???6
“Don’t worry, we will definitely exert our full effort, and make it so that you will never forget it!” Sun Shaolong also said.
Yet Zhuo Die’s expression was dark, as she said, “And castrate him!
Doesn’t this guy have two women?
Make it so he can only look at them in future, and cannot touch them!”
Hiss, this woman was so poisonous!
“That’s right!” Tan Bing and Sun Shaolong were stunned for a moment, then both nodded.
Ling Han asked them what they wanted to do, and that was an eye for an eye.
Whatever you guys want to do to me, I will return it to you.
“You’re the one who’s planted the seeds, so you’re the one who’s going to swallow the fruits!” he said calmly.
Xiu!
He charged forward, unleashing the Imminent Skyline and instantly appearing before Sun Shaolong.
After advancing into Celestial Path, Ling Han was already able to completely grasp this movement technique.
It was no longer a matter of crossing 50km with a single stride, but rather a matter of extreme speed.
Sun Shaolong felt his vision blur, and there was already another person in front of him.
As a cultivator, his reaction speed was not slow.
Immediately, with a shake of his hands, he delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
However, he was nowhere near as quick as Ling Han.
Pa, Ling Han took out the broken piece of the tombstone, and smashed it onto the top of the other’s head.
Sun Shaolong instantly collapsed to the ground.
Fortunately, he was a
Foundation Building Tier cultivator.
Otherwise, this smack would have been enough to obliterate his head.
However, he wouldn’t be much better off either.
His forehead was bulging, and there was a large bump on his forehead.
In the future, he would also be plagued by misfortune, and he would have to suffer.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and looked towards Tan Bing.
Tan Bing couldn’t help but take a step back, a chill in his heart.
However he had just taken a step back, when he discovered that Ling Han was already standing where he had been.
The stone slab in his hand was raised, and struck down heavily on him.
“Ah!” He released a short scream, and instantly, followed in Sun Shaolong’s
footsteps, he too collapsed onto the ground.
There was only one left.
Zhuo Die paled in shock, and hurriedly screamed, “What are you all standing around for?
Go, go!”
Those servants hurriedly drew their weapons and rushed over, but how easy was it for Ling Han to deal with them?
Weng, he released the barrage of murderous aura.
Pa, pa, pa, pa!
Instantly, these people fell all over the ground, and all of them rolled thier eyes, as if’they had lost consciousness from a massive shock..

chapters.title: Chapter 3667: A world where the strong prey on the weak
paragraphs: Chapter 3667: A world where the strong prey on the weak
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Zhuo Die couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
A boundless fear rose up in her. Just how terrifying was this person in front of her?

He was able to knock over a Foundation Building cultivator with a single strike. It was unknown what kind of technique he had used, but all the servants of mortal level fell to the ground, especially the latter. This was too terrifying. What Foundation Building cultivator could be so strong?
At first, she had thought that with after joining forces with the other two, wouldn’t defeating an alchemist be as easy as waving a hand?
Who didn’t know that alchemists were only slightly more powerful in terms of Spiritual Power? However, alchemists were much weaker in terms of battle prowess.
But now?
That was not the case at all. Not only was Ling Han’s battle prowess not weak, it was shockingly strong.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
What kind of monster had she encountered?
Ling Han smiled and said, “A woman’s heart is the most poisonous. Sure enough, it’s true.”
“What do you want?” Zhuo Die forced herself to calm down, and shouted lowly at Ling Han.

“Don’t worry. With how ugly you are, no one would have any designs on you,” Ling Han said calmly. Then, he turned around and said to the empress and the others, “Men can be castrated, but how can women be castrated?”
The empress was proud, and merely made a gesture of decapitation.
Meanwhile, Hu Niu bit her finger as she started to think. Meanwhile, the large black dog jumped over and continued to wave its paws, barking loudly.
No one could understand the barking of a dog, but Ling Han understood what it meant.
“You said, disfigure her?”
The large black dog nodded repeatedly.
“But she’s already so ugly, so disfigurement doesn’t mean much.” Ling Han was troubled.
Zhuo Die was furious. What part of her was ugly?
Though she could not be considered an exquisite beauty, she could still be considered a beauty, and had absolutely nothing to do with the word ‘ugly’.

However, this was not the main point. She was really afraid that Ling Han would disfigure her, and she was quietly retreating. As long as she could escape from here, she would immediately ask for help from the ancestor of her clan. To actually dare trifle with the Zhuo Clan, you were seeking your own death.
“You can’t escape!” Ling Han struck out with the stone slab. Pa, Zhuo Die instantly fell to the ground.
Towards those who wanted to harm him, there was naturally no need for him to be reserved. Ling Han castrated both Tan Bing and Sun Shaolong.
The large black dog jumped over, and ravaged Zhuo Die’s face. Then, it barked at Ling Han, indicating that it was done.
Ling Han looked at Zhuo Die’s disheveled face, and shook his head. This would definitely leave behind irrecoverable wounds.
So be it. She would remember this lesson forever.
“Let’s go.”
They exited the inn and left the White Night City, heading towards the Flowing Sand City.
Compared to the White Night City, the Flowing Sand City was a large city. There were elites of Core Formation Tier, and there was also a golden nine-storey tower here.
As long as he could pass through the golden nine-storey tower, he would be able to obtain a ticket to the Metal Element Fruit Gathering… a second grade ticket.
Four days later, they arrived at the Flowing Sand City.
On the way, the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog had all reached 20 Meridians, and had also cleared all their meridians. Next, it was time to break through to the Blood Transformation Tier.
Ling Han had enough Treasured Fruits of Life. After finding an inn in the Flowing Sand City, the two people and one dog began to break through. Ling Han stood guard for them.
Half a day later, they advanced into the Blood Transformation Tier one after another.
Though this could not be considered an elite, it was stronger than any ordinary person. Furthermore, their lifespan had also increased greatly.

With Ling Han protecting them, the empress and the others’ path was naturally much easier than Ling Han’s. They had a cultivation technique prepared for them, and there was no need to worry about the Treasured Fruit of Life. They only had to focus on cultivating.

Only then did Ling Han go to the nine-storey tower. After obtaining this qualification, he would go to the Flame Valley and first forge the Origin Gold into the model of a Monarch Tool. Otherwise, why would he keep a precious piece of Origin Gold in storage?
He had come alone. In any case, it was just a trip, so there was no need for him to invite the empress and the others.
The golden nine-storey tower was really forged from gold. From the outside, it was a blindingly bright gold in colour.
Because it was daytime, there were some people here.
However, there were not many people that were qualified to challenge the golden nine-storey tower. The majority were only here to join in on the excitement.
Right now, it was clear that someone was attempting to pass this trial. The seventh level was lit up.
However, Ling Han had just arrived, when he saw the seventh level darken, while the eighth level lit up.
“It’s the eighth level!”
“There are only two stages left.”
“As expected of Han Qian. He’s going to soar into the sky this time.”
“Being able to pass through the golden nine-storey tower would be comparable to a one-star genius.”
“He can be taken as a disciple by the Holy Land.”

Everyone felt rueful. Most of the people here had passed through the Silver Tower, but had failed at the Golden Tower. After tempering their battle prowess for several years, they were still unable to pass.
In comparison, Han Qian had just advanced into Celestial Path not too long ago, yet already had hopes of clearing the golden nine-storey tower. This was really something to be envious of.
In a short while, the eighth level of the tower darkened, and the ninth level lit up.
Yi, that was Han Qian?
When Ling Han went to the nine-storey tower of Black Iron to train, he encountered Han Qian, and was almost cut off from the queue by him.
Now that Han Qian had entered into the golden nine-storey tower, it meant that this guy had already passed through the two nine-storey towers of Black Iron and Silver.
Now that Ling Han couldn’t enter, he could only wait.
“The ninth level is still lit.”
“They’re still fighting fiercely.”
“It’s already been fifteen minutes.”
“He’s truly powerful. Being able to battle for so long is already enough to prove his strength.”
“Yi, it’s dark!”
“Passed, or… failed?”
“Let’s just wait and see.”
In a short while, the golden tower opened, and a person walked out.
Han Qian.
His face was bright, and he looked very pleased with himself.
Obviously, he must have successfully passed through the nine-storey tower. Otherwise, if he was still so happy, he must be out of his mind.
Those around them all offered their congratulations, though it was unknown how many of them were sincere.
Han Qian was smug. As he walked, he nodded at the people around him. After taking a few steps, he suddenly stopped, and stared at a person in front of him. It was actually Ling Han!

He naturally remembered Ling Han. At that time, he had still wanted to show off his might to Ling Han after passing through the Black Iron Tower. Who would have thought that after he came out, there was no sign of Ling Han at all?
He must have been afraid.
He was a little proud, but also a little displeased. Ling Han actually dared to ignore him; this was a show of contempt towards him.
He had never thought that he would actually meet Ling Han here again.
“What a coincidence!” he said with a smile.
Ling Han ignored him completely. What time did he have to waste with this kind of trash? He strode forwards, heading towards the golden tower.
“Impudence! I’m talking to you!” Han Qian roared in rage.
“Oh no, this brat actually dared to offend Han Qian!”
“He’s a prodigy of the Zifang Sect, and his future achievements are limitless.”
“Brat, hurry up and beg Young Master Han for mercy. Perhaps he can spare you.”

Everyone was also discussing spiritedly, and some were making suggestions to Ling Han. No one was optimistic about him. After all, Han Qian had already proven his strength and talent, and there was a powerful Zifang Sect behind him.
Hearing everyone’s discussions, Han Qian’s anger subsided instead. He looked proudly at Ling Han, and said, “Kneel down and beg for your life, and I can spare your life!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh. “I think that I didn’t offend you, yet you want to kill me. What kind of logic is that?”
“Because I am stronger than you, because this is a world where the strong prey on the weak!” Han Qian humphed, and declared loudly..

chapters.title: Chapter 3668: Accidentally killed
paragraphs: Chapter 3668: Accidentally killed
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Just because you’re powerful, you can do as you please?”
-Of course!” Han Qian smirked coldly, “So, if you want to blame someone, blame your own bad luck for not becoming an elite!
“I understand.” Ling Han nodded.
“Then why aren’t you kneeling!” Han Qian was getting a little impatient.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Kneel down and beg me. If I’m in a good mood, perhaps I can spare your life.”
-Ha? Hahahaha!” Han Qian faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly.
What a joke; someone actually dared to make him kneel down and beg for his life?
Do you think you are the Dao Child of a great sect?
“Ignorance!” Han Qian strode towards Ling Han, “Since you are so stubborn, I
will send you on your way!”
“He’s done for!”

“Sigh, why did he have to oppose Han Qian head-on? He is the most outstanding disciple of the younger generation of the Zifang Sect. Being able to pass through the golden tower is enough to prove that he is a one-star genius, or has battle prowess that could match a one-star genius.
-He asked for it. He had already been given a chance, but he didn’t seize it.”
-Does this brat think he’s still learning skills in his own sect? That fellow disciples would still have mercy on account that they are from the same sect.”
“Serves him right!”
The people around them all shook their heads. Not one of them sympathized with Ling Han.
-This world was too realistic. If you did not have the ability, you would have to bow your head. Otherwise, don’t complain about encountering obstacles everywhere.
Han Qian approached Ling Han, but what surprised him was that Ling Han actually did not flee. He was just standing where he was and waiting for him.
Oh, this brat knew that there was no way to dodge, so he simply knelt down and accepted his fate.
“At least you have some self-awareness!” he said, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and with a wave of his hand, delivered a slap back at Han
Qian.
Han Qian was almost about to explode in fury. ‘You actually want to slap me? By the looks of it, you’re not resigned to your fate at all. Instead, you’re determined to fight me to the death.
But an instant later, he paled in shock.
Ling Han’s palm strike was too fast, and it just happened to pass through his defenses, leaving him with nowhere to dodge or block.

Pa he had not even finished this thought, when he had already sustained a heavy slap. A massive force surged out, and he instantly collapsed onto the ground. He felt a weng, weng, weng sound ring out in his ears, and he had almost passed out.
There was dead silence.
What was going on here? Why was it that Han Qian couldn’t even withstand a single slap from Ling Han, and directly collapsed onto the ground?
What kind of prodigy are you?
Han Qian forced himself to get back to his feet. He shook his head, trying his best to clear his mind.
His face was flushed red. No matter what the reason was, he had been knocked over with a single slap. He did not have the slightest excuse.
A cold light flashed, and a long sword appeared in his hand, covered densely with veined patterns.
“Die!” he roared, brandishing his sword in a slash.

This was a Spirit Tool. As the sword slashed out, the blade of the sword glowed, and a gorgeous Sword Qi was slashed out. Upon a closer look, thrs Sword Qi was actually formed from seals, which slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han threw a punch at the Sword Qi.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
What was astonishing was that the moment this Sword Qi collided, the masses of seals actually exploded, forming a terrifying shockwave.
Interesting.

Ling Han smiled faintly. No wonder Han Qian was so arrogant. He did indeed have some abilities, and was not just arrogant. However, this kind of strength was completely insufficient in front of him. The gap was too wide.
With a thought, the Starlight Screen appeared, and the shockwaves that assaulted him instantly disappeared completely.
“Take a finger from me as well!” Ling Han used the Celestial Crossing Finger.
Xiu, a burst of energy shot out, rapidly shooting towards Han Qian.
Han Gan parried the attack, easily blocking it.
“I was only careless just now!” He recovered his confidence, and struck repeatedly with his sword. Multiple seals turned into Sword Qi and shot out, forming a great explosion.
Could I do the same?
Ling Han thought internally. The reason why he had not defeated Han Qian with a single punch was because he had the intention to test it out.
He continued to point his finger, and xiu, xiu, xiu, qi swept out unhindered. After more than a hundred attacks, another burst of energy shot out, but there was the light of seals flickering.
Success!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. When he extended a finger again, several more seals appeared in the air, which shot towards Han Qian.
Peng! Han Qian tried to block the attack, yet he detonated the seal, causing a huge explosion.

Han Qian, on the other hand, did not think that Ling Han was secretly learning from him This kind of offensive method with additional seals was very common, and belonged to the category of “fundamental”. It was absolutely impossible for him to imagine that Ling Han was capable of “contending” with him, yet did not even know the basics.

How could he know that Ling Han was simply a lone cultivator? After advancing into Celestial Path, there was no one to guide him on how he shoul cultivate. He was completely relying on his own exploration.
“Within ten moves, I will send you to the Underworld!” His confidence was increasing.
Ling Han smiled, and shot out another finger. It was still the Celestial Crossing Finger, but this time, the power of the finger was completely formed from seals.
This was terrifying. Han Qian brandished his sword to disperse the attack, yet it caused a great explosion, which instantly sent him flying.

Ling Han nodded. To be frank, these seals were the cultivator’s comprehension of the power of heaven and earth. However, they were manifested directly through seals, and at the same time, they were more condensed, forming an explosion.
In this way, the attack power was naturally even stronger. After a series of successes, Ling Han threw another punch. The seals condensed into a golden fist that smashed towards Han Qian.
This wasn’t as simple as seals. It also contained theEnergy of Metal.

With how powerful Ling Han was, he was completely capable of crushing Han Qian. Han Qian could not withstand this blow, and his defenses were forcefully shattered by the force of the punch. At this moment, the seals exploded. Peng, peng, peng, endless energy exploded on Han Qian’s body, and blood and flesh flew everywhere.
When the power of the punch surged out, a terrifying scene appeared. A hole had shockingly appeared in Han Qian’s chest. It was as big as a foot, penetrating from front to back.

Even Ling Han was given a fright. He could indeed kill Han Qian with a single punch but when he had shot out his fist just now, he had not intended to kill the latter. He only wanted to test out the effects of the combination of seals and high-level energy.
Unexpectedly, the destructive power of this blow had exceeded his expectations, and directly blasted a hole into Han Qian’s body.

A Celestial Path elite’s aura was very enduring. Even if all his internal organs were gone, Han Qian did not die on the spot. He lowered his head for a look, his face filled with disbelief. He was so powerful, so how could he possibly not be able to withstand even a single move from Ling Han?
He was so outstanding, and had a bright future ahead of him. How could he die here?
He looked at Ling Han, regret flashing through his eyes. If he had known that this person was so powerful, he should not have trifled with him.
What enmity did they have? What enmity did they have against each other?
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Peng!

Han Qian collapsed to the ground. If he were a True Self Tier cultivator, he wouldn’t have died even after sustaining such severe wounds. Worse come to worst, he could simply switch to another body and start all over again. Now, however, his only fate was to be engulfed by death.
He was dead.
There was complete silence, and no one could speak.
Han Qian was dead.
The prodigy of the Zifang Sect had died.
How was Ling Han so powerful? He was unfathomably powerful! He had killed Han Qian with a simple and ordinary punch!

Quite a number of people were shaking their heads internally. Who asked Han Qian to be so arrogant? He had not planned to pay any attention to him at all, but he was determined to approach himself. And now, great, he had lost his own life.
He deserved it..

The people around them all shook their heads.
Not one of them sympathized with Ling Han.
-This world was too realistic.
If you did not have the ability, you would have to bow your head.
Otherwise, don’t complain about encountering obstacles everywhere.
Han Qian approached Ling Han, but what surprised him was that Ling Han actually did not flee.
He was just standing where he was and waiting for him.
Oh, this brat knew that there was no way to dodge, so he simply knelt down and accepted his fate.
“At least you have some self-awareness!” he said, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and with a wave of his hand, delivered a slap back at Han
Qian.
Han Qian was almost about to explode in fury. ‘You actually want to slap me?
By the looks of it, you’re not resigned to your fate at all.
Instead, you’re determined to fight me to the death.
But an instant later, he paled in shock.
Ling Han’s palm strike was too fast, and it just happened to pass through his defenses, leaving him with nowhere to dodge or block.
Pa he had not even finished this thought, when he had already sustained a heavy slap.
A massive force surged out, and he instantly collapsed onto the ground.
He felt a weng, weng, weng sound ring out in his ears, and he had almost passed out.
There was dead silence.
What was going on here?
Why was it that Han Qian couldn’t even withstand a single slap from Ling Han, and directly collapsed onto the ground?
What kind of prodigy are you?
Han Qian forced himself to get back to his feet.
He shook his head, trying his best to clear his mind.
His face was flushed red.
No matter what the reason was, he had been knocked over with a single slap.
He did not have the slightest excuse.
A cold light flashed, and a long sword appeared in his hand, covered densely with veined patterns.
“Die!” he roared, brandishing his sword in a slash.
This was a Spirit Tool.
As the sword slashed out, the blade of the sword glowed, and a gorgeous Sword Qi was slashed out.
Upon a closer look, thrs Sword Qi was actually formed from seals, which slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han threw a punch at the Sword Qi.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
What was astonishing was that the moment this Sword Qi collided, the masses of seals actually exploded, forming a terrifying shockwave.
Interesting.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
No wonder Han Qian was so arrogant.
He did indeed have some abilities, and was not just arrogant.
However, this kind of strength was completely insufficient in front of him.
The gap was too wide.
With a thought, the Starlight Screen appeared, and the shockwaves that assaulted him instantly disappeared completely.
“Take a finger from me as well!” Ling Han used the Celestial Crossing Finger.
Xiu, a burst of energy shot out, rapidly shooting towards Han Qian.
Han Gan parried the attack, easily blocking it.
“I was only careless just now!” He recovered his confidence, and struck repeatedly with his sword.
Multiple seals turned into Sword Qi and shot out, forming a great explosion.
Could I do the same?
Ling Han thought internally.
The reason why he had not defeated Han Qian with a single punch was because he had the intention to test it out.
He continued to point his finger, and xiu, xiu, xiu, qi swept out unhindered.
After more than a hundred attacks, another burst of energy shot out, but there was the light of seals flickering.
Success!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
When he extended a finger again, several more seals appeared in the air, which shot towards Han Qian.
Peng!
Han Qian tried to block the attack, yet he detonated the seal, causing a huge explosion.

Han Qian, on the other hand, did not think that Ling Han was secretly learning from him This kind of offensive method with additional seals was very common, and belonged to the category of “fundamental”.
It was absolutely impossible for him to imagine that Ling Han was capable of “contending” with him, yet did not even know the basics.
How could he know that Ling Han was simply a lone cultivator?
After advancing into Celestial Path, there was no one to guide him on how he shoul cultivate.
He was completely relying on his own exploration.
“Within ten moves, I will send you to the Underworld!” His confidence was increasing.
Ling Han smiled, and shot out another finger.
It was still the Celestial Crossing Finger, but this time, the power of the finger was completely formed from seals.
This was terrifying.
Han Qian brandished his sword to disperse the attack, yet it caused a great explosion, which instantly sent him flying.
Ling Han nodded.
To be frank, these seals were the cultivator’s comprehension of the power of heaven and earth.
However, they were manifested directly through seals, and at the same time, they were more condensed, forming an explosion.
In this way, the attack power was naturally even stronger.
After a series of successes, Ling Han threw another punch.
The seals condensed into a golden fist that smashed towards Han Qian.
This wasn’t as simple as seals.
It also contained theEnergy of Metal.
With how powerful Ling Han was, he was completely capable of crushing Han Qian.
Han Qian could not withstand this blow, and his defenses were forcefully shattered by the force of the punch.
At this moment, the seals exploded.
Peng, peng, peng, endless energy exploded on Han Qian’s body, and blood and flesh flew everywhere.
When the power of the punch surged out, a terrifying scene appeared.
A hole had shockingly appeared in Han Qian’s chest.
It was as big as a foot, penetrating from front to back.
Even Ling Han was given a fright.
He could indeed kill Han Qian with a single punch but when he had shot out his fist just now, he had not intended to kill the latter.
He only wanted to test out the effects of the combination of seals and high-level energy.
Unexpectedly, the destructive power of this blow had exceeded his expectations, and directly blasted a hole into Han Qian’s body.
A Celestial Path elite’s aura was very enduring.
Even if all his internal organs were gone, Han Qian did not die on the spot.
He lowered his head for a look, his face filled with disbelief.
He was so powerful, so how could he possibly not be able to withstand even a single move from Ling Han?
He was so outstanding, and had a bright future ahead of him.
How could he die here?
He looked at Ling Han, regret flashing through his eyes.
If he had known that this person was so powerful, he should not have trifled with him.
What enmity did they have?
What enmity did they have against each other?
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Peng!
Han Qian collapsed to the ground.
If he were a True Self Tier cultivator, he wouldn’t have died even after sustaining such severe wounds.
Worse come to worst, he could simply switch to another body and start all over again.
Now, however, his only fate was to be engulfed by death.
He was dead.
There was complete silence, and no one could speak.
Han Qian was dead.
The prodigy of the Zifang Sect had died.
How was Ling Han so powerful?
He was unfathomably powerful!
He had killed Han Qian with a simple and ordinary punch!
Quite a number of people were shaking their heads internally.
Who asked Han Qian to be so arrogant?
He had not planned to pay any attention to him at all, but he was determined to approach himself.
And now, great, he had lost his own life.
He deserved it..

chapters.title: Chapter 3669: Flaming Canyon
paragraphs: Chapter 3669: Flaming Canyon
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han shrugged. He had no plans to kill Han Qian, or rather, he had no plans to kill Han Qian so quickly, but who asked Han Qian to be too weak?
Forget it, there was no need to take it to heart.
He strode forwards, and walked into the golden tower.
In less than a minute, he had cleared the nine-storey tower. Pa, a pill bottle descended from above his head.
He picked it up and looked at it. There was a label on the bottle, and there were three words written on it: Tranquil Heart Pill.
Tranquil Heart Pill?
Ling Han immediately began a mental search, and soon found the information.
The Tranquil Heart Pill could allow one to clear one’s mind and see Dao, increasing one’s ability to appreciate things. Moreover, it could suppress the internal demons to a certain extent.
This was a One Star Celestial medicine. Unfortunately, it did not have much effect on him.
The Six Characters Bright King Curse was the trump card that could annihilate all internal demons.
Yi, if he could rob this golden tower, he should be able to make some money, right?

Ling Han suddenly had a strange thought. However, the golden tower was just standing there like this. If he wanted to publicly destroy it, it wouldn’t be long before someone from the Holy Land of Metal Element would run over and apprehend him.
Moreover, he couldn’t even damage the golden figures here, so wouldn’t it be even more difficult to destroy the golden tower?
Forget it, forget it. Now, he had best go and forge the Origin Gold into a tool.
Ling Han left the golden tower and met up with the others. They then set off together, heading toward the Flame Canyon.
Because the journey was relatively long, they naturally had to borrow Tang Yun’er’s shuttle. In this way, they only spent half a day’s time to enter into the territory of the Holy Land of Flames.
The shuttle landed, and it was naturally chaotic again.
Looking at the map, this place was already not far from the Flame Canyon.

Ling Han did not have everyone follow him. If everyone entered into the Flame Canyon, then the consumption of Natural Dao Water would be much, much too great. Where would he find the time to refine the Origin Gold?
Hence, Ling Han found a secluded place, and had everyone stay here first. With the protection of the seven babies, at least they would not have to fear Heavenly Dao Foundation elites.
Ling Han also left behind the Battle Armor, further increasing the chances of success.

There was also the Essence Nurturing Gourd, and Ling Han had also handed it over to the empress. At night, they could stay in the gourd. Firstly, it could increase their Spiritual Power, and secondly, it was safer.
After making all the preparations, Ling Han set out.

After advancing into Celestial Path, cultivators wouldn’t die even if they didn’t have food, clear water, or air. As long as they could absorb the power of heaven and earth, they would be able to live. Even in extreme environments, they wouldn’t have to worry about their lives.
Ling Han set off on his own, heading towards the Flame Canyon.

Before he had even walked far enough, he discovered that the ground around him was showing signs of being charred, and there were less and less trees, grass, and flowers. After walking for a while, he basically could not see any more plants. There were some that were fiery red in colour, and they were Chi Yan Grass that could survive even in lava.
Ling Han didn’t use the Natural Dao Water. As long as he could hold on, he wouldn’t use the Natural Dao Water, lest he expend too much and affect his forging of the Origin Gold.

It was not that there was no one here. There were people deliberately searching for the Chi Yan Grass here. It was said that this thing was a saintly item for boosting one’s libido, so it was very popular.
With benefits, it was naturally inevitable that there would be conflict. Ling Han was even treated as a herb harvester by others, and was attacked.
—In this place, every herb-gatherer had their own territory. This naturally was something that they had achieved through fighting with their abilities.
Ling Han didn’t unleash his fury, and he simply pushed them back before calmly passing them by.
After two hours, he arrived at the entrance to the Flame Canyon.
There was a stone tablet erected here, and there were a few words written on it: “Land of Extreme Flame, those who enter will not return.”
Ling Han swept an eye over them, and felt as if these words were about to jump out of the rock. They were grand and majestic, possessing an indescribably great aura.
The person who had written these words was definitely extraordinary.
He naturally ignored them, and strode in.
Boom! A wave of heat surged over, and Ling Han discovered that the clothes on his body immediately started to burn.
This heat was who knew how many times higher than the outside world.
Ling Han hurriedly channeled his mystical power to surround his entire body to resist this powerful power of flames.
He slowed down his pace. Now that he was here, he could no longer walk so fast. If the power of flames exploded to the extreme, he would be incinerated into ashes in an instant.

After walking for a while, just the mystical power alone was no longer enough to protect him. Ling Han channelled out the Starlight Screen. This defense was extremely strong, and once again dispelled the wave of heat.
Ling Han advanced again, but he had not walked too far, when he saw flames intertwining ahead of him. Multiple seals were blooming, like flowers in full bloom.
He slowly walked forwards, but he had not even been touched by the flames, when he saw that his Starlight Screen was melting at an extremely fast speed, like snow that had met hot water.
What terrifying power of flames.

Ling Han no longer hesitated, and took out Natural Dao Water. He drank a drop, and instantly, slivers of cold air surged out of his body, forming a water shield outside his body, cutting off the heat.
He was no longer cautious. Instead, he used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed instantly spiked.
Now, no matter how terrifying the might of the flames was, Ling Han didn’t care anymore.
He discovered that the water shield was continuously being expended, and the deeper he went into the canyon, the faster it was being expended.
Life was truly amazing. Even in this kind of extremely fiery land, there were still plants growing.

It was a blade of grass that was only half an inch tall. It was actually growing on a rock. Its five leaves spread open, and like starfish, stuck tightly onto the rock. From afar, it looked like five geckos.
“Phoenix Blood Grass!” Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He stopped and plucked the grass, placing it into his Spatial Tool.
This was a good thing. According to legends, it was dyed with the blood of a phoenix, and loved places of extreme heat the most.

The hotter and more difficult the environment was, the better the Phoenix Blood Grass grew. It was said that after ingesting it, there was an extremely low possibility that one would be able to cultivate a Flame Mystical Power.
The higher the level of the Phoenix Blood Grass, the higher the possibility of forming the Flame Mystical Power, and the more powerful the Mystical Power would be.
Of course, the higher level of the Phoenix Blood Grass, the more powerful one would need to be to match it. Otherwise, before the Mystical Power was formed, one would be burnt to ashes first.
He had not thought that there would be additional gains.
Ling Han smiled knowingly, and continued onwards.

The power of flames here was incredibly terrifying. Though there was Natural Dao Water to dispel the calamity of burning the body, it had also greatly increased the air resistance, causing Ling Han to be unable to fully unleash his speed.
After an hour, the water shield on Ling Han’s body was almost exhausted.
He didn’t dare to take any chances. After ingesting the second drop of Natural Dao Water, the power of the water instantly surged, and the water shield returned to its strongest state.
Hiss, this place was so big.
Though his speed had not been pushed to the extreme, it was still five times the speed of sound. Running at this kind of speed for an hour, he actually still had not reached the end of the valley?
In less than half an hour, Ling Han’s water shield was once again close to exhaustion.
The closer he was to the end of the valley, the stronger the power of the flames would be, and the greater the expenditure on the water shield.
If he really reached the end of the valley, just how long would a drop of Natural Dao Water be able to last?
‘Hmm?’
When Ling Han ingested the third drop of Natural Dao Water, he suddenly caught sight of a figure..

chapters.title: Chapter 3670: Encountering an elite
paragraphs: Chapter 3670: Encountering an elite
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
In such a blazing place, there was actually another person!
Did he also have Natural Dao Water, or… was his strength so heaven-defyingly powerful?
Ling Han saw very clearly that there was no water shield on that person’s body. Instead, he was covered densely with seals of fire, effectively absorbing the power of the flames.
This was an elite, and one that was powerful to the extreme. He could actually walk freely in such depths.

The other had also seen him. The power of flames here was too terrifying. His divine sense could not be activated, so he could only see him with the naked eye. Thus, Ling Han discovered the other even earlier, because he had an eye technique.

It was an old man. He had a head of crimson hair, and his eyes were like copper bells. He was dressed in white coarse clothes, and there was not the slightest bit of adornment on him. However, he exuded a powerful and invincible aura. He was first surprised, then nodded, and said to himself, “So it’s Natural Dao Water!”
To be able to recognize Natural Dao Water with a single glance, this old geezer was no ordinary character.
Of course, being able to appear here with his own strength was already proof of the old geezer’s strength.

“Very good. I want to obtain Fire Crystals and comprehend the way to communicate with high-level flame energy. In this area, there is a limited number of Fire Crystals. If there is Natural Dao Water, then I can enter into a deeper area,” the old man mumbled to himself again, but his voice was very loud, and did not fear that Ling Han would hear him at all.
p***l
Ling Han did not say another word, and directly broke out into a run towards the depths of the canyon.
Why didn’t he run back?

Firstly, he couldn’t waste the Natural Dao Water. Secondly, and most importantly, this old man was too powerful. If he ran back, it would be impossible for him to dodge. He could only enter the depths of the canyon and rely on the Heavenly Dao Flames there to stop him.
As for how he would come out later, that was a matter for the future. At present, the most important thing was to escape.
“Trying to escape?” the old man in coarse clothes said calmly. He set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
With the gap in strength between the two of them, the old man in coarse clothes should have been able to easily catch up to Ling Han, but it was different here.
The power of flames was too terrifying, forcing the old man to have to channel 99% of his power to resist. This naturally greatly affected his speed.
Ling Han, on the other hand, had a water shield to protect him, so he didn’t need to worry about the flames. He only needed to run with all his might.
One ran, while the other pursued. Though the old man had a slight advantage in speed, if he wanted to catch up to Ling Han, he would need some time.
What was the key?

The old man in coarse clothes had already reached his limit by coming here. If he continued to run in, even he wouldn’t be able to withstand the power of the flames. He wouldn’t be able to chase for more than a few steps.
He obviously knew this as well, and couldn’t help but raise a brow, brazenly making his move.
Boom, endless power condensed, turning into a giant hand of fire that grabbed out at Ling Han.
This palm strike was incredibly terrifying. Endless seals were surging in the flames, as if the God of Fire was about to bum the world to ash in his fury. However, it was useless.

The giant hand of flames descended, but it was continuously melting. The power of flames here was too terrifying. Even if the old man in coarse clothes also shot out fire element attacks, they were still rapidly disintegrating. The old man in coarse clothes frowned. In truth, he had also known that this would happen. He had only made a move to scare Ling Han.
He immediately activated his divine sense, using a level of being that was innumerable times higher to suppress Ling Han.
This was the might of a high-level cultivator, and it was used to intimidate low-level cultivators.
Boom! The might surged over, yet Ling Han was completely unmoved. He continued to run as fast as he could.
This time, the coarse-clothed elder was truly astonished.
Who was he?
Dragon Flame Venerate!
This was a supreme elite at the fourth pinnacle level. Below Saint-level, he was the most powerful.
By now, it had already been a very long time since a Saint had appeared on this planet. He was definitely the strongest, but his pressure was actually ineffective against Ling Han?
Just how strange was this?
Could this brat have a Saint Tool on him?
That couldn’t be, either. What Holy Land would hand over a Saint Tool to a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator? Wouldn’t they be afraid that it would be snatched away?
After chasing for another two steps, the old man in coarse clothes suddenly stopped. He didn’t dare to go any deeper, or it would be an action of courting death.
However, even if this brat brought the Natural Dao Water with him, there would eventually come a time when it would be exhausted. How could it be that he would never come out?
He would just wait for him.
Ling Han moved swiftly. The water shield was rapidly being consumed, and he had no choice but to drink another drop of Natural Dao Water to maintain the activation of the water shield.
Old b@stard.
He thought to himself. Just because he saw that he had Natural Dao Water, he wanted to take him down forcefully. How shameless!
However, for the old geezer to be able to walk to such a deep place, his abilities should be world-shakingly terrifying.

By the looks of it, he wouldn’t be able to exact revenge in the short term. —If this was known to others, they would definitely cry out in madness. Have you gone mad? He is a mighty Venerate Tier elite, and your first reaction is actually not how to escape, but rather when you can get your revenge. He was really bold.

Ling Han put all of this aside first, and arrived at the depths of the Flaming Canyon. There was a pit here that had been created by a smash. It was not very big, about nine meters in diameter, and was only about three meters deep. In this place, the power of flames had reached the pinnacle.

Ling Han stretched out his head to look from afar. Even if he had Natural Dao Water, he didn’t dare to touch the flames here. He saw that the flames boiling in the pit were actually all seals, but they were indescribably mysterious. This was a high-level flame energy!
Ling Han thought. There was actually still a difference even when both was high-level energy. This was known through the level of different Spirit Diagrams.

Different Fire Spirit Diagrams communicated with completely different flames. In this place, it was possible that it had reached the pinnacle of the power of flames. Even Saints could be easily burnt to death.
Ling Han’s heart throbbed wildly. Were these seals the profound knowledge that communicated with the supreme power of flames?

He thought, but did not dare to have any hesitation. Immediately, he followed the tool refinement technique that Wu Qingxu had taught him, and attached a sliver of his divine sense to the Origin Gold, then threw the Origin Gold into the fire pit.
Boom! The symbols immediately started to pulsate madly, surrounding the Origin Gold and attempting to melt it down.
But what kind of existence was the Origin Gold?

sentences.text: Chapter 3670: Encountering an elite
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
In such a blazing place, there was actually another person!
Did he also have Natural Dao Water, or… was his strength so heaven-defyingly powerful?
Ling Han saw very clearly that there was no water shield on that person’s body.
Instead, he was covered densely with seals of fire, effectively absorbing the power of the flames.
This was an elite, and one that was powerful to the extreme.
He could actually walk freely in such depths.
The other had also seen him.
The power of flames here was too terrifying.
His divine sense could not be activated, so he could only see him with the naked eye.
Thus, Ling Han discovered the other even earlier, because he had an eye technique.
It was an old man.
He had a head of crimson hair, and his eyes were like copper bells.
He was dressed in white coarse clothes, and there was not the slightest bit of adornment on him.
However, he exuded a powerful and invincible aura.
He was first surprised, then nodded, and said to himself, “So it’s Natural Dao Water!”
To be able to recognize Natural Dao Water with a single glance, this old geezer was no ordinary character.
Of course, being able to appear here with his own strength was already proof of the old geezer’s strength.
“Very good.
I want to obtain Fire Crystals and comprehend the way to communicate with high-level flame energy.
In this area, there is a limited number of Fire Crystals.
If there is Natural Dao Water, then I can enter into a deeper area,” the old man mumbled to himself again, but his voice was very loud, and did not fear that Ling Han would hear him at all.
p***l
Ling Han did not say another word, and directly broke out into a run towards the depths of the canyon.
Why didn’t he run back?
Firstly, he couldn’t waste the Natural Dao Water.
Secondly, and most importantly, this old man was too powerful.
If he ran back, it would be impossible for him to dodge.
He could only enter the depths of the canyon and rely on the Heavenly Dao Flames there to stop him.
As for how he would come out later, that was a matter for the future.
At present, the most important thing was to escape.
“Trying to escape?” the old man in coarse clothes said calmly.
He set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
With the gap in strength between the two of them, the old man in coarse clothes should have been able to easily catch up to Ling Han, but it was different here.
The power of flames was too terrifying, forcing the old man to have to channel 99% of his power to resist.
This naturally greatly affected his speed.
Ling Han, on the other hand, had a water shield to protect him, so he didn’t need to worry about the flames.
He only needed to run with all his might.
One ran, while the other pursued.
Though the old man had a slight advantage in speed, if he wanted to catch up to Ling Han, he would need some time.
What was the key?
The old man in coarse clothes had already reached his limit by coming here.
If he continued to run in, even he wouldn’t be able to withstand the power of the flames.
He wouldn’t be able to chase for more than a few steps.
He obviously knew this as well, and couldn’t help but raise a brow, brazenly making his move.
Boom, endless power condensed, turning into a giant hand of fire that grabbed out at Ling Han.
This palm strike was incredibly terrifying.
Endless seals were surging in the flames, as if the God of Fire was about to bum the world to ash in his fury.
However, it was useless.
The giant hand of flames descended, but it was continuously melting.
The power of flames here was too terrifying.
Even if the old man in coarse clothes also shot out fire element attacks, they were still rapidly disintegrating.
The old man in coarse clothes frowned.
In truth, he had also known that this would happen.
He had only made a move to scare Ling Han.
He immediately activated his divine sense, using a level of being that was innumerable times higher to suppress Ling Han.
This was the might of a high-level cultivator, and it was used to intimidate low-level cultivators.
Boom!
The might surged over, yet Ling Han was completely unmoved.
He continued to run as fast as he could.
This time, the coarse-clothed elder was truly astonished.
Who was he?
Dragon Flame Venerate!
This was a supreme elite at the fourth pinnacle level.
Below Saint-level, he was the most powerful.
By now, it had already been a very long time since a Saint had appeared on this planet.
He was definitely the strongest, but his pressure was actually ineffective against Ling Han?
Just how strange was this?
Could this brat have a Saint Tool on him?
That couldn’t be, either.
What Holy Land would hand over a Saint Tool to a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator?
Wouldn’t they be afraid that it would be snatched away?
After chasing for another two steps, the old man in coarse clothes suddenly stopped.
He didn’t dare to go any deeper, or it would be an action of courting death.
However, even if this brat brought the Natural Dao Water with him, there would eventually come a time when it would be exhausted.
How could it be that he would never come out?
He would just wait for him.
Ling Han moved swiftly.
The water shield was rapidly being consumed, and he had no choice but to drink another drop of Natural Dao Water to maintain the activation of the water shield.
Old b@stard.
He thought to himself.
Just because he saw that he had Natural Dao Water, he wanted to take him down forcefully.
How shameless!
However, for the old geezer to be able to walk to such a deep place, his abilities should be world-shakingly terrifying.
By the looks of it, he wouldn’t be able to exact revenge in the short term. —If this was known to others, they would definitely cry out in madness.
Have you gone mad?
He is a mighty Venerate Tier elite, and your first reaction is actually not how to escape, but rather when you can get your revenge.
He was really bold.
Ling Han put all of this aside first, and arrived at the depths of the Flaming Canyon.
There was a pit here that had been created by a smash.
It was not very big, about nine meters in diameter, and was only about three meters deep.
In this place, the power of flames had reached the pinnacle.

Even if he had Natural Dao Water, he didn’t dare to touch the flames here.
He saw that the flames boiling in the pit were actually all seals, but they were indescribably mysterious.
This was a high-level flame energy!

There was actually still a difference even when both was high-level energy.
This was known through the level of different Spirit Diagrams.
Different Fire Spirit Diagrams communicated with completely different flames.
In this place, it was possible that it had reached the pinnacle of the power of flames.

Every morning, Ling Han wanted to cultivate, but the power of flames here was too terrifying, suppressing the power of heaven and earth.
He couldn’t cultivate at all.
Thankfully, he had prepared a backup plan, and brought food with him.
Otherwise, if he couldn’t absorb the power of heaven and earth, and didn’t eat or drink, he would really starve to death here..

chapters.title: Chapter 3671: Tool Refinement
paragraphs: Chapter 3671: Tool Refinement
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Four days, five days, six days, and there was no change to the Origin Gold at all.
This was truly a terrifying object. The aura of Primal Chaos descended, resisting the energy of the flames, and was not inferior at all.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised and rueful. The Origin Gold was indeed awesome. It hadn’t been refined, and merely a pure ingredient was already so amazing. No wonder it could sweep aside all opposition in the world after instilling the might of the Ancestral King into it in the future.
It should be known that there would come a day when a Great Emperor would be aged, but the Origin Gold would not.
It would last for all eternity, and be immortal for all eternity.
Ling Han was not anxious. Going by Wu Qingxu’s words, even in a land of extreme flames, the Origin Gold would have to be melted for a whole thirty-six days, before there would be some slight change.
He would wait.

A dozen over days later, Ling Han’s mouth was dry with thirst. Even if he had the protection of the water shield, he still felt extremely hot here. This was not just on the physical level, but also on the spiritual level.
It was as if a flame had been planted in his mind, and it was about to spread endlessly, forming a great fire that would incinerate him.
Ling Han persisted. Mystical power circulated continuously in his body, and the Celestial Foundation exuded the ancient aura, suppressing that terrifying power of flames.
This was truly terrifying. Even if Ling Han was merely studying the seals of flames, he would still draw fire onto himself.
Even so, Ling Han still didn’t stop.
As long as he could hold on, he would not give up.
Twenty days! Thirty days!
By now, Ling Han was completely dehydrated and shrivelled up. It was guaranteed that no one would be able to recognize him.
Right now, he was nothing more than a dried corpse. The only difference was that he was still alive.
He finally had some enlightenment.
He thought to himself, a slight smile curling up the comers of his lips. This seal of fire was too difficult to grasp. He stared at it and finally made some progress.
32 days, 35 days, 36 days!
Ling Han discovered that the Origin Gold finally showed signs of softening.
It did not melt, but merely weakened.
This was already the limit. Even the Heavenly Dao Flames couldn’t truly melt the Origin Gold.
That sliver of divine sense of Ling Han’s had taken effect. It had been protected by the aura of Primal Chaos all this while, and had not been burnt by the flames.
His divine sense channeled and fused with the Origin Gold.
What cultivation level did he have? On what basis could he use the precious tool refined from the Origin Gold?

There was only one way, and that was to merge his spirit with the Origin Gold. From then onwards, the Origin Gold would be like a part of his body, so it would naturally be a piece of cake for him to channel it.

It had been burnt by the Heavenly Dao Flames for 36 days. There was only one purpose for this, and that was to turn the Origin Gold soft and loose. Only then would his spirit be able to spread out in every corner of the Origin Gold and perfectly fuse together.
His spirit channelled. Thankfully, the Origin Gold was inanimate. Otherwise, such a powerful existence only needed a slight thought, and it would be able to shatter his spirit.
Bit by bit, Ling Han calmed down and spread out his divine sense.
At this moment, he naturally didn’t have the energy to study the flame seals anymore. In comparison, refining the Origin Gold was definitely more important.

One day, two days, five days, Ling Han improved slightly every day. The Heavenly Dao Flames was still burning fiercely. Though it could not refine the Origin Gold, it still caused the Origin Gold to maintain a slightly weak state, creating conditions for the fusion of Ling Han’s spirit.
Nine days!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had finally completely fused his divine sense with the Origin Gold.
Change!
Ling Han manipulated the Origin Gold, and with the help of the Heavenly Dao Flames, he began to mold the shape of the Origin Gold.
What shape would the Origin Gold Spirit Tool be forged into?
Ling Han had considered a great many things.
For example, the sword, the king of weapons. With a single slash, it could sever the heavens, and dazzle the universe.
For example, the saber. It was incredibly domineering, and could shatter the heavens with a single strike.
There was also the cauldron, a precious tool of an empire. The wielder of the cauldron could control the world.
However, Ling Han still preferred the Tower.
After his rebirth, his first Spirit Tool was the Black Tower. It had accompanied him for innumerable years, and he had developed affection for it as well.
The Black Tower was forged by the Karmic Life Heavenly Venerable, so he would forge his own tower-shaped precious tool.
It was decided then.

In the fire pit, the Origin Gold was changing shape. The Heavenly Dao Flames couldn’t melt it, but added with Ling Han’s control through divine sense, this could allow the Origin Gold to shape itself.
-There was no power in this world that could change the Origin Gold, aside from the Origin Gold itself.
The model of a small tower appeared, and Ling Han continued to carefully mould it. Nine levels appeared on the body of the tower, and then it became more and more detailed.
As the Origin Gold, it naturally couldn’t be so simple. Every level formed an independent space, which was very big.
However, Ling Han’s Spiritual Power was limited. After reaching a certain level, he could no longer open further spaces.
It was fine. His spirit had already fused with the Origin Gold. In future, as his divine sense became stronger, he would naturally be able to continue opening up space.
The purpose of coming here was to merge his spirit with the Origin Gold. This could only be done in a situation when the Heavenly Dao Flames melted the Origin Gold until it was slightly weak.

“Come!” Ling Han said lightly, and the tower that was forged from the Origin Gold spun and flew towards him. It floated above his head, and an aura of Primal Chaos poured down. Lightning flashed, as if it was a deadly weapon that was delivering punishment on behalf of the heavens.
This aura of Primal Chaos was extraordinarily heavy, and could overwhelm all. Furthermore, the power of lightning was incomparable, capable of destroying everything.

Of course, Ling Han’s current strength wasn’t enough, so he could only channel out a bit of the might of the two. However, in the Foundation Building Tier, he probably wouldn’t be able to find a worthy opponent.

Ling Han laughed loudly. A Foundation Building Tier cultivator already possessed the most powerful precious tool; who in this world could compare? Unfortunately, this was built by him, so it naturally could not possibly possess the might of an Imperial Weapon. It only possessed endless growth and potential.
“From now onwards, your name will be Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!”
Ling Han wanted to leave, but just as he raised his foot, a thought flashed through his mind, and he turned his gaze to the fire pit.
Could he absorb some flames?
Although he didn’t dare to touch the flames, didn’t he still have the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
“Retrieve!” He drew out the precious tower, and arrived above the fire pit. With a thought, the space on the ninth floor of the precious tower instantly opened, and began to absorb the flames.
He really could!
Haha, this was great.

However, after the Heavenly Dao Flames entered into the precious tower’s space, it immediately dispersed from the flame seals as if it had shattered. It was originally only the size of a fist, but now it actually turned into a sea of flames, causing the tower’s space, while being obviously large, not being able to collect many flames.
So be it if there weren’t many. Again.
Ling Han filled all nine levels of the tower with Heavenly Dao Flames — or rather, slightly inferior Heavenly Dao Flames.
The Heavenly Dao Flames were capable of burning Saints to death. If it had been one level higher, then it shouldn’t have been difficult for it to burn Venerate Tier elites to death, right?
Hehe, just how many Saints were there in this world?
Venerate Tier elites should be regarded as the most powerful beings in the universe, right? Then, if he could burn even Venerate Tier elites to death, just how awesome would his trump card be?
“If that old b@stard is still waiting for me outside, I’ll burn him to death.
Ling Han murmured, then strode out of the valley.
He was already running out of Natural Dao Water. If he didn’t leave now, he would be burned to death here.

After storing away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, Ling Han ran quickly and soon left the innermost depths of the canyon. The might of the flames dropped drastically, and the expenditure of the water shield also slowed down.
“Brat, do you really think you can escape from this old man’s grasp?” A calm voice’rang out, and the old man in coarse clothes appeared once more.
Dragon Flame Venerate!

Ling Han had confidence now, so he was naturally unafraid. He retreated deeper into the canyon, as in that kind of extremely fiery place, he could greatly weaken his opponent’s strength. Otherwise, if he died the moment his opponent made a move, he would not even be able to have the chance to unleash the Heavenly Dao Flames.
“Old b@stard, is there something wrong with your brain? Have I offended you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3672: Burning a Venerate Tier
paragraphs: Chapter 3672: Burning a Venerate Tier
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han had complaints, and the Dragon Flame Venerate could understand that, but this brat was too outrageously bold; he actually dared to call him old b@stard?
He was a Venerate Tier elite, the strongest below Saint Tier!
“You’re seeking death!” he said balefully. He raised his hand to grab at Ling Han.

If Ling Han treated him respectfully, then just because Ling Han could resist his intimidation, perhaps he would observe Ling Han for a while. If Ling Han’s talent was good enough, he would not mind taking him as a disciple.
However, after hearing Ling Han’s curse, he naturally wouldn’t have such thoughts anymore.
Regardless of whether you were a prodigy or not, in front of a Venerate Tier elite, you were nothing but dust and trash.
Boom! The large hand grabbed over, and it was as if even the stars in the sky could be easily captured.
The power of a Venerate Tier elite was boundlessly terrifying.
Yet Ling Han smirked coldly. With a thought, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared. Then, a level of space on the tower’s body opened, and towering flames blazed.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower itself could only be considered a One Star Tool. However, it was incredibly sturdy, and even Saints could not possibly damage it. But now that it was filled with Heavenly Dao Flames, its might was completely different.
This weakened version of the Heavenly Dao Flames might not be able to burn the Saint to death, but the Dragon Flame Venerate was no Saint.
Boom! Flames blazed, incinerating everything.
“What?!” the Dragon Flame Venerate exclaimed in astonishment. He hurriedly retreated.
He didn’t even dare to touch these flames.
But in this place, the power of flames was too strong, so he could not retreat quickly either.
The surging flames chased after his behind, and its speed was slightly faster, getting closer and closer.
However, the Dragon Flame Venerate was running out of the valley, and his speed was also getting faster and faster. Though the flames were closing in, its speed was becoming slower and slower.
It had still caught up!
The Dragon Flame Venerate let out a pained scream as his bottom was burned.

He made a prompt decision, and turned his hand into a saber. A slash descended, and a sanguine light blazed. One side of his behind was instantly severed, and the flames did not spread all over his body.
Even so, there was still fire poison entering his body, which left a huge problem for him.
The Dragon Flame Venerate turned around and gave Ling Han a meaningful look. However, his steps became even faster. Xiu! He instantly disappeared without a trace.
He had been severely wounded, so his top priority now was to expel the fire poison. Otherwise, even if he decided to sacrifice his “behind”, it would still be inevitable that he would die.
