chapters.title: Chapter 3673: Arrival at the Holy Land
paragraphs: Chapter 3673: Arrival at the Holy Land
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

Boom, a ball of flames danced in Ling Han’s hand. It was very small, and looked like a flame, but the wave of heat it exuded was incredibly terrifying. It could melt even Divine Metal of a slightly lower grade.
This was what he had appreciated from the Heavenly Dao Flames.

Communicating with high-level energy didn’t necessarily require a Spirit Diagram. Previously, Ling Han had only memorized a single flame seal, and after mastering it, he naturally communicated with high-level flame energy.
This was incomparable to the flame energy that he had previously grasped.

En, the Spirit Diagram should only be a means of communicating with high-level energy. Now that he had completely comprehended the flame seal, it was equivalent to having grasped a corresponding Spirit Diagram.
Of course, he had only deciphered a single seal, so this flame was pitifully weak. It was just a small flame.
“When I become stronger in the future, I’ll go to the Flaming Canyon and master all the seals. That’s something that can burn even Saints to death,” Ling Han murmured.
In these two months, everyone had improved greatly. The empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog had all advanced into Extreme Bone Tier.
Unfortunately, they had all broken through from Sixth Change, and were unable to reach Seventh Change.
This was related to the Power of Dimension in his body. It couldn’t be forced.
Ling Han considered for a moment, then decided to have everyone continue waiting for him outside, and not enter into the Holy Land of Metal Element with him.
Firstly, he could not possibly bring such a large number of people with him. Then, all of them would only be able to enter into the Essence Nurturing Gourd.
Secondly, even if he did, with the power of the Holy Land of Metal Element, how could it be that theHoly Land of Metal Element wouldn’t recognize the Essence Nurturing Gourd?
This was a treasure that even a Spirit Transformation True Lord would be tempted by. How could he protect it?
He had come to collect benefits, and had no wish to become a wealth-delivering boy.
Thus, it was better for everyone to stay here. The Essence Nurturing Gourd was also handed into the care of the empress.
In any case, their cultivation levels were too low, so even if they were given celestial fruits, it would not be of much use.
Aside from a Spatial Spirit Tool, Ling Han only had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower with him.

“I have to disguise this treasure. Otherwise, this scene would be too astonishing. The Primal Chaos aura would be boiling, and lightning would be closely intertwined. Even an idiot would know that it is extraordinary,” he mumbled.

This was easy to deal with. What kind of God Tool was the Origin Gold? It could be big or small, and it was all up to him to decide. It immediately shrunk to the size of a thumb, and he used it like an ornament for his hair sash, hanging it on his head.

This was one aspect. On the other side, Ling Han also caused the God Tool to keep a low profile. The aura of Primal Chaos no longer descended, and lightning was no longer intertwined. It looked like a very ordinary One Star precious tool. Even if it was slightly more powerful, no one would think that it had been forged from Origin Gold.
“Now, I can fly, right?”
With a thought from Ling Han, he began to ride on his Tool.
He jumped onto the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This precious tower floated gently and didn’t fall.
“Let’s go.”
Ling Han issued a command, and the precious tower immediately advanced, but its speed was too fast. With a xiu, Ling Han flipped down from above, and fell onto the ground with a thud.
The precious tower slowly flew back, and hung above Ling Han’s head.
“Can’t you fly slower?”

Ling Han mocked. However, he also knew that this was impossible. With the strength of a Foundation Building Tier cultivator, he was still unable to make the precious tool fly at a low speed. Otherwise, it would not be able to overcome the gravity fields at all.
He once again jumped onto the precious tower. This time, he used his mystical power to press down on himself, firmly sticking close to the precious tower.
“Let’s go again.”
Ling Han gave a soft shout, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower flew again at an extremely fast speed.
It was as if he had stuck onto it, and did not fall off again.
Faster.
Ling Han injected even more mystical power into the tower, and the speed of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower instantly soared.

Ten times the speed of sound, fifteen times, twenty times. However, the limit was only twenty times, which was the same speed as Ling Han running at full speed, but the advantage was that he could fly in the air and ignore all obstacles.
For a normal Foundation Building Tier cultivator, flying on a Tool was an extremely difficult task, but for Ling Han, this was a piece of cake, and he didn’t know how difficult it was at all.
Riding on his precious tool, he soon arrived at the main gate of the Holy Land.

The entire Holy Land was protected by a formation. With Ling Han’s current formation abilities, there was absolutely no way he could break through it. Furthermore, there was absolutely no need for him to break through it. In the first place, he would be able to enter boldly.
“Who goes there? You have come to the Holy Land, and still dare to fly on a Tool?” Immediately, someone shouted at him.
Ling Han descended, but he had just learnt how to fly, so he was naturally in a very sorry state. With a bang, he crashed into a rock.
“Pul” A woman’s laughter was heard, and then she said, “Senior Brother Jia, he should have just leamt how to fly on a Tool, so don’t make things difficult for him.”
Ling Han gritted his teeth and put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. He then turned around to take a look.

There were two young people standing at the main gate, a man and a woman. They were both in the Foundation Building Tier. Moreover, the man should have reached Heavenly Dao Foundation, as his level of being was clearly slightly superior Ling Han, and the woman should also be a Human Dao Foundation. Her level of being was equal to Ling Han’s.
“I’m here to attend the Metal Element Fruit Gathering,” Ling Han said with a faint smile.
“You?” The male, Senior Brother Jia couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “Are you worthy?”
Ling Han’s expression did not change, and he said calmly, “It is not up to you to decide whether I am worthy or otherwise.”
Senior Brother Jia couldn’t help but feel angry. This brat actually dared to insult him?
He humphed, “Brat, what kind of place do you think this is?” He moved aggressively, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han. A vigorous power surged over, endless seals blazing.
“Senior Brother Jia!” The woman hurriedly stepped forward to block him.
Senior Brother Jia hurriedly withdrew his hand, and complained, “Junior Sister, what are you doing?”
Yet the woman smiled at Ling Han, and asked, “This one, have you passed through the three types of nine-storey towers?”
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “Yes.”
“Then come over here, and I’ll examine you,” the woman continued.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
Ling Han walked over as instructed, and did not even cast a second look at that Senior Brother Jia or whatnot, angering that Senior Brother Jia so much that his eyes were spitting fire.
The woman pointed at a white jade at the mountain’s entrance, “Come, place your hand on it.”
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down on the jade. Instantly, the invisible mark that he had previously been struck by the nine-storey tower surfaced, exuding a bright light.
“Senior Brother Jia, he has passed through the nine-storey towers, and obtained the qualification to join the Holy Land,” the woman turned and said to Senior Brother Jia.
“Humph, so what?” Senior Brother Jia was unconcerned.

There were many people who had passed through the nine-storey towers, but a great many had been expelled after entering into the Holy Land for one or two years, and less than one-tenth of them could stay behind. Thus, he did not take Ling Han seriously at all.
“Senior Brother!” The woman stomped her foot, then smiled at Ling Han. “My name is Liu Lin, so you can just call me Senior Sister Liu. What’s your name?”
“Ling Han.”
“Junior Brother Ling, follow me.” Liu Lin waved a hand, and brought Ling Han with her into the main gate.
Ling Han nodded, smiled faintly at Senior Brother Jia, and strode off.
“Detestable brat!” Senior Brother Jia raised his fists, appearing extremely displeased.

With his status, there was originally no need for him to stand guard here. However, for the sake of courting Liu Lin, he had taken the initiative to come. However, he had not even said a few words to Beauty Liu, when he was interrupted by Ling Han’s appearance.
This was actually the true reason for his anger. Now, it was even better. Liu Lin brought Ling Han in, and actually left him alone to watch over the main gate.
Did they really think that he was a doorman?

He humphed, “Brat, what kind of place do you think this is?” He moved aggressively, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
A vigorous power surged over, endless seals blazing.
“Senior Brother Jia!” The woman hurriedly stepped forward to block him.
Senior Brother Jia hurriedly withdrew his hand, and complained, “Junior Sister, what are you doing?”
Yet the woman smiled at Ling Han, and asked, “This one, have you passed through the three types of nine-storey towers?”
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “Yes.”
“Then come over here, and I’ll examine you,” the woman continued.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
Ling Han walked over as instructed, and did not even cast a second look at that Senior Brother Jia or whatnot, angering that Senior Brother Jia so much that his eyes were spitting fire.
The woman pointed at a white jade at the mountain’s entrance, “Come, place your hand on it.”
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down on the jade.
Instantly, the invisible mark that he had previously been struck by the nine-storey tower surfaced, exuding a bright light.
“Senior Brother Jia, he has passed through the nine-storey towers, and obtained the qualification to join the Holy Land,” the woman turned and said to Senior Brother Jia.
“Humph, so what?” Senior Brother Jia was unconcerned.

There were many people who had passed through the nine-storey towers, but a great many had been expelled after entering into the Holy Land for one or two years, and less than one-tenth of them could stay behind.
Thus, he did not take Ling Han seriously at all.
“Senior Brother!” The woman stomped her foot, then smiled at Ling Han.
“My name is Liu Lin, so you can just call me Senior Sister Liu.
What’s your name?”
“Ling Han.”
“Junior Brother Ling, follow me.” Liu Lin waved a hand, and brought Ling Han with her into the main gate.
Ling Han nodded, smiled faintly at Senior Brother Jia, and strode off.
“Detestable brat!” Senior Brother Jia raised his fists, appearing extremely displeased.
With his status, there was originally no need for him to stand guard here.
However, for the sake of courting Liu Lin, he had taken the initiative to come.
However, he had not even said a few words to Beauty Liu, when he was interrupted by Ling Han’s appearance.
This was actually the true reason for his anger.
Now, it was even better.
Liu Lin brought Ling Han in, and actually left him alone to watch over the main gate.
Did they really think that he was a doorman?

chapters.title: Chapter 3674: Final Tournament
paragraphs: Chapter 3674: Final Tournament
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han would never have imagined that he would be able to offend someone even though he had just come over very, very normally.
Of course, he would not care either. If he had offended him, so be it. What was the big deal about it?
Liu Lin was very cordial, chattering all the way, introducing the Holy Land of
Metal Element to Ling Han.

The Holy Land was divided into a total of seven areas. For Foundation Building disciples like them, they could only move around in the first three areas, and the last four areas belonged to forbidden territory. If they entered without permission, the lightest punishment would be a violent beating, and a heavy punishment would be a violent beating before they were expelled from the sect.

“You want to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering and not join the Holy Land?” When Liu Lin found out about Ling Han’s thoughts, she couldn’t help but exclaim in shock, appearing very confused.
This was the Holy Land of Metal Element. No matter where it was in the vast galaxy, it could be considered supreme.
You were able to join a Holy Land, so why are you still being so picky?
Ling Han smiled and said, “I don’t have such thoughts yet. “You’re truly a weirdo,” Liu Lin said with a shake of her head. “Fine, you have your own thoughts.”
She brought Ling Han to a group of buildings, then arranged for Ling Han to stay in a room.
“The people living here will all be participating in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering 13 days later. Just wait for the notice.
“All right, thanks.” Ling Han nodded.
Liu Lin left, while Ling Han walked into his room, closed the doors, and began to study formation techniques.
This path was wide and profound, especially for Celestial level Formations. It was the hardest to start, and without “enlightenment”, one really wouldn’t be able to grasp the slightest bit of it.
Ling Han had Wally’s help, and his improvement in formations was extremely fast. However, he was still far from being able to step through these doors.

He diligently studied it. If he could really grasp formations, then his battle prowess would be greatly strengthened. In future, when he ventured into ancient sites, or went to steal someone else’s woman, they would both be useful.
In these few days, his improvement was extremely great.
In the past two months, he hadn’t cultivated. However, Ling Han had been tempered in extremely harsh environments all this while, so his spirit had become much stronger.
He opened his apertures and extracted the power of heaven and earth. The Celestial Foundation in his mind slowly grew stronger.
It was really too advantageous to cultivate here. One day was comparable to ten days in other places.
13 days quickly passed, and someone finally came to inform that they were to participate in a competition. Only the victor would be qualified to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
For Ling Han, this was something that he had long since known, but for others, this was too sudden.
But what could be done? How could it be that they could argue with the Holy Land?
So be it if it was a competition. Everyone here was filled with confidence in
themselves.

Ling Han pondered for a moment before putting on a mask. There were definitely a great many people here that had not expected that he would come to the Holy Land of Metal Element. Then, let the surprise become even fiercer.
Ling Han walked out, yet shockingly discovered that there were actually quite a number of people whose faces had not been revealed.
Some had veined patterns drawn on their faces, and their facial features could not be seen at all. Some were wearing cloaks that enshrouded their entire person, while some were wearing masks.
Was this because they were afraid that they would be embarrassed after being eliminated, so they deliberately hid their faces?

Ling Han saw a great many extraterrestrial visitors that had appeared on the Celestial Sea Planet, but there were even more unfamiliar faces. They should be prodigies that the Holy Land of Metal Element had summoned from other planets.
The Eldest Imperial Prince, the Seventh Imperial Prince, Hong Tianbu, and Niu Jianhua!
A faint smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. These guys, just wait for him to deal with them.

Everyone followed an envoy from the Holy Land, and arrived at a plaza. “Next, you guys still have the last test to pass.” A middle-aged man appeared. He was tall and slender, and stood proudly in the sky.
Stand quietly in midair?
This had to be a Core Formation Tier elite, at least.

Everyone was solemn. Even though many of them had Sect Master-level backgrounds, they were not even worth mentioning in a Holy Land, and he was also far stronger than them, so they were not qualified to challenge him.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
“Through this Transfer Formation, you will enter into a place called the Frost Origin Mystery Realm.”
“The first twelve people to come out of the Frost Origin Mystery Realm are qualified to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering!
“In this Mystery Realm, it is not forbidden to use any kind of means, nor is it forbidden to kill. Thus, if you are afraid of death, there is no need for you to
go.”

“Additionally, there are Ice Origin Stones on every peak of the Mystery Realm. You guys should be aware of their effects, so I won’t say much.” “Finally, there is also a Celestial Tree there. It is presently the time for the fruits to ripen. If you all have the ability, you can harvest it as you like, and consider it your reward.”
“Those who have decided to participate, walk forwards. Enter the Transfer Formation. Cowards, scram immediately!”
When this person finished speaking, everyone couldn’t help but feel hesitant.
There were actually only twelve spots?
How many people did they have here? At least tens of thousands.
Tens of thousands of people contending for twelve spots; this competition was too fierce, wasn’t it?
“Forget it. It’s just being able to eat a few celestial fruits. It’s not worth it.” Immediately, someone thought of retreating.
There was no lack of descendants of Sect Master-level forces here. For the sake of a few celestial fruits, to come to blows, firstly, it was not worth it, and secondly, it would degrade their status.
However, there were also many people who believed in their own strength. To say nothing of the fact that only twelve people could win, even if there was only one, it would definitely be them.
There were a few thousand people that chose to give up, but there were still about two thousand that stayed behind.
“GO on.” The middle-aged man from the Holy Land of Metal Element waved his hand, and commanded the people that had stayed behind to enter the Transfer Formation.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The Transfer Formation lit up continuously. It could transport around a hundred people each time, so its efficiency was quite amazing.

Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry. He was the last batch, less than a hundred people, just over fifty people. Thus, the formation appeared very spacious. Xiu, a brilliant light surged past, and the scene in front of them immediately changed.
A powerful chill assaulted them, and everyone involuntarily crossed their arms over their chests.

There were not just the fifty over people that had just been teleported here. There were also those people that had been teleported here previously, but there were already a great many people that had walked forwards.
“The first 12 people who return are qualified to participate in the fruit gathering. Wouldn’t that be a piece of cake? They just have to eactivate the Transfer Formation,” someone immediately said.
“Tsk!” He was immediately teased by the people beside him.

“What is it? Do you think I’m wrong?” the person from before asked coldly. “Firstly, are you a Formation Master, so you know how to activate formations? Secondly, as long as you’re not an idiot, you should have discovered that this Transfer Formation is a one-way formation. This is the place of entry, and the Transfer Formation for leaving is naturally at the end of the Mystery Realm.” The person who teased him said calmly.
This rendered the person from before speechless, and he could only glare harshly at him.
Ling Han observed for a moment. He was presently on a plain, covered with pure white snow. The accumulated snow was as deep as two feet, and with a single step, it would reach his knee.
However, this naturally wasn’t a problem for Celestial Path elites. Even if they couldn’t fly on Celestial Tools, it was fine. They only needed a little bit of power to stand.
Ahead of them, a large number of people had already left on their Tools, but there was also a small number that chose to run on the snow, thinking that it might not be safe to fly in the air.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then also moved his body, and began to sprint on the snowy ground..

chapters.title: Chapter 3675: Ice Valley
paragraphs: Chapter 3675: Ice Valley
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Hu, snow fluttered, and the cold wind was bone-chilling.

Ling Han stimulated a high-level flame energy, and his body instantly warmed up. However, it was as if this accumulated snow was also condensed from high-level ice energy. It had a very strong restraining effect on flame energy, forcing Ling Han to continuously extract flame energy for replenishment.
This was extremely exhausting on his Spiritual Power.

The Heavenly Dao Flames was not effective here. Firstly, there was only a tiny flame, and secondly, the destructive power of this thing was too great. It could only be used against enemies, but for warmth? Don’t burn yourself into ashes first.
Since the level of this flame energy was not high enough, he would switch to something else.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen, and instantly, the apertures all over his body lit up, forming a bell of stars.
The chill was blocked outside, and could no longer invade Ling Han’s body.
However, though this no longer expended Ling Han’s Spiritual Power, his mystical power was still continuously draining away.
Thankfully, Ling Han’s reserves of mystical power were astonishingly large.
This kind of expenditure was really no big deal.
What about the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
This could resist extreme flames, so what if it was cold?
Ling Han summoned the precious tower, which floated above his head, emanating wisps of Primal Chaos aura.

If he had not caused the precious tool to maintain a low profile, there would definitely be millions of scenes, and even Saints would be moved. But now, though the Primal Chaos aura was a little extraordinary, it was only so. At most, it could only be considered extraordinary among Foundation Building
Tiers.
This effect was immediately apparent. Wrapped in Primal Chaos aura, Ling
Han seemed to be impervious to all attacks.
The Origin Gold was the Origin Gold. Even if it had not been fused with the power of the Ancestral King, within the corresponding cultivation level, this was invincible.
En, just like him.
Ling Han thought narcissistically. He was invincible among his peers, like Origin Gold, like an Imperial Weapon.
His speed was astonishing, so what if the wind and snow intertwined? He strolled casually, and using twenty times the speed of sound, he soon caught up to the person in front of him.
However, this snowy plain was too large, and it was impossible for everyone to walk in a straight line. There would definitely be a great many people that he had surpassed, yet had never come across.
Ling Han’s speed was too fast. A great many people only reacted after he had surpassed them, and there was no chance for them to make a move even if they wanted to.
After running like this for half an hour, they finally reached the end of the snowy plains. A canyon lay ahead of them, with snow and ice raging.
Hu, a cold wind blew past, and actually turned into a massive vulture. As it swept past, it was like a bird king from the ancient times that was out on a trip, its might astonishing.
Even if they were very far away, Ling Han still felt a strong wariness, and hurriedly retreated.
He didn’t know if the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could block this cold air, but if it wasn’t necessary, he didn’t want to take the risk.
The cold winds howled, and lasted for a whole five minutes. A great many people suddenly appeared in the canyon, advancing forwards, but their speed was extremely slow.
As it turned out, there were caves everywhere in the canyon. Previously, those people must have stayed in the caves to avoid the cold, and only came out when the cold wind blew past.

Obviously, Ling Han wasn’t the only one who had realized how terrifying the cold wind was. Of course, it was also possible that others had seen that someone had been implicated, and had thus learnt their lesson.
Ling Han also stepped into the canyon. He could see very clearly that there was a cave about every thirty meters or so on either side of the canyon. It wasn’t very deep, at most six meters.
The moment he entered, he immediately discovered that the gravity here was astonishingly strong. To say nothing of flying, even walking on snow was incredibly difficult.
No wonder those people in front were so slow.
Could the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower resist this gravity?
Ling Han summoned the precious tower again, and felt his whole body become light, ready to fly at any time.
As expected of the embryonic form of the Imperial Weapon. It was too awesome.

Ling Han didn’t dare to use it. Although the precious tower kept a low profile, if he could move freely here with the precious tower, wouldn’t that be telling others that this precious tool was an amazing item?
He put away the precious tower again, and walked forwards in the snow, slowly and steadily.
In any case, everyone’s speed was the same, so it didn’t matter.
After walking for less than ten minutes, hu, a strong gust of wind whistled, and instantly, a bone-deep chill assaulted him.
That strange wind was coming again.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and hurriedly searched for a cave to shelter himself from the wind.
The people in front were not idle either. They too stepped aside, and entered into the mountain cave.
In just a short while, the cold wind surged past madly. Even in the cave, Ling Han felt a bone-deep chill assault him, causing him to shiver.
Cold, it was really cold. If he was blown by the cold wind head-on, would he directly be turned into an ice statue?
This was extremely likely.

After the cold wind passed, Ling Han exited the cave and continued his journey. He had to walk out of this canyon as soon as possible. Otherwise, if he kept being blown by the cold wind like this, it would affect his speed too much. He had wonderful ideas but reality was cruel. Without the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he couldn’t go any faster.
He tried to summon the flame energy, but with a gust of cold wind, it was directly extinguished.
F*ck!’
The coldness here was so terrifying?
Ling Han channeled the Starlight Screen, and this was much better. The gravity had decreased greatly, causing his speed to increase explosively.

Most people could only move one step at a time, but Ling Han could jump. With a single leap, he could cover more than six meters. It couldn’t compare to being outside, but in here, this was already considered godly speed.

He soon surpassed a blue-robed young man. The latter stared at his back for a while, and did not make a move, but when he surpassed another red-robed young man, he was attacked by the latter.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚

in this place, everyone was a competitor, and only twelve spots could be won. Boom, that young man in red robes was very overbearing. He waved his hand and shot out a golden fist force, with multiple seals flickering.

Ling Han humphed, and also shot out a punch, but it was very ordinary. “You’re seeking death!” the red-robed young man said with a sneer. He hadn’t even formed a seal in his power, so how powerful could it be?

Peng, the two powers clashed, and energy exploded. A large amount of accumulated snow was sent flying, and the expression of the young man in red robes changed drastically. His opponent’s punch was extremely solid, and directly shattered his force, continuing to attack him.
It was too fast, there was no way to dodge.
Peng, he was sent flying, and his figure drew an arc in midair, crashing heavily into the mountain wall. Then, he fell headfirst into the accumulated snow.
Before Ling Han could decide how he was going to deal with this guy, hu, a coldness rose up abruptly, and that super cold wind came again.
Ling Han hurriedly found a place to hide and leaped into the mountain cave. The cold wind came and went at an astonishing speed, and he couldn’t delay at all.
“Aiya, there’s another outside.” Only at this moment did he remember that there was another young man in red robes outside.
When the cold wind blew past, Ling Han walked out of the cave, and saw that the young man in red had already turned into an ice statue, without the slightest sign of life.

No matter what, this was still a one-star genius, or a prodigy whose battle prowess was comparable to a one-star genius, and he had died just like that. He had brought this upon himself. Who asked him to be so cruel?

Ling Han did not feel much sympathy, but he frowned. It was said that a one-star genius was already qualified to join a Holy Land, but they had entered here to carry out the final competition, and there was a risk of death, yet the Holy Land did not care in the slightest.
Was this really a selection process for talented recruits?

A great many people suddenly appeared in the canyon, advancing forwards, but their speed was extremely slow.
As it turned out, there were caves everywhere in the canyon.
Previously, those people must have stayed in the caves to avoid the cold, and only came out when the cold wind blew past.
Obviously, Ling Han wasn’t the only one who had realized how terrifying the cold wind was.
Of course, it was also possible that others had seen that someone had been implicated, and had thus learnt their lesson.
Ling Han also stepped into the canyon.
He could see very clearly that there was a cave about every thirty meters or so on either side of the canyon.
It wasn’t very deep, at most six meters.
The moment he entered, he immediately discovered that the gravity here was astonishingly strong.
To say nothing of flying, even walking on snow was incredibly difficult.
No wonder those people in front were so slow.
Could the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower resist this gravity?
Ling Han summoned the precious tower again, and felt his whole body become light, ready to fly at any time.
As expected of the embryonic form of the Imperial Weapon.
It was too awesome.
Ling Han didn’t dare to use it.
Although the precious tower kept a low profile, if he could move freely here with the precious tower, wouldn’t that be telling others that this precious tool was an amazing item?
He put away the precious tower again, and walked forwards in the snow, slowly and steadily.
In any case, everyone’s speed was the same, so it didn’t matter.
After walking for less than ten minutes, hu, a strong gust of wind whistled, and instantly, a bone-deep chill assaulted him.
That strange wind was coming again.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and hurriedly searched for a cave to shelter himself from the wind.
The people in front were not idle either.
They too stepped aside, and entered into the mountain cave.
In just a short while, the cold wind surged past madly.
Even in the cave, Ling Han felt a bone-deep chill assault him, causing him to shiver.
Cold, it was really cold.
If he was blown by the cold wind head-on, would he directly be turned into an ice statue?
This was extremely likely.
After the cold wind passed, Ling Han exited the cave and continued his journey.
He had to walk out of this canyon as soon as possible.
Otherwise, if he kept being blown by the cold wind like this, it would affect his speed too much.
He had wonderful ideas but reality was cruel.
Without the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he couldn’t go any faster.
He tried to summon the flame energy, but with a gust of cold wind, it was directly extinguished.
F*ck!’
The coldness here was so terrifying?
Ling Han channeled the Starlight Screen, and this was much better.
The gravity had decreased greatly, causing his speed to increase explosively.
Most people could only move one step at a time, but Ling Han could jump.
With a single leap, he could cover more than six meters.
It couldn’t compare to being outside, but in here, this was already considered godly speed.
He soon surpassed a blue-robed young man.
The latter stared at his back for a while, and did not make a move, but when he surpassed another red-robed young man, he was attacked by the latter.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
in this place, everyone was a competitor, and only twelve spots could be won.
Boom, that young man in red robes was very overbearing.
He waved his hand and shot out a golden fist force, with multiple seals flickering.
Ling Han humphed, and also shot out a punch, but it was very ordinary.
“You’re seeking death!” the red-robed young man said with a sneer.
He hadn’t even formed a seal in his power, so how powerful could it be?
Peng, the two powers clashed, and energy exploded.
A large amount of accumulated snow was sent flying, and the expression of the young man in red robes changed drastically.
His opponent’s punch was extremely solid, and directly shattered his force, continuing to attack him.
It was too fast, there was no way to dodge.
Peng, he was sent flying, and his figure drew an arc in midair, crashing heavily into the mountain wall.
Then, he fell headfirst into the accumulated snow.
Before Ling Han could decide how he was going to deal with this guy, hu, a coldness rose up abruptly, and that super cold wind came again.
Ling Han hurriedly found a place to hide and leaped into the mountain cave.
The cold wind came and went at an astonishing speed, and he couldn’t delay at all.
“Aiya, there’s another outside.” Only at this moment did he remember that there was another young man in red robes outside.
When the cold wind blew past, Ling Han walked out of the cave, and saw that the young man in red had already turned into an ice statue, without the slightest sign of life.
No matter what, this was still a one-star genius, or a prodigy whose battle prowess was comparable to a one-star genius, and he had died just like that.
He had brought this upon himself.
Who asked him to be so cruel?
Ling Han did not feel much sympathy, but he frowned.

It was said that a one-star genius was already qualified to join a Holy Land, but they had entered here to carry out the final competition, and there was a risk of death, yet the Holy Land did not care in the slightest.
Was this really a selection process for talented recruits?

chapters.title: Chapter 3676: Meeting the Seventh Imperial Prince again
paragraphs: Chapter 3676: Meeting the Seventh Imperial Prince again
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han shook his head, and continued onwards.
After walking for a while, the sky gradually darkened. The cold winds stopped blowing, but the temperature in the canyon dropped drastically, and by the looks of it, it would continue to drop.
Ling Han decided not to continue the journey. Instead, he would find a cave to stay in for the night, to avoid this super low temperature.
The moment he entered the cave, the coldness had indeed subsided considerably.

Ling Han tried to start a fire, but the temperature here was so low that even wood couldn’t burn. He took out rations, wanting to barbeque them with high-level flames, but that was too powerful, directly burning the rations into ashes.
Ling Han had no choice but to absorb the power of heaven and earth to replenish his energy. Although it was weak, it was better than nothing.
However, this power of heaven and earth also seemed to have been frozen. There was only one word for it—cold.

Ling Han closed his eyes to rest. There were still people continuing their journey outside. This was a great opportunity for them to surpass others. If they were not careful, they could possibly die here.

One, two, there were quite a number of people who passed by this cave. Some would come in for a temporary rest, but they sat at the entrance of the cave, maintaining a very great distance from Ling Han.
One couldn’t be unguarded against others. Everyone here was a competitor.
Ling Han didn’t react at all. As long as others didn’t provoke him, he couldn’t be bothered to make a move either.
With his observations of this Mystery Realm, going out was not something that could be done in a day or two.
There was no hurry. He would take things slowly.

People came and went. Ling Han could see very clearly that those who tried to be brave all had pale faces, and a great amount of coldness was accumulated in their internal organs. Once it exploded, it would definitely be fatal.
Even if it didn’t explode, it would still bury a seed of illness, and cause endless trouble in the future.

After a while, the sky had completely darkened, and the temperature had also dropped to rock bottom. No one dared to force themselves to continue their journey, and they all sought out caves to avoid the cold.
Shua, a figure flashed past, and another person had already appeared in the cave.
Yi, ya?
Ling Han was surprised. There was actually such a coincidence in this world!
This person was actually the Seventh Imperial Prince.
“Get out!” the Seventh Imperial Prince stated calmly. His voice was not loud, but it was filled with pressure.

He was used to being an Imperial Prince. Even though he had come to the Holy Land of Metal Element, where there were many people whose backgrounds were not inferior to his, or even superior to his in fact, it was still difficult for him to restrain his arrogance.
Since he had encountered him, he would settle the score.
“Why?” Ling Han asked, his tone similarly calm.
The Seventh Imperial Prince humphed, “Either get out, or die!”

Ling Han shrugged and said, “It’s so cold outside right now, so going out will only lead to death. What difference does it make whether I go out or not? Moreover, I arrived here first, so don’t you think that’s going too far?”

“What do you mean by going too far? My abilities are stronger than yours, so I can do as I please.” The Seventh Imperial Prince was impatient, “If you do not go out, your only fate would be death. If you go out, there is still a chance of survival. Make your choice.”
Ling Han shook his head, “How would I know if your strength is not just empty boasting? Who knows, you may just be trash.”
“Fine, if you insist on courting death, I’ll oblige you!” The Seventh Imperial Prince finally became impatient. He glared at Ling Han, and Spiritual Power instantly surged out.
Ling Han only acted as if he had not noticed, and asked, “Why are you glaring at me?”
Yi?

The Seventh Imperial Prince was startled. He had shot out Spiritual Power, and his original intention was to destroy the other’s divine sense. He was an elite of Spiritual Power, and killing someone could be done with a single thought, but not only had Ling Han Han not died, he did not even have the slightest reaction. This was too strange.
He wasn’t stupid, and he immediately said with a sneer, “Fine, so you’re pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger!”

Even if the other party wasn’t an elite of Spiritual Power, he must have also cultivated a secret technique of stabilizing his divine sense, or carried a precious tool that could defend against attacks to divine sense.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I already said that you only know how to boast. As expected.”
The Seventh Imperial Prince was unmoved. With a thought, xiu, xiu, xiu, dozens of short swords instantly appeared, slashing towards Ling Han.
Ling Han spread out his Spiritual Power to form a net, blocking all these short swords.
This wasn’t a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, and it was completely dependent on whose Spiritual Power was stronger. The stronger one would be able to gain control.
“What!” The Seventh Imperial Prince was finally stunned. This was the most direct contest of Spiritual Power, and the result was that the other was not the slightest bit inferior to himself.
This masked man was actually also an elite of Spiritual Power!
He frowned deeply, and a sliver of regret welled up in him. If he had known earlier, he would have preferred to be a little slower, and spend the night in a cave some way behind.
Right now, the temperature had already dropped to rock bottom. If he left, he would definitely die.
“All right, I have approved of your strength. You can rest here.” The Seventh Imperial Prince nodded.

Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “You are too funny. I was the one who came here first in the first place, so what need is there for you to give alms? Furthermore, I have not acknowledged your strength, so how could a piece of trash like you be worthy of staying with me?”
“You’re so arrogant!” the Seventh Imperial Prince said balefully.

“With strength, you naturally can be arrogant!” Ling Han moved. Xiu, xiu, xiu! The Lightning Fist was activated, and instantly, multiple punches shot towards the Seventh Imperial Prince at an incredibly fast speed.

“Yi?” The Seventh Imperial Prince’s expression was filled with surprise. Of course, he was not shocked by how powerful the Lightning Fist was. In truth, this fist technique was still quite extraordinary in the mortal level, but in the Celestial Path level, it could only be considered extremely ordinary.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have gifted it to Ling Han in the first place.
He naturally recognized this fist technique, and it was precisely because of this that he was surprised.
Could it be that it was… impossible!
That person had not set foot on the Celestial Path, and had not received any invitation either, so how could he possibly appear here?
“Have you thought of something?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“You, you, you?” The Seventh Imperial Prince’s face was filled with disbelief.
“That’s right. I’m here.” Ling Han removed his mask.
Pu, it really was him!
The Seventh Imperial Prince’s mouth was wide open, completely big enough to fit an egg.

Though he had already guessed this, he did not think that there was the slightest possibility of it, but when he saw Ling Han standing in front of him, alive and well, he was so shocked that his scalp went numb.
How was this possible?
Why had Ling Han appeared here?
Had he seen wrongly?
Had he seen a ghost?
“Why are you here?” The Seventh Imperial Prince still asked.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
“You don’t have to worry about that,” Ling Han said calmly. “Now, let’s continue the previous topic. I don’t think you have the right to stay with me. Are you getting lost or not?”

“Ling Han, though your natural talent in cultivation is freakish, after advancing into Celestial Path, it is practically impossible for you to surpass your cultivation level to battle me.” The Seventh Imperial Prince attempted to convince Ling Han, “If you fight me to the death, even if you can defeat me, you yourself would not be able to gain any advantage, and would definitely be severely injured.”

In this year, he had been cultivating in the Holy Land, and had received too many benefits. He had already cultivated to the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation. Ling Han, on the other hand, must have just advanced into Celestial Path, and there was a massive gap in their cultivation levels.
“Hehe, why don’t you give it a try!” Ling Han attacked again, blasting towards the Seventh Imperial Prince.
This time, he was finally serious. A terrifying power surged. That was a power that could easily crush even a peak stage Heavenly Dao Foundation.
Peng!
With this strike, the Seventh Imperial Prince instantly threw up blood madly.
The gap in strength was as wide as could be..

chapters.title: Chapter 3677: Unavoidable Death
paragraphs: Chapter 3677: Unavoidable Death
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“How could you possibly be so strong!” The Seventh Imperial Prince said as he coughed up blood.
He was at the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation, and only needed some time to accumulate enough power, and he could already attempt to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation.

Furthermore, above Celestial Path, the gap between prodigies would shrink considerably. He was also a one-star genius, so how could he possibly be so different from someone who had just entered Celestial Path?
He was dissatisfied. He was the son of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and who was Ling Han? Could he compare to him?
But now, he had been easily defeated by Ling Han.
“Because I am a prodigy,” Ling Han said smilingly, and delivered a slap. Pa, the Seventh Imperial Prince once again threw up blood.
The Seventh Imperial Prince almost exploded in fury at this reply. This was really a vile character that had achieved success.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Seventh, I am very disappointed in you.”
W-what?
The Seventh Imperial Prince’s eyes widened. What kind of tone was that? Are you my elder, to actually use such a tone to speak of me?

“As your granduncle, bullying a junior like you is a bit demeaning, but who asked you to do too many bad things? Merely on account of the matter of slaughtering Huju City, I can’t possibly spare you,” Ling Han said.
The Seventh Imperial Prince was both furious and anxious. Are you treating me like your grandson?
Damn it! Damn it! He was already over a hundred years old, yet was treated as a junior by a wet-behind-the-ears brat!
“Ling Han, you want to offend your superior?” the Seventh Imperial Prince called out. He was filled with fear. This was not Celestial Sea Planet, nor was it the Imperial Capital.
Pa, Ling Han slapped him across the face, “I already told you, I am your granduncle, and you dare to speak to me in this tone?”𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶

The Seventh Imperial Prince glared at him, “Not only have you insulted me, you have even insulted my father. How dare you, a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator actually dares to humiliate a Spirit Transformation True Lord!”
Pa, the sound of a slap was crisp.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Why haven’t you learnt your lesson yet? I already said that I’m your granduncle.”

The Seventh Imperial Prince glared angrily at Ling Han. He swore that once he returned to Celestial Sea Planet, he would definitely report this to Chen Fengyan. Ling Han was really unbelievably arrogant. Did he think that just because he had received the favour of the Emperor, he could do as he liked?
You were able to stand in a high position because you had gained the favour of the Emperor, but the moment you fell out of favor, you would be trash.

-Old Seventh, for Chen Fengyan’s sake, you’ve repeatedly targeted me, but I can let you off the hook for those matters,” Ling Han said with a serious expression. “However, your mistake was slaughtering Huju City. This is a complete act of inhumanity. If I spare your life, how can I face those who died unjustly?”
The Seventh Imperial Prince gaped, as if he could not believe this. After a while, he finally said, “You are actually going to kill me for the deaths of some lowly commoners?”

“Lowly commoners?” Ling Han shook his head, “You don’t understand!” There were countless living beings in the dimensions inside his body. By the standards of this world, all of them were incredibly lowly, but the combined beliefs of countless lowly people allowed Ling Han to create a miracle of cultivation. This was the power of the weak.
“You can’t kill me! You can’t!” the Seventh Imperial Prince shouted harshly. He was an Imperial Prince, an Imperial Prince!
He was filled with extreme regret. If he hadn’t wanted to capture Ling Han back then, and if he hadn’t acted without hesitation, how could he have ended up like today?

He was filled with resentment. He was an outstanding talent that was destined to do great things, and his father was also a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Yet, he had to die at the hands of a Human Dao Foundation cultivator. He felt wronged, and he felt aggrieved. He was unwilling to accept this.
-Ah!” he roared madly, his eyes glaring furiously at Ling Han, as if he wanted to kill the latter with a single look.
He didn’t want to die. He really didn’t want to die.
Ling Han was unmoved. He sent out a palm strike, and Destructive Energy boiled. With only a surge, the Seventh Imperial Prince was immediately annihilated, as if he had never existed.
Though this could not be considered a very strong opponent, Ling Han still felt an indescribable ease.
He had avenged the wronged deaths of a city’s citizens, and it was as if a burden had been lifted from his shoulders.
He closed his eyes to rest, and formation patterns floated in his mind, continuously evolving.

Now, whenever he was free, he would study formation patterns. Alchemy was no big deal to him, but he was much worse in the art of formations, though he was actually very talented in formations as well.
A night passed, and Ling Han didn’t waste any time. He cultivated for half an hour before trying to walk out of the cave.
Cold.
Ling Han shuddered upon seeing this. Even the Starlight Screen that he had channeled out was unable to resist the invasion of the frosty aura. He was unable to leave this place.
In the canyon, the sun appeared especially late. Only after more than an hour did the first ray of sunlight shine down.
Ling Han made another attempt, and this time, the coldness had subsided considerably. Though it was still very cold, it was already tolerable.

He walked out, and jumped in the snow, leaving behind deep footprints. Hu, not long after, a cold wind howled over, and the temperature instantly dropped drastically. Everyone hurriedly found a cave to avoid the cold, and returned to the rhythm of yesterday.
After walking for an entire day, Ling Han still hadn’t walked out of the valley. When night fell, he had no choice but to find a cave to spend the night in.
“Scram!” Unexpectedly, there were two other people in the cave. When they saw him, one of the men in white immediately shouted.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “It’s a big place, so one more person wouldn’t make a difference.”
“It doesn’t matter, it’s up to me to decide!” the white-robed man said with a humph. His face was filled with disdain.
Ling Han wasn’t reserved anymore, and said, “This cave isn’t owned by your family, and you want me to leave? Hehe.”
-If you don’t leave, then I’ll chase you out.” The white-robed man strode over. Boom, the violent aura in his body surged out, “A mere Human Dao Foundation, I can crush you with a single finger!”
He indeed had the right to be arrogant, because he was a one-star genius and had the cultivation level of Heavenly Dao Foundation.
A Heavenly Dao Foundation was invincible, so how could he possibly take a Human Dao Foundation cultivator seriously?
His aura alone was enough to suppress Ling Han.
However, when the surging aura surged past, it did not have the slightest effect.
-Yi?” The white-robed man showed a hint of surprise, but he immediately showed a hint of pride. If his aura could not be suppressed, he would use the cornerstone of the Celestial Path.

-Your willpower can be tempered to become incredibly tenacious, but the suppression of the foundation stone of Heavenly Dao on the foundation stone of Human Dao was the difference of cultivation level, and could not be avoided.

Weng, he released the foundation stone of the Celestial Path. Golden light flickered, and there was an endlessly powerful aura exuding from him. Competing with the foundation stones of the Celestial Path?

Ling Han also drew out his own cornerstone of the Celestial Path. The Celestial Foundation that he had built to imitate that primitive Celestial Gate was plain and unadorned, like a stubborn rock that could be seen anywhere, but the aura it exuded was enough to make an Ultimate Dao Foundation tremble.
A Human Dao Foundation actually dared to compete with him in Celestial Foundation?

The white-robed man almost spluttered in laughter, but it was only an instant, and he gave a muffled humph. Not only was his aura completely suppressed, even the cornerstone of his Celestial Path was trembling, as if it was about to shatter.
F***, what was going on here?

He was at the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation, and only needed some time to accumulate enough power, and he could already attempt to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation.
Furthermore, above Celestial Path, the gap between prodigies would shrink considerably.
He was also a one-star genius, so how could he possibly be so different from someone who had just entered Celestial Path?
He was dissatisfied.
He was the son of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and who was Ling Han?
Could he compare to him?
But now, he had been easily defeated by Ling Han.
“Because I am a prodigy,” Ling Han said smilingly, and delivered a slap.
Pa, the Seventh Imperial Prince once again threw up blood.
The Seventh Imperial Prince almost exploded in fury at this reply.
This was really a vile character that had achieved success.

W-what?

What kind of tone was that?
Are you my elder, to actually use such a tone to speak of me?
“As your granduncle, bullying a junior like you is a bit demeaning, but who asked you to do too many bad things?
Merely on account of the matter of slaughtering Huju City, I can’t possibly spare you,” Ling Han said.
The Seventh Imperial Prince was both furious and anxious.
Are you treating me like your grandson?
Damn it!
Damn it!
He was already over a hundred years old, yet was treated as a junior by a wet-behind-the-ears brat!
“Ling Han, you want to offend your superior?” the Seventh Imperial Prince called out.
He was filled with fear.
This was not Celestial Sea Planet, nor was it the Imperial Capital.

The Seventh Imperial Prince glared at him, “Not only have you insulted me, you have even insulted my father.

Pa, the sound of a slap was crisp.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Why haven’t you learnt your lesson yet?
I already said that I’m your granduncle.”
The Seventh Imperial Prince glared angrily at Ling Han.
He swore that once he returned to Celestial Sea Planet, he would definitely report this to Chen Fengyan.
Ling Han was really unbelievably arrogant.
Did he think that just because he had received the favour of the Emperor, he could do as he liked?
You were able to stand in a high position because you had gained the favour of the Emperor, but the moment you fell out of favor, you would be trash.
-Old Seventh, for Chen Fengyan’s sake, you’ve repeatedly targeted me, but I can let you off the hook for those matters,” Ling Han said with a serious expression.

This was the power of the weak.

He was an Imperial Prince, an Imperial Prince!

He was filled with resentment.
He was an outstanding talent that was destined to do great things, and his father was also a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
Yet, he had to die at the hands of a Human Dao Foundation cultivator.
He felt wronged, and he felt aggrieved.
He was unwilling to accept this.
-Ah!” he roared madly, his eyes glaring furiously at Ling Han, as if he wanted to kill the latter with a single look.
He didn’t want to die.
He really didn’t want to die.

Cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 3678: Extremely Two-faced
paragraphs: Chapter 3678: Extremely Two-faced
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin. People always thought that he was easy to bully because of his low cultivation level, but this kind of person would usually end up in tragedy.
He clenched his fist, and greeted the other’s attack.
Peng!
The two forces collided, and the white-robed man’s body was instantly pushed back. Then, he was pushed back continuously.
What!
Putting aside the fact that he did not dare believe it, even the other yellow-robed man felt the same. His mouth was half-gaping, and he almost spluttered.
What was going on here? A weakling that was merely a Human Dao Foundation was actually able to send a one-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation flying with a single punch?
“Who are you?” the white-robed man asked. “Liu Jin from the Flying Star Sect? Zheng Xiaotian from the Storm Galaxy? Dao Child Han Yun from the Nine Underworlds?”

The people he was talking about were all recognized as well-known figures of the younger generation in the galaxy. It was said that they could even defeat a three-star genius at the same cultivation level. Their natural talent was unimaginably powerful.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “What is it? Do you want to form relations now?”

“Don’t be too smug. I may not lose to you!” The white-robed man was cold. Even if Ling Han was a four-star genius, he was only invincible against Heavenly Dao Foundation. He was a one-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and definitely wouldn’t lose to Ling Han.
He moved again, launching an attack at Ling Han.
This time, he was going all out, using a celestial technique. High-level energy surged out, and masses of silver seals dispersed, blasting towards Ling Han.
Ling Han merely tapped out a finger, and it was done very easily.
Celestial Crossing Finger.
This was a celestial technique, but its grade wasn’t high. Since it was given out as a reward by the Holy Land of Metal Element, it naturally couldn’t be all that valuable.
But in Ling Han’s hands, even if it was a celestial technique that was not considered a high-level celestial technique, it still exploded with astonishing might.
Pu! The white-robed man’s attack instantly crumbled as the force of Ling Han’s tap swept over. However, the force from Ling Han’s finger didn’t dissipate, continuing to attack the white-robed man.

The white-robed man hurriedly retreated. However, this cave was narrow, so he could only retreat and not dodge left and right. Thus, he actually couldn’t escape either. He could only roar and throw a series of punches. After a few consecutive punches, he finally dispersed the force of Ling Han’s finger completely.
Both he and the yellow-robed man paled in shock. How could there be such a powerful Human Dao Foundation?
Ling Han smiled, and put away the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, “Don’t say that I am bullying you.”
The cornerstone of the Celestial Path retracted, and the white-robed man was no longer suppressed. His battle prowess recovered completely.
“Arrogance!” The white-robed man humphed, yet thought that Ling Han was an idiot, not exploiting his advantage.
This should be the heir of a great sect, or even the likes of Dao Child, but it was obvious that he had just travelled the world, so his brain was still not very bright.
He couldn’t help but feel his heart throb wildly. This kind of Dao Child should possess an astonishing rare treasure, right?
He would snatch it!
He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han, wanting to apprehend Ling Han swiftly.
However, just as he was about to rush over, Ling Han revealed a mischievous grin.
The cornerstone of the Celestial Path had reappeared!
Instantly, the white-robed man’s strength plummeted.
‘You, f*ck, f*ck, f*ck!’

A string of curses raced through the white-robed man’s mind. To think that he had thought that Ling Han was a naive and hot-blooded youth who didn’t know how to make use of his advantages. Who would’ve thought that he was the one who was so foolish and naive?
Two-faced, he was really too f*cking two-faced, he was practically screwing him over!
Peng! Ling Han threw a punch, which landed on the white-robed man’s face. The latter screamed in pain, and instantly collapsed to the ground.

If his battle prowess had been suppressed all this while, he wouldn’t have been in such a miserable state. However, he had clearly calculated his strength, and all his attacks were based on this. Yet, the benchmark had suddenly changed. How could this not cause him to panic and lose his balance?
That was why he had said that Ling Han was screwing him over.
“You are too treacherous!” The other yellow-robed man rebuked loudly.
Ling Han shrugged, and said with a smile, “Eve thought about it. If I don’t use my advantages, I’ll be called a fool by you guys. Thus, I’ve decided not to pretend to be a fool.”
‘F*ck you,’ the white-robed man wanted to cry as Ling Han stepped on him.
As it turned out, he was the idiot here.
“Hand over all your belongings. Otherwise, I’ll throw you guys out for a breath of fresh air,” Ling Han said calmly.
You? Are you robbing us?
“What’s with that look?” Ling Han asked in displeasure. “Hurry up. My patience is limited.”
The white-robed man had no choice but to look at his companion for help.
“Sir, you have gone too far!” The yellow-robed man could not tolerate this. He drew out a sword, which was instantly activated, and instantly, a cold light flickered.
He charged towards Ling Han, wanting to save his companion.
Ling Han didn’t worry about the white-robed man fleeing. The outside of this cave could directly freeze someone to death. If he wanted to die, he could do as he liked.
He stepped hard. Peng, his figure shot out, greeting the yellow-robed man.
“Ah—” The white-robed man screamed, his expression plaintive. ‘If you want to fight, just fight. Why do you have to step on me? My bones are about to break.’
Ling Han stepped forwards, and shot out a punch.
The yellow-robed man guarded against him using the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to suppress him. This strike was actually 30% offensive and 70% defensive.

However, Ling Han had absolutely no intention of using the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to suppress others. He activated the Starlight Screen, and just like that, crashed directly into the sword light, and then punched out directly.
Peng! With a single strike, the yellow-robed man was sent flying, crashing heavily into the cave wall.
Thankfully, this mountain rock was extraordinarily sturdy. Otherwise, with such a collision, even ordinary mountains would crumble.
At first, the white-robed man had still been cursing Ling Han for being treacherous and devious, but after seeing this scene, he had completely lost all his temper.
Even if he didn’t screw him over, he was still no match for him in a head-on confrontation.
How could there be such a terrifying person?
Even if it was a four-star genius, even if he was stronger than them, he would at least have to go through a tough battle to be able to defeat them. How could it be so easy?
A five, five-star genius?
“I’ll repeat it again. It’s a robbery,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The two of them yielded. This gap in strength was really too wide. They were completely no match for him.
Those who understood practicality were prodigies.
They all took out their Spatial Spirit Tool, and handed them over to Ling Han.
Ling Han accepted it, and swept a glance over it with his divine sense. Involuntarily, he couldn’t help but smile in satisfaction, “Not bad, not bad. Your background is quite rich.”
The two of them wanted to cry. They had really never seen such a prodigy actually rob someone in such a public setting.
Did he have any shame?
But looking at the mask on Ling Han’s face, it was clear that this guy was shameless.
They didn’t dare to make a sound. Right now, Ling Han was only trying to rob them of their wealth. What if he wanted to kill them?
Ling Han naturally didn’t hold back, occupying a spot deep inside the cave. He had the white-robed and yellow-robed men stand guard outside, while he closed his eyes to rest.

Seeing how Ling Han looked like he was sleeping soundly, the white-robed man and his companion were both slightly tempted. Should they take the chance to make a move and kill Ling Han? Not only would they be able to take back their losses, they would also be able to take revenge.
But when they recalled the gap in strength between them and Ling Han, they exchanged a look, and both shook their heads, dismissing this wonderful idea.
What if this was a trap that Ling Han had dug out for them?
This wouldn’t be the first time that they had been tricked..

chapters.title: Chapter 3679: What a coincidence
paragraphs: Chapter 3679: What a coincidence
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The night passed, and the sun had just risen.
Whether it was Ling Han or the other two men, they were all sitting cross-legged and cultivating.

Sitting cross-legged was only a common form of cultivation. It did not mean that this was absolutely necessary for cultivation. Some people were used to cultivating while running. Unless there was a special restriction on cultivation techniques, they could completely choose any form they liked when cultivating.
Ordinarily speaking, this kind of cross-legged position was the most suitable for calming one’s mental state, so it was the most widely used.

After the cultivation ended, the two men’s expressions were filled with anxiety. They couldn’t wait for the sunlight to shine on them, so that they could leave Ling Han in time. If they stayed for another second, they were afraid that they would be screwed over again.
Thus, when the first ray of sunlight shone over, the two of them ran as if their behinds had been bitten by a dog.
Was he really that terrifying?
Ling Han reflected for a moment, smiled, and also left through the cave.

This canyon was astonishingly long, and their speed was really too slow. Another day passed, and Ling Han still found a cave to avoid the cold. This time, he found a cave with no one, but very soon, someone appeared, his attitude domineering, demanding that he get out.
Against this kind of person, Ling Han did not have any reservations. He directly moved to suppress them, then ransacked them. His gains were not too bad.
He couldn’t help but feel his heart palpitate. This was a way to earn money.
In the next few days, he encountered a great many ignorant people, and the result was the same. They were all suppressed by him, robbed, and there was no exception.
Soon, there was a legend in the valley. There was a masked man who specialized in robbery, and his actions were extremely terrible.
This caused the other people who were also wearing masks to unfortunately be implicated, and besieged by a great many people. That was because everyone knew that this masked man was very “rich”.
Ling Han was naturally no exception either. He was targeted by some people, but he could oppose even Ultimate Dao Foundation, so who would he be afraid of?
Another five days later, they finally walked out of this canyon.

The temperature rapidly rose again. Though it was still a world of ice and snow, it was already within tolerable limits. There was no cold wind that assaulted them, forcing them to find a cave to hide in.
This was a plain that was not too big, and there was a tall mountain ahead of them.
There was an Ice Origin Stone on the mountain!
Ling Han sped up. This was a treasure that he was determined to obtain. With the help of the Ice Origin Stone, the empress and the others could quickly catch up to him in terms of cultivation level.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

In fact, Ling Han had only channeled an ordinary Celestial Crossing Finger.

My father is a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and you have only just entered into Celestial Path. How could that be possible?

W-what?

chapters.title: Chapter 3680: Even robbing me?
paragraphs: Chapter 3680: Even robbing me?
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
‘Aren’t you my elder? Didn’t you come to save me?’
Why was it that even he wanted to rob him now?
The Eldest Imperial Prince gaped widely, an expression of disbelief on his face.
He had never seen this kind of “elder” before. He even wanted to rob his own juniors. F***.

“What is it? Reluctant?” Ling Han glared at him, “If I had not saved you, would you have been able to save your own life? Furthermore, what if one of these people has a special fondness for a$$-r@ping? Just think, how terrible would that be?”
The other six hurriedly shook their heads. None of them had any abnormal sexual orientation. They definitely would not be interested in a man’s a**.
Ling Han looked at the six of them balefully, yet said calmly, “You guys have to think carefully. Are you interested in men or not?”
This… was a blatant threat.
The six of them had no choice but to nod. Looking at how Ling Han was acting, he was going to make a move at the slightest disagreement.
Forget it. For the sake of their own life, they had best make a sacrifice. In any case, no one would know.
They all nodded instead of shaking their heads.

“Hiss, so many gays!” Ling Han pretended to be stunned, then clapped a hand on the Eldest Imperial Prince’s shoulder, “I had thought that there was only one gay, but I had not thought that all six of them were gays. You see, it was fortunate that I had saved you, wasn’t it? Otherwise, if you had been ganged up on by so many people, just how miserable would you be?”
The Eldest Imperial Prince’s mouth was half-gaping. F***, there was absolutely no one that was interested in his a**. It was all forced out by you, all right?
But faced with Ling Han’s “abuse of authority”, what could he say?
He obediently handed over the Ice Origin Stone. Otherwise, if Ling Han searched him, he wouldn’t be able to keep it either.
Thus, he might as well take the initiative himself.

Ling Han broke into a smile, then patted the Eldest Imperial Prince’s shoulder, and said to the other six people, “This is my grand nephew. You all have to be more polite, or I will cause trouble for you at any time.”
The Eldest Imperial Prince’s expression was dark. Though he had not been beaten, the displeasure in his heart was not much inferior to the other six.
“Alright, I’m leaving. You don’t have to see me out.” Ling Han strode off.
Who would see you our? Who the hell would be seeing you out!
Including the Eldest Imperial Prince, everyone wanted nothing more than to rush up and stomp on Ling Han, but in reality, they could only watch as he left.
Ling Han continued to advance. By now, he should be the person walking in front, heading towards the second peak.
“Who would’ve thought? The Eldest Imperial Prince has actually advanced into the Heavenly Dao Foundation.”
“This cultivation speed is so fast!”
“Without enough Treasured Fruits of Life, how did he charge up?”
“Were they given by the Holy Land?”
“From this aspect, the Holy Lands are really willing to sacrifice a lot.”
“However, looking at the cruelty of this competition, it doesn’t seem to match the selection of talented people.”
“What on earth are they planning?”
Ling Han thought as he walked, but he wasn’t a roundworm in the Holy Land of Metal Element’s stomach, so how could he possibly know?
A day later, he arrived at the top of the second mountain peak.

The summit was very flat, covered with pure white snow, and in the snow, there was a large rock that stuck out extraordinarily, and there were a few small rocks that looked like ice cubes piled on top of it.
“Ice Origin Stone.”
Ling Han strode over, but after a few steps, he stopped in his tracks.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
“It’s protected by a formation!”
He murmured. Though he had not grasped Celestial Path Tier-level formation techniques, it was a piece of cake for him to discover the existence of a formation.
“Extraordinary.” Ling Han waved his hand, and instantly, patches of accumulated snow were sent flying, revealing the ground.

With the large rock as the centre, the ground was covered densely with multiple silver veined patterns. There seemed to be no pattern to it, but upon closer look, it seemed to conform to some kind of principle, causing one to be captivated and want to comprehend it.
Ling Han threw a rock over. The rock had not even landed, when a ray of light shot out. Pa, the rock was shattered.
“Judging by this attack, its might is probably the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation.”
Ling Han walked forwards in a daze. Merely by looking at it like this, there was no way he would be able to unravel the formation in this lifetime.
When he stepped onto the silver veined pattern, xiu, a flash of light instantly blasted towards him.

Ling Han clenched a fist to counter. Peng! The ray of light was instantly extinguished, but he also felt a slight pain in his fist, allowing him to directly realize that the battle prowess of the peak stage of Ultimate Dao Foundation should be able to match him.
However, before he could advance, xiu, xiu, xiu, three streaks of light shot out at the same time, striking towards him again.
These lights were all emitted from the veined patterns on the ground, so they were all from below, but from different angles.
Ling Han was unafraid, throwing punches continuously.
Peng, peng, peng! With just three punches, he destroyed the three attacks again.
However, before the first wave was over, another wave rose, and another nine streaks of light shot over.
Was there really no end to it?

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel interested. If he only wanted to study the secret of formations, he would die in the end. Now that he had entered into the formation, he thought that he could use this as a reference, and that should be able to enlighten him faster.
He activated the Starlight Screen, and xiu, xiu, xiu! Rays of light shot over. However, after they collided with the Starlight Screen, they all shattered, unable to take another step forward.

However, the Starlight Screen wasn’t omnipotent. After suffering nine attacks, cracks appeared on the light screen, and Ling Han needed to use his mystical power to repair them. The cracks quickly disappeared, and the price was naturally expending Ling Han’s mystical power.
The nine streaks of light were blocked, and next… there were 27 streaks of light!

Xiu, xiu, xiu! Rays of light shot out in unison. This time, they were much fiercer. Though they were all blocked by the Starlight Screen, the light screen also crumbled after it blocked them. There was absolutely no chance to mend it.

The mystical power used to repair the light screen was far smaller than activating the Starlight Screen again. Of course, what Ling Han lacked the least was mystical power reserves, which could completely challenge the mystical power of a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
After 21 flashes of light, there were 63 flashes!
This time, Ling Han didn’t dare to parry. He hurriedly retreated, or he would be riddled with holes.
Interesting.
Ling Han stepped into the formation again. This time, the light that he shot out became a single streak again, beginning a new cycle.

He knew that if he activated the Imminent Skyline, he would only be able to sustain three waves of light at most. In other words, he would only need to sustain nine beams of light at most. The Starlight Screen would be able to block all of them.
However, after taking away the Ice Origin Stone, would this formation still be effective?
Because this could possibly be a formation eye, the formation’s core. Once the core was gone, the formation’s might would naturally be gone.
For the sake of studying formations, Ling Han decided not to take the Ice Origin Stone first. In any case, it was his.
He walked onto the formation from different angles, and continuously attempted to do so.

As expected, leaning in isolation was far inferior to actual practice. Enlightenment continuously rose up in Ling Han’s heart. He felt that in another two to three days, he would definitely be able to master this formation.
And with the comprehension of one technique, it would aid comprehension of all techniques, and he would really have gained rudimentary mastery of formations.
Half a day passed very quickly.
Xiu, a figure suddenly leaped out, arriving at the summit.
This was a young man with a dignified aura. He was tall and sturdy, and his hair was very short, only an inch long. He exuded a capable and experienced aura.
“Scram!” He stared at Ling Han and spat out a word..

Enlightenment continuously rose up in Ling Han’s heart.
He felt that in another two to three days, he would definitely be able to master this formation.
And with the comprehension of one technique, it would aid comprehension of all techniques, and he would really have gained rudimentary mastery of formations.
Half a day passed very quickly.
Xiu, a figure suddenly leaped out, arriving at the summit.
This was a young man with a dignified aura.
He was tall and sturdy, and his hair was very short, only an inch long.
He exuded a capable and experienced aura.
“Scram!” He stared at Ling Han and spat out a word..
