paragraphs: Chapter 3681: Battling Ultimate Dao Foundation
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was currently studying formation techniques, and was completely focused. How could he be in the mood to pay attention to him?
The sturdy man couldn’t help but show a hint of anger, and said, “Are you seeking death?”
Lmg Han still ignored him. He was presently at a crucial point. Once he comprehended this stage, his grasp of this formation would definitely improve greatly.
“Howdare you!” the man roared in fury. He raised his palm and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.

Xiu, it just so happened that Ling Han had activated the formation, and 27 flashes of light shot out, shattering his Starlight Screen. Thus, faced with the blow from the sturdy man, Ling Han could only raise his fist in response, or he would be injured.
Peng! The punch landed, and that person’s palm strike was shattered. However, Ling Han also frowned slightly. Under the rebound of power, his fist hurt slightly.
He stepped out of the formation, and looked at the sturdy man, feeling very displeased.
Being disturbed by the other party, his thoughts were interrupted, and it just happened to be at this point, causing him to waste at least an hour’s time.
Humph, if you can’t crack the formation, then get lost!” the sturdy man said coldly.
Ling Han cocked his head at him, and said, “I’m in a bad mood right now.”

“So what? Do you want to hit me?” The sturdy man humphed. His name was Nangong Lin, and he was a one-star genius that had attained Ultimate Dao Foundation. If he hadn’t been tied down by a matter previously, how could he have come here so late?
However, it didn’t matter. He was already walking at the forefront, and all the Ice Origin Stones that came after would belong to him.
Beat you to the point that even your mother can’t recognize you.” Ling Han rushed out. He was presently in a very bad mood. He definitely had to find someone and give him a beating.

“A mere Human Dao Foundation dares to be insolent in front of me.” Nangong Lin smirked coldly, and pressed out a hand, intending to apprehend Ling Han. Boom, the two forces crashed into each other, instantly forming a great storm. Ling Han and Nangong Lin both took a few steps back at the same time, but if one were to compare, they would discover that Ling Han had taken a few more steps back.

He was already freakish. He was only in Human Dao Foundation, yet he was already capable of matching the peak stage of Ultimate Dao Foundation. However, no matter what, Nangong Lin was still a one-star genius. Logically speaking, he could be considered invincible in Ultimate Dao Foundation, so he was naturally stronger than Ling Han. Otherwise, there would really be no justice.

“En?” Nangong Lin’s expression suddenly became serious, but he immediately came to a realization, “I almost fell for your trick. You are definitely not Human Dao Foundation, but rather peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation, or even Ultimate Dao Foundation.”
How could there be such a strong Human Dao Foundation? Wouldn’t that have to be a six-star genius?
Looking at the galaxy nearby-not planets, the number of four-star geniuses wouldn’t exceed ten people, while six-star geniuses? Hehe.

“How devious. Are you trying to screw me over?” Nangong Lin looked furious. If he wasn’t Ultimate Dao Foundation, and was only building Heavenly Dao Foundation, would he have fallen into the latter’s trap due to his carelessness? Screw your sister!” Ling Han charged over again, and was still attacking head-on.
It didn’t matter that his power was slightly inferior. This wasn’t all of his battle prowess.
Ling Han unleashed the Celestial Crossing Finger. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Streaks of finger power shot toward Nangong Lin.
“Celestial Crossing Finger? Haha!” Nangong Lin smirked coldly, “Using such a weak celestial technique, Celestial Crossing Finger, to deal with me, where did you get such courage from?”
He also channeled a celestial technique. Multiple seals shone brilliantly, and as expected, the battle prowess he exploded with was even above Ling Han, immediately suppressing Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He wanted to defeat his opponent with the Celestial Crossing Finger, an ordinary celestial technique.
He activated his eye technique, and instantly, the surroundings appeared in another form in front of him.

Nangong Lin delivered a strike, and brilliance filled the skies, completely concealing the course of his attack. It had a strong confusion effect, and this was also the unique trait of the majority of celestial techniques. They would use this kind of method to hide the course of attack.
However, after Lmg Han activated his eye technique, no matter how brilliant the light was, it couldn’t cover his eyes.
Xiu, he tapped out a finger, and the force just happened to pass through the gap in Nangong Lin’s attack, and shot towards the latter’s neck.

Nangong Lin had never imagined that this attack would come. However, he was a one-star genius that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundation, after all. Thus, his ability to adapt was naturally powerful. He hurriedly turned his head to the ‘ side, dodging this attack.
Pu, blood spurted from the side of his neck, and he still did not manage to completely dodge this blow.
He flew into a thunderous rage. Just now, he had still been belittling Ling Han. In the end, Ling Han immediately made him bleed with a single strike.
This was a slap to the face.
He roared loudly. Boom! High-level energy surged, and he charged towards
Ling Han with black-colored energy.
Ling Han unleashed a barrage of murderous aura. Weng! Nangong Lin was instantly affected, and his attacks instantly became sluggish.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The Celestial Crossing Finger shot out, aimed directly at the weakest point of Nangong Ling’s defense.
Nangong Lin had no choice but to switch to defense. He would first deal with
the threat from the Celestial Crossing Finger.
He wanted to counterattack again, but the moment he launched an attack, he would be suppressed by the barrage of murderous aura, and could only be’ forced to switch to defense.
Combined with the barrage of murderous aura and eye technique, the Celestial Crossing Finger, an ordinary celestial technique, released a brilliant light.
Who would still dare to say that the Celestial Crossing Finger was not good enough?
Pu! Pu! Pu!
Nangong Lin was still continuously hit. Though it was only some superficial wounds, with some blood splashing out, it still caused him to fly into a thunderous rage.
“What about the Celestial Crossing Finger?” Ling Han asked calmly.

Nangong Lin was speechless. Although he knew that this wasn’t because the Celestial Crossing Finger was extraordinary, but rather because Ling Han had a technique that could affect his mind. Moreover, Ling Han’s insight was especially good, and he could always see through his attacks.
But so what? Wasn’t this Ling Han’s strength?
He wasn’t so shameless that he would demand that Ling Han could only battle
him with the Celestial Crossing Finger.
“Don’t be happy too soon,” Nangong Lin said coldly. He shook lightly, and a flash of white light surged out from his body. Then, it turned into a small white jade-like tower, glowing with light.

This was his precious tool, and it was quite extraordinary. It was forged from a Three Star material, and had great room for improvement. In future, when he became a great elite of Core Formation Tier, this white jade tower would naturally become a precious tool of Core Formation Tier-level.
Of course, this would need a very long time. Even if he was very confident, that
day would have to be at least a hundred years later.
How powerful would a One Star precious tool forged from a Three Star material be?
It was naturally no issue for him to sweep aside all his peers.

Weng, the precious tower trembled slightly, and an indescribable might circulated. It was like a great elite had severed his own cultivation level to cultivate again. Though his abilities would be limited by his cultivation level, in terms of quality, he had a crushing advantage.
Humph!” Nangong Lin regained his confidence, his expression filled with arrogance.
Lmg Han couldn’t help but wear a strange expression. A tower-shaped precious tool?
The Black Tower hated tower-shaped precious tools the most. After such a long time, Ling Han would naturally be affected as well.
Then let’s have a competition!

Ling Han also summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which floated above his head and exuded wisps of precious aura. However, because the precious tool kept a low profile, he couldn’t see anything special about it.
“You think you’re worthy of using a tower-shaped precious tool?” Nangong Lin sneered. “Go!” he shouted lightly, and immediately steered the precious tower towards Ling Han.
This was forged from a Three Star material, let’s see if I won’t smash you to death!

chapters.title: Chapter 3682: Comprehending formations
paragraphs: Chapter 3682: Comprehending formations
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Weng, the white jade tower spun lightly, yet was pressing down at an extremely fast speed.

This was forged from a Three Star material, and was naturally not something that an ordinary One Star precious tool could compare to. Immediately, a terrifying pressure pressed down on him. This was the might of the material itself, which was enough to suppress all One Star Spirit Tools.
However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t affected at all.
How was this possible!
Nangong Lin’s jaw dropped. He could not believe this at all.

This was his White Jade Demon Suppression Tower, forged from a Three Star material, and added with the fact that he had been tempering it day and night with his cultivation level of Ultimate Dao Foundation, to be fair, even he was no match for it.
But now?
It was completely ineffective!

He didn’t know that this was still because Ling Han had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower keep a low profile. Otherwise, with the might of the Origin Gold, it could completely suppress three-star ingredients in terms of quality, and it wasn’t impossible for it to make a three-star material self- destruct even.
The world was huge, and of all the ingredients, the Origin Gold was naturally the most superior. It was the ruler of all weapons, and could suppress all Divine Metals.

“Come, you want to compete in Spirit Tools? I’ll oblige you!” With a thought from Ling Han, zi, a bolt of lightning immediately shot out from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, shooting towards Nangong Lin.
This strike was extraordinarily fast!
What kind of existence was the Origin Gold?
One that could forge Imperial Weapons!

Even if it was only a One Star Spirit Tool, it was still an overlord of this level. This attack was so fast that no Foundation Building Tier cultivator could dodge it. Otherwise, the Origin Gold was really not living up to its name.
Nangong Lin was instantly hit. A powerful electric current surged over, and he felt his whole body tremble. It was so uncomfortable that he wanted to vomit out the food in his stomach.
He hurriedly summoned the White Jade Tower back, pouring down energy to protect him.
When Ling Han saw this, he couldn’t help but laugh loudly. That was because Nangong Lin had been completely charred by this lightning bolt. He could even smell the fragrance of the meat.

This bolt of lightning was not a technique that he had instilled into it, but rather the might that came with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This piece of Origin Gold was nurtured in Primal Chaos, and tempered in the pool of electricity. By nature, it had two effects.

Unfortunately, because Ling Han’s divine sense had been infused into the Origin Gold, the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would also be affected by Ling Han’s cultivation level. Otherwise, with the might of the Origin Gold, even Saints could be killed.
Nangong Lin looked at Ling Han. He was a little confused at this moment.
The opponent in front of him was too strange.

From a level of being, it looked like he was Human Dao Foundation, but his battle prowess was not weaker than even him. Comparing Spirit Tools, his White Jade Demon Suppression Tower that was forged from three-star materials was actually unable to suppress him. This was extremely inconceivable.

“Go!” He was naturally unwilling to give up. He pointed a finger at Ling Han, and the white jade tower immediately shot out a ray of light, which turned into a flying sword that slashed towards Ling Han.
Peng!
The flying sword struck the precious Qi of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Not only did it not manage to penetrate it, it directly shattered by itself.
Nangong Lin was dumbfounded. He stared blankly at Ling Han.
That attack just now was definitely a direct confrontation between the two precious tools, and the result was… the complete defeat of the White Jade Demon Suppression Tower.
A precious tool forged from three-star materials had actually been completely defeated?
Nangong Lin’s heart trembled madly. Then there was only one possibility, and that was the material used to forge that precious tool of his was above three stars.
Heavens, was it a True Self Tier-level material, or… Spirit Transformation Tier?
Nangong Lin couldn’t help but feel greedy. To say nothing of him, even True Self Tier and Spirit Transformation True Lords would go crazy for this kind of material.
“Hehe, if it’s not yours, then don’t think too much about it.” Ling Han charged over, launching a series of attacks.

This time, Ling Han didn’t use the Celestial Crossing Finger anymore. Instead, he used the Demonic Monkey Fists. Boom! A terrifying aura rolled out, and a Demonic Monkeyappeared. It was nine meters tall, and roared as it pounced at Nangong Lin.
Zi, zi, zi! Multiple arcs of lightning also shot out from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, launching a second attack at Nangong Lin.

Nangong Lin hurriedly channeled the White Jade Tower to defend himself. However, this could block the power of the Demonic Monkey Fists, yet it couldn’ t block the Primordial Demonic Monkey that had manifested. It continuously attacked his mind, making him feel extremely uncomfortable.

Meanwhile, the lightning of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could not be blocked, and he could only slice off a portion of its might. It still electrocuted Nangong Lin to the point that his whole body went numb, and he was close to death.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his attacks were like a wild storm, soon blasting Nangong Lin to the ground.
So what if he was Ultimate Dao Foundation?

Ling Han was not reserved at all, and searched Nangong Lin. The White Jade Demon Suppression Tower was naturally not spared either. This was a Three Star material, and if he sold it to a Core Formation Tier elite, he could completely melt it and reforge it, immediately becoming a precious tool of the Core Formation Tier.
This could be sold for a high price.
“Give me back my precious tower!” Nangong Lin lay on the ground, his face filled with fury.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “If you are not convinced, you can come and seek me out for revenge in future. I will not change my surname, nor will I change my name. Niu Jianhua.”
In any case, he was wearing a mask, so no one recognized him.
“You’re that masked thief!” Realization dawned on Nangong Lin.
“It’s your Grandpa Niu!” Ling Han knocked Nangong Lin unconscious with a single slap.
En, should he wear the Battle Armor that he had snatched from Niu Jianhua in the future? Wouldn’t that make him even more similar?
Ling Han continued to study the formation technique, stimulating the formation technique to attack him, thus allowing the formation technique to appear and allow him to study it.
In a short while, another person ran over, but when he saw Nangong Lin lying on the ground, that person resolutely did not make a move on Ling Han. Instead, he circled around him.
—Nangong Lin was really too miserable. He had been stripped to the point that he was only wearing underpants.

After this, more and more people came up. Most of them would directly take a detour when they saw Nangong Lin, but there were also a few people who thought that they were extraordinary, and thought that they were stronger than Nangong Lin. In the end, it was naturally impossible for them to escape the fate of being beaten down. They were placed together with Nangong Lin, and all the treasures were plundered.
When night fell, there were a total of eleven people piled up, which was quite a large number.
At this time, no one else dared to make a move on Ling Han. Those 11 half- naked men were really too intimidating.

The night at the summit was also very cold, but it had not reached the point of freezing one to death. Ling Han was still studying the formation technique. The enlightenment in his heart continued to arise, and he felt that he was not far from a breakthrough.
The night passed, and the sun rose.
If one stood on the mountaintop, they would be able to see the sun rise and the first rays of the morning sun descended. Instantly, the darkness receded like a tidal wave.
Ling Han was at a critical moment. He temporarily set aside his cultivation and continued to study the formation.
Another day and a half passed, and he suddenly released a long bout of laughter.
He had comprehended, not only this formation, but also the art of formations itself. It was a comprehension of everything.
“Come!”

He stepped down, and instantly, a ball of light spread out from the sole of his foot, turning into a dozen over veined patterns, intertwining with those veined patterns on the ground. He took another step, yet the entire formation had no reaction at all.
He had temporarily suppressed this formation.
Ling Han walked over and easily took away the Ice Origin Stone. Once the Ice Origin Stone was gone, the glowing veined patterns on the ground immediately dimmed.
As expected, the Ice Origin Stone was the formation eye, and once it was taken away, the formation would lose its effect.

It was nine meters tall, and roared as it pounced at Nangong Lin.
Zi, zi, zi!
Multiple arcs of lightning also shot out from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, launching a second attack at Nangong Lin.
Nangong Lin hurriedly channeled the White Jade Tower to defend himself.
However, this could block the power of the Demonic Monkey Fists, yet it couldn’ t block the Primordial Demonic Monkey that had manifested.
It continuously attacked his mind, making him feel extremely uncomfortable.
Meanwhile, the lightning of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could not be blocked, and he could only slice off a portion of its might.
It still electrocuted Nangong Lin to the point that his whole body went numb, and he was close to death.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his attacks were like a wild storm, soon blasting Nangong Lin to the ground.
So what if he was Ultimate Dao Foundation?
Ling Han was not reserved at all, and searched Nangong Lin.
The White Jade Demon Suppression Tower was naturally not spared either.
This was a Three Star material, and if he sold it to a Core Formation Tier elite, he could completely melt it and reforge it, immediately becoming a precious tool of the Core Formation Tier.
This could be sold for a high price.
“Give me back my precious tower!” Nangong Lin lay on the ground, his face filled with fury.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “If you are not convinced, you can come and seek me out for revenge in future.
I will not change my surname, nor will I change my name.
Niu Jianhua.”
In any case, he was wearing a mask, so no one recognized him.
“You’re that masked thief!” Realization dawned on Nangong Lin.
“It’s your Grandpa Niu!” Ling Han knocked Nangong Lin unconscious with a single slap.
En, should he wear the Battle Armor that he had snatched from Niu Jianhua in the future?
Wouldn’t that make him even more similar?
Ling Han continued to study the formation technique, stimulating the formation technique to attack him, thus allowing the formation technique to appear and allow him to study it.
In a short while, another person ran over, but when he saw Nangong Lin lying on the ground, that person resolutely did not make a move on Ling Han.
Instead, he circled around him.
—Nangong Lin was really too miserable.
He had been stripped to the point that he was only wearing underpants.
After this, more and more people came up.
Most of them would directly take a detour when they saw Nangong Lin, but there were also a few people who thought that they were extraordinary, and thought that they were stronger than Nangong Lin.
In the end, it was naturally impossible for them to escape the fate of being beaten down.
They were placed together with Nangong Lin, and all the treasures were plundered.
When night fell, there were a total of eleven people piled up, which was quite a large number.
At this time, no one else dared to make a move on Ling Han.
Those 11 half- naked men were really too intimidating.
The night at the summit was also very cold, but it had not reached the point of freezing one to death.
Ling Han was still studying the formation technique.
The enlightenment in his heart continued to arise, and he felt that he was not far from a breakthrough.
The night passed, and the sun rose.
If one stood on the mountaintop, they would be able to see the sun rise and the first rays of the morning sun descended.
Instantly, the darkness receded like a tidal wave.
Ling Han was at a critical moment.
He temporarily set aside his cultivation and continued to study the formation.
Another day and a half passed, and he suddenly released a long bout of laughter.
He had comprehended, not only this formation, but also the art of formations itself.
It was a comprehension of everything.
“Come!”
He stepped down, and instantly, a ball of light spread out from the sole of his foot, turning into a dozen over veined patterns, intertwining with those veined patterns on the ground.
He took another step, yet the entire formation had no reaction at all.
He had temporarily suppressed this formation.
Ling Han walked over and easily took away the Ice Origin Stone.
Once the Ice Origin Stone was gone, the glowing veined patterns on the ground immediately dimmed.
As expected, the Ice Origin Stone was the formation eye, and once it was taken away, the formation would lose its effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 3683: Silver Dragon Fish
paragraphs: Chapter 3683: Silver Dragon Fish
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor. Henyee Translations
After obtaining Ice Origin Stones and stepping on the path of formations, Ling
Han was extremely happy.
He laughed loudly, and strode off.
There were still many mountain peaks here, and he should be able to obtain a great many Ice Origin Stones.

Ling Han leaped up and sped down the mountain. The gravity here was still very strong, and Foundation Building Tier cultivators couldn’t fly. Of course, if Ling Han didn’t mind exposing the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, then flying wouldn’t be a problem.
Not long after, he arrived at the second mountain peak.
However, the Ice Origin Stone here had already been taken, and Ling Han could still sense the faint aura of the formation.

He paced around on the formation, injecting power into it one after another. There was mystical power and Spiritual Power, and after a few steps, the already dim veined patterns on the ground all lit up, as if the formation had come back to life.
This was not just an appearance, but had really happened.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face as he activated the formation again.
However, there was no formation eye, so activating it was only temporary. When the power he injected was exhausted, the formation would naturally dim again.
“Now, I can only be so calm after activating the formations that are already there.When I can change the landscape with a single stomp and form a formation, that would be awesome.”
Ling Han mused ruefully, but he was really too far away from this step. That could be called a Formation Grandmaster, and now?
He had just crossed the threshold.
He continued to advance, but after descending this mountain, a fork appeared ahead of him. There were a total of three paths that he could take.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶

Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to take the first option. He strode forwards. After walking for about half an hour, a lake appeared ahead of him, and beside the lake, there was a large group of people surrounding it. Some were even attacking the lake, and with a boom, there was a huge splash.
What were they doing?
Ling Han walked over, patted the shoulder of the person beside him, and asked, “Brother, what are you guys doing?”
The person was given a fright. Ling Han had actually approached him soundlessly, and he had only reacted after a tap on his shoulder?

If Ling Han wanted to kill him, then wouldn’t he already be dead? Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. However, he didn’t dare to show the slightest bit of anger on his face, fearing that Ling Han would really kill him in a fit of anger.
“There are Silver Dragon Fish here,” he said honestly.

“What’s that?” Ling Han muttered. He had only made up for his knowledge of alchemy. Basically, he could recognize all medicinal ingredients and alchemical pills with a single glance. In fact, even if they were ground into dust, he only needed to smell them.
But as for other things, his knowledge was limited. After all, his energy was
also limited.
That person really wanted to roll his eyes. You don’t even know Silver Dragon Fish, so how did you manage to reach Foundation Building Tier?

He only dared to say this in his heart, but said, “The Silver Dragon Fish is completely silver, and swims in the water like a shrunken True Dragon, which is why it has the name of Silver Dragon Fish. And the Silver Dragon Fish can increase cultivation level. Though it is not instantaneous, it would be reflected slowly in future, and the effects would be astonishing.”
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. No wonder so many people were blasting madly at the lake waters. As expected, they had ulterior motives.

“Why don’t you just dive in and capture them?” he asked again. “Sigh, who doesn’t want to?” That person shookhis head, “But there’s nothing to be done. This lake water looks to be flowing, and has not frozen over, but the temperature is astonishingly low. If you jump in, you would directly freeze all the blood in your body, and sink to the bottom.”
“Even if you can rely on a rare treasure to resist the cold, those Silver Dragon Fish are swimming very quickly in the water, much faster than us.
Ling Han nodded. Before he could decide whether to go into the water to catch fish or continue forward, he saw that a few people had actually walked back.
When he asked, he found out that there was no path ahead.
How could there be no path?

As it turned out, there was a large gate blocking the path ahead of them, and the large gate could not be touched at all. The power of lightning was seeping out, and they could not climb over it no matter how hard they tried. There were only two options: one, go back the way they had come, or two, find the key, because there was a lock on the door.
“Since this is a test set by the Holy Land of Metal Element, there must be a key? that can open the lock. We came back to mobilize everyone to search for clues,” one of the returning people said.
However, only a few people responded. Since so many people chose to stay here to catch the Silver Dragon Fish, how could they just set aside the Sliver Dragon Fish and search for the key?
Who knew if it even existed?
“Who knows, there may not be any key at all. This is a dead end, and we would have to go through another path,” someone said.
The few people who had returned previously decided to turn around and explore the other two paths.
The people left behind could very easily choose. If those few people did not return all this while, it meant that the other two options were a way out – at least, one of them had to be the way out.
Thus, everyone continued to fish.
Yet a thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. Could this key be in the lake?
Otherwise, the appearance of this lake would have been far too abrupt.
Let’s look around.
He arrived at the banks of the lake. He had not even entered into the water, when a baleful coldness was already bearing down on him.
“A mere Human Dao Foundation, get lost,” someone immediately shouted at him.
This was a man, but his appearance was interesting, because the eyebrows of others were all linear, and as for his? They were small circles.
There was another person beside him, who also looked interesting. His hair was actually divided into three areas, and he had tied it into three braids.
“Yi, a masked man?” The braided man asked in surprise, “Could it be that great thief?”
“How could that be? A mere Human Dao Foundation,” the man with the eyebrow said disdainfully.
“True,” the braided man nodded.
Tm really sorry. My cultivation level is too low.1
Ling Han couldn’t help but rub his chin in shock. Could such a low cultivation level also become a point of mockery?
“Are you still not getting lost?” The man with the eyebrows was getting impatient, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han, wanting to blast him into the lake.
Ling Han raised a brow, and also delivered a palm strike.
Peng!
A powerful energy fluctuation overflowed, and various seals exploded madly.
The man with the eyebrows collapsed to the ground.
“Ah—11he screamed, blood gushing from his body.

The braided man watched with fear and trepidation. How could this be a Human Dao Foundation? Was there such a powerful Human Dao Foundation? This guy must be a Heavenly Dao Foundation or even in fact Ultimate Dao Foundation, and then used a special cultivation technique or precious tool to change the fluctuation of his vital signs. That was why he looked like a Human Dao Foundation.
Ling Han didn’t say another word. He first plundered the browed man clean, then threw him into the lake.
“I’m about to die from the cold!” the man with the eyebrows screamed. Ignoring the pain all over his body, he hurriedly used all four of his limbs and swam up from the lake.
Thankfully, Ling Han had no intention of killing him. Otherwise, as long as he didn’t let him ashore, the man with the eyebrows would definitely be dead.
“That great thief is here!”
“It’s him!”
“So this is how he looks like.”

“Of course. He has a mask on his face, so that’s naturally how he looks like. Everyone looked over. The masked man, robbery. With these two factors added together, it was natural that everyone could guess Ling Han’s identity.

Even if you were wearing a dozen over layers of armor, it was still impossible for your defenses to be unbreakable. This wasn’t a dozen over Foundation Building Tier cultivators working together to protect you.

Five, ten, fifteen, twenty!

would not take the initiative to provoke him either.

If no one made a move, he would not be able to rob more people.

Spirit Tools, right????F

chapters.title: Chapter 3685: Old Clam
paragraphs: Chapter 3685: Old Clam
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t plan to stand guard on the surface of the lake. That would be too inefficient.
Since the Starlight Screen could resist extreme cold, what did he have to fear?
Ling Han entered the lake and immediately started to swim.
On the shore, those who had been robbed had no face to continue, and turned around to walk back, while those who had stayed behind looked at the lake surface and smirked coldly.
Did he think that he was the only one who could enter the lake?
After setting up a shield, there were more and more people who could go into the water, but why was everyone staying on the shore?

That was because the lake water was too cold. Spreading out a shield would expend too much mystical power. Even if it was Ultimate Dao Foundation, he could only last for about five minutes. However, since he was in the lake, his speed was extraordinarily slow. What could be done in five minutes?
“You’re not going to turn back until you crash into a wall?”
“Heh, it won’t be long before he pops out on his own.”
“How laughable. Do you think we can’t go into the water?”
A considerable number of people smirked coldly. When Ling Han came out of the water, they would definitely mock him.

In the lake, Ling Han felt like he was being restrained. The resistance of the lake waters was extraordinarily strong, causing his swimming speed to slow down. With his previous judgement of the speed of the Silver Dragon Fish, it should be impossible for him to catch up.
Going up just like that?
How could that be allowed?
Ling Han dived downwards, and soon arrived at the bottom of the lake.

He had two purposes. Firstly, of course, he had to catch the Silver Dragon Fish. Secondly, he suspected that there was a key at the bottom of the lake that could open the lock to the main doors ahead of him.

Though this lake couldn’t be considered too deep, it was still 180 meters deep, and light could only reach 30 meters below the surface of the water. At this depth, the lake was naturally completely pitch-black, and only Ling Han’s Starlight Screen was flickering with light.
Of course, the sunlight couldn’t reach this place, so Ling Han wasn’t worried that the light emitting from his body would be noticed by the people on the shore.
He unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which hovered above his head and poured down streams of Primal Chaos aura, expelling both the lake water and the coldness.

Ling Han put away the Starlight Screen. He didn’t need the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and he could still stay here for a few months. There was no other reason, but there were really too many reserves of mystical power that could support him to be so extravagant.
However, since he had a precious tool to use, why should he waste mystical power?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower protected him, and Ling Han was unaffected by all techniques. At least, lake water of this level could no longer affect him.
His speed immediately returned to normal. He activated his Eye Technique, and even the darkness couldn’t obstruct his vision.
He saw that six meters away, there was a school of Silver Dragon Fish slowly swimming around.
Xiu, Ling Han rushed over, and stretched out a hand to grab it.
How could those Silver Dragon Fish have foreseen that someone would actually dare dive into the water to catch them?
This reaction was extremely slow. In fact, it didn’t even have the time to turn around before it was captured by Ling Han.
There were a total of eleven.
Ling Han couldn’t help but break into a smile. In just a short while, his gains had surpassed anyone else. In fact, even the top five in fact added together couldn’t compare to his gains.
However, there were many people with him, and there were also many gluttons. He had to capture more.
Ling Han swam around in the lake, and began a great hunt.
One minute, two minutes, three minutes, four minutes.
“He’s about to come out.”
“To be able to last until now, he is not weak either.”

On the shore, everyone spoke one after another. Previously, the person who had lasted the longest among them was five minutes. They were sure that Ling Han definitely could not surpass this limit, and would definitely come out five minutes ago.
However, another minute quickly passed.
The surface of the lake was calm, and the waves rippled. Only when someone struck the surface of the water by the lake would there be ripples.
Where had this person popped out from?

“No way, this brat can actually hold on for so long?” A considerable number revealed shocked expressions. This was already equal to the best result. Furthermore, Ling Han still hadn’t surfaced, and was continuously breaking records.
“Could it be that he ingested alchemical pills in the water to replenish his mystical power?”
“Now, the best Mystical Power Pill can only recover 10% of mystical power at a time, and if taken continuously for a short period of time, the medicinal effects will continuously be halved.”
“En, so no matter how wealthy he is, he would only be able to last six to seven minutes, at most.”
Everyone expressed their agreement one after another. Even if there was a great alchemist willing to support them at all costs, it was impossible that there would be no limit.
However, very soon, six minutes had passed, followed by seven minutes, eight minutes, and even ten minutes, but Ling Han still did not appear.
“F***, have we seen a ghost?” someone exclaimed in shock, his face filled with disbelief.
The expressions of the others were not much better either. It had already been ten minutes, and that had doubled the best result.
“Could it be that he has already died below?”
“Possibly.”
“That guy was very stubborn. He probably had to hold on until his limit, but in the end, he did not manage to float back up in time, and died below.”
“En, he must be dead.”
Many people came to this conclusion, and after another five minutes, everyone came to the same conclusion, and that was Ling Han must have died.
They continued to do whatever they were doing, and the people who came after them continued to stream over.
However, the people who had ran to the other two paths had not returned all this while. It was probable that there was no lockdown of the main doors there, and their path was smooth and unobstructed.
However, there were Silver Dragon Fish here. Many people clearly knew that the other two paths could be the way out, but they still lingered here.
However, they didn’t know if it was an illusion, but they realized that there were fewer and fewer Silver Dragon Fish swimming towards the surface of the water.
And underneath the lake, Ling Han swam endlessly, his gains increasing further and further.
As he hunted, he was also searching for any hidden key.
“If it’s really a key, then the chances of finding it in the mud and sand at the bottom of the lake are endlessly small.”
“So, if there really is a key, then the hiding place must be very obvious.”
“Hmm?”
Ling Han suddenly stopped, and saw a stretch of corals ahead of him.
Why were there corals in the fresh water?
Ling Han mocked internally, but his eyes did not stop on the coral, but rather on a large clam in the corals.
This large clam was as big as a screen, and was presently spread open. A pearl the size of a human head could be clearly seen inside.
This pearl was completely golden, exuding light, and appeared very striking in the dark waters.
And beside the pearl, there was also a black key.
Hehe, found it.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. The fact that this old clam could grow to such a large size meant that it had probably lived for several hundred years, or even more than a thousand years, right?
Thus, this golden pearl was definitely very nutritious. If it was used for an alchemical pill, its effects would definitely be excellent.
Not bad, this was a pleasant surprise.
Ling Han swam over, and when it felt the change in the water flow, the old clam immediately closed its lid.
How was he supposed to stop ir?

Ling Han unleashed a murderous aura attack, and the old clam’s divine sense was instantly captured. It became weak, and the clam shell that had initially been tightly closed immediately loosened a bit. Ling Han easily opened it.
However, Ling Han didn’t kill it. He simply retrieved the golden pearl and key.
“It’s said that clam meat is fresh, so it’s a bit of a pity,” Ling Han mumbled to himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 3686: Coincidental encounter
paragraphs: Chapter 3686: Coincidental encounter
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor. Henyee Translations
Ling Han swam around in the lake again, but there were not many Silver Dragon Fish left. At most, there would not be more than ten left.
Forget it. He would just let them rest here, and continue to reproduce. He floated upwards, and with a splash, rushed out of the water’s surface.
“What a huge fish!” A person was by the lake, and he exclaimed in surprise. He had never thought that such a large Silver Dragon Fish would jump out.
With such a big splash, was this the Silver Dragon Fish King?
He immediately prepared himself to make a move. He was going to use his mystical power to trap this “Fish King”, and drag it onto the shore.
Boom, the mystical power was like silk, winding towards Ling Han.

Ling Han naturally didn’t know that he was being treated like a Silver Dragon Fish and a fish king at that. He only knew that someone had launched an attack at him, but their purpose wasn’t to kill him. Instead, they simply wanted to capture him.
Who would be so bold?
Ling Han humphed and replied with a punch of his own.
‘F*ck! I’ve seen a ghost!’
That person’s eyes were wide open. Now, he naturally saw clearly that this wasn’t a fish king that had popped out of the lake, but a person!
He had just arrived not too long ago, so he naturally hadn’t seen Ling Han dive into the water. How could he have imagined that a person would suddenly appear from below?
Water ghost?

He definitely did not believe that this was a person, because he knew how cold the lake waters were. There was no one that could last more than five minutes, and he had already been here for at least more than an hour. In this period of time, there was definitely no one that had dived into the water. At most, they had only tested the water temperature.
Thus, if someone had crawled out from the bottom of the lake, they must be a water ghost.
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, shattering his opponent’s power. The remaining power did not dissipate, and the person was sent flying.
If it wasn’t for the fact that the other party only wanted to capture him and not
kill him, Ling Han wouldn’t have held back either.
On second thought, he understood. The other party thought of him as a giant Silver Dragon Fish.
When they saw Ling Han clearly, the people by the lake all exclaimed in surprise. These were all people who had seen Ling Han dive into the water before.
He had come out! He had come out!
Heavens, just how long had passed?
It had almost been a day.

Are you a f****** monster, to actually be able to stay close to a day at the bottom of such a cold lake? Are you a Silver Dragon Fish that has taken human form, and so naturally could resist the cold?
Xiu, someone jumped over. This was a slender young man. He swept an eye over Ling Han, and asked, “Why can you stay in the lake for so long?”
“Do I know you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
The young man was taken aback, and subconsciously exclaimed, “How are you worthy of knowing me!”
p***?did he know how to speak properly?
“Since I don’t even know who you are, why should I answer you?” Ling Han countered.
The young man flew into a thunderous rage, “Because I am Yue Haoming!” -Never heard of it.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, an expression of disdain on his face.
“Humph, don’t think that you can be arrogant in front of me just because you have defeated so many people previously.” Yue Haoming said coldly, “As I see it, your strength is only so-so!”
He was a prodigy that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundation, so he naturally thought that in this Mystery Realm, the people here could only contend with him, at most.

Ling Han cracked a smile. Xiu, he charged towards Yue Haoming. The barrage of murderous aura shot out, and Yue Haoming couldn’t help but grunt. There was a stabbing pain in his mind, as well as an indescribable feeling of fear.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. Without facing it personally, no one could imagine the might of the barrage of murderous aura.

His strength was actually not inferior to Ling Han’s. In terms of raw power, he was even far superior. However, once he lost the initiative, he fell into a passive position, and had no choice but to first parry Ling Han’s attacks.

Ling Han let out a battle cry, and shot out both fists in a series of punches. The Demonic Monkey Fists was already used, and the 108 layers of power stacked together were shot out in the manner of Frequency Attack.

This was too terrifying. Even if Yue Haoming was a one-star genius that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundation, so what? He was completely unable to fight back – he had just caught his breath, and just when he was about to make a move, he was struck by a murderous aura attack that caused his mind to temporarily go blank, and he could only passively defend again.
In about a hundred moves, Yue Haoming was blasted onto the ground.

Seeing this scene, everyone’s expressions became serious. Previously, even if Ling Han had defeated 35 Foundation Building cultivators single-handedly, not one of them had been Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivators. Though everyone recognized Ling Han’s strength, they did not think that they would lose to Ling Han.
A large part of the reason for this was because Ling Han was wearing over a dozen layers of armor. This was extremely useful against low-level cultivators.
But now, Ling Han had completely defeated Yue Haoming with a violent attack, displaying his terrifying abilities.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
This person… was terrifying.
Ling Han smiled, and swept Yue Haoming clean, “Knowing that I am short of money, you took the initiative to gift me treasures. I, Niu Jianhua, thank you very much.”

-You!” Yue Haoming stared fixedly at Ling Han. Niu Jianhua, he would remember this name. He had actually robbed him so badly that he was only wearing underpants. In future, he would definitely get his revenge, definitely.
Ling Han naturally would not be concerned. Go and seek revenge on Niu Jianhua, young man!
He strode off. Since he had already caught all the Silver Dragon Fish, and obtained the key, what was the point of staying here any longer?
Very soon, he arrived in front of the great doors that those people had spoken of. These doors were built in the middle of a canyon, and just happened to be blocking the way.
The door was completely black, and by the looks of it, it should have been forged from metal. Lightning could be seen flickering on the door.
This door couldn’t be touched, and one would be electrocuted upon contact. Ling Han took out the key and shot it at the keyhole. With a sharp sound, the key entered the keyhole.
He then used his Spiritual Power to control it, and the key started to turn. Ka, a crisp sound rang out.
The great doors did not open, but the light of lightning that was flickering on them had disappeared.
Ling Han pressed his hands down, a smile curling up the corners of his lips. He didn’t feel it at all.
He gave a strong push, and ka, ka, ka, the great doors slowly opened.
He was leaving.

He strode forwards, passed through the main doors, and continued onwards. The canyon soon ended, and a new snowy peak appeared ahead of him. After a few leaps and landings, Ling Han arrived at the foot of the mountain. He was just about to climb the mountain, when he saw that there was an intense battle not far away.
These two people were both wearing Battle Armors, and their battle was incredibly intense.
‘Ya?’
Ling Han recognized them. These two people were actually Princess Bixiao and Niu Jianhua, respectively!

These two people had both come to the Holy Land of Metal Element. Ling Han could imagine this, but it was actually so coincidental that they would meet. -Princess Bixiao was wearing his Battle Armor, so Niu Jianhua naturally recognized her. Thus, he would definitely step forward to ask, so it was very normal for them to come to blows.
The problem was, where had this guy gotten a Battle Armor from?

Ling Han merely swept an eye over them, and had a direct understanding of their battle prowess. They were both at the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation, and they were both one-star geniuses. With the help of the Battle Armor, they could just barely reach about 20% to 40% battle prowess of a one-star genius.

However, Niu Jianhua’s Battle Armor was clearly inferiors This was normal. Otherwise, he wouldn’t only have two suits of Battle Armor on him. This pair of Battle Armor was probably brought by those old servants.
“Great thief, let me deal with you!” Ling Han let out a battle cry and jumped
out..

“What a huge fish!” A person was by the lake, and he exclaimed in surprise.
He had never thought that such a large Silver Dragon Fish would jump out.
With such a big splash, was this the Silver Dragon Fish King?
He immediately prepared himself to make a move.
He was going to use his mystical power to trap this “Fish King”, and drag it onto the shore.
Boom, the mystical power was like silk, winding towards Ling Han.
Ling Han naturally didn’t know that he was being treated like a Silver Dragon Fish and a fish king at that.
He only knew that someone had launched an attack at him, but their purpose wasn’t to kill him.
Instead, they simply wanted to capture him.
Who would be so bold?
Ling Han humphed and replied with a punch of his own.
‘F*ck!
I’ve seen a ghost!’
That person’s eyes were wide open.
Now, he naturally saw clearly that this wasn’t a fish king that had popped out of the lake, but a person!
He had just arrived not too long ago, so he naturally hadn’t seen Ling Han dive into the water.
How could he have imagined that a person would suddenly appear from below?
Water ghost?
He definitely did not believe that this was a person, because he knew how cold the lake waters were.
There was no one that could last more than five minutes, and he had already been here for at least more than an hour.
In this period of time, there was definitely no one that had dived into the water.
At most, they had only tested the water temperature.
Thus, if someone had crawled out from the bottom of the lake, they must be a water ghost.
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, shattering his opponent’s power.
The remaining power did not dissipate, and the person was sent flying.
If it wasn’t for the fact that the other party only wanted to capture him and not
kill him, Ling Han wouldn’t have held back either.
On second thought, he understood.
The other party thought of him as a giant Silver Dragon Fish.
When they saw Ling Han clearly, the people by the lake all exclaimed in surprise.
These were all people who had seen Ling Han dive into the water before.
He had come out!
He had come out!
Heavens, just how long had passed?
It had almost been a day.
Are you a f****** monster, to actually be able to stay close to a day at the bottom of such a cold lake?
Are you a Silver Dragon Fish that has taken human form, and so naturally could resist the cold?
Xiu, someone jumped over.
This was a slender young man.
He swept an eye over Ling Han, and asked, “Why can you stay in the lake for so long?”
“Do I know you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
The young man was taken aback, and subconsciously exclaimed, “How are you worthy of knowing me!”
p***?did he know how to speak properly?
“Since I don’t even know who you are, why should I answer you?” Ling Han countered.
The young man flew into a thunderous rage, “Because I am Yue Haoming!” -Never heard of it.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, an expression of disdain on his face.
“Humph, don’t think that you can be arrogant in front of me just because you have defeated so many people previously.” Yue Haoming said coldly, “As I see it, your strength is only so-so!”
He was a prodigy that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundation, so he naturally thought that in this Mystery Realm, the people here could only contend with him, at most.
Ling Han cracked a smile.
Xiu, he charged towards Yue Haoming.
The barrage of murderous aura shot out, and Yue Haoming couldn’t help but grunt.
There was a stabbing pain in his mind, as well as an indescribable feeling of fear.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked.
Without facing it personally, no one could imagine the might of the barrage of murderous aura.
His strength was actually not inferior to Ling Han’s.
In terms of raw power, he was even far superior.
However, once he lost the initiative, he fell into a passive position, and had no choice but to first parry Ling Han’s attacks.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and shot out both fists in a series of punches.
The Demonic Monkey Fists was already used, and the 108 layers of power stacked together were shot out in the manner of Frequency Attack.
This was too terrifying.
Even if Yue Haoming was a one-star genius that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundation, so what?

He was completely unable to fight back – he had just caught his breath, and just when he was about to make a move, he was struck by a murderous aura attack that caused his mind to temporarily go blank, and he could only passively defend again.
In about a hundred moves, Yue Haoming was blasted onto the ground.
Seeing this scene, everyone’s expressions became serious.
Previously, even if Ling Han had defeated 35 Foundation Building cultivators single-handedly, not one of them had been Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivators.
Though everyone recognized Ling Han’s strength, they did not think that they would lose to Ling Han.
A large part of the reason for this was because Ling Han was wearing over a dozen layers of armor.
This was extremely useful against low-level cultivators.
But now, Ling Han had completely defeated Yue Haoming with a violent attack, displaying his terrifying abilities.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
This person… was terrifying.
Ling Han smiled, and swept Yue Haoming clean, “Knowing that I am short of money, you took the initiative to gift me treasures.
I, Niu Jianhua, thank you very much.”
-You!” Yue Haoming stared fixedly at Ling Han.
Niu Jianhua, he would remember this name.
He had actually robbed him so badly that he was only wearing underpants.
In future, he would definitely get his revenge, definitely.
Ling Han naturally would not be concerned.
Go and seek revenge on Niu Jianhua, young man!
He strode off.
Since he had already caught all the Silver Dragon Fish, and obtained the key, what was the point of staying here any longer?
Very soon, he arrived in front of the great doors that those people had spoken of.
These doors were built in the middle of a canyon, and just happened to be blocking the way.
The door was completely black, and by the looks of it, it should have been forged from metal.
Lightning could be seen flickering on the door.
This door couldn’t be touched, and one would be electrocuted upon contact.
Ling Han took out the key and shot it at the keyhole.

He then used his Spiritual Power to control it, and the key started to turn.
Ka, a crisp sound rang out.

Ling Han pressed his hands down, a smile curling up the corners of his lips.
He didn’t feel it at all.
He gave a strong push, and ka, ka, ka, the great doors slowly opened.
He was leaving.
He strode forwards, passed through the main doors, and continued onwards.
The canyon soon ended, and a new snowy peak appeared ahead of him.
After a few leaps and landings, Ling Han arrived at the foot of the mountain.

These two people were both wearing Battle Armors, and their battle was incredibly intense.
‘Ya?’
Ling Han recognized them.
These two people were actually Princess Bixiao and Niu Jianhua, respectively!
These two people had both come to the Holy Land of Metal Element.
Ling Han could imagine this, but it was actually so coincidental that they would meet. -Princess Bixiao was wearing his Battle Armor, so Niu Jianhua naturally recognized her.
Thus, he would definitely step forward to ask, so it was very normal for them to come to blows.
The problem was, where had this guy gotten a Battle Armor from?

They were both at the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation, and they were both one-star geniuses.
With the help of the Battle Armor, they could just barely reach about 20% to 40% battle prowess of a one-star genius.
However, Niu Jianhua’s Battle Armor was clearly inferiors This was normal.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t only have two suits of Battle Armor on him.
This pair of Battle Armor was probably brought by those old servants.
“Great thief, let me deal with you!” Ling Han let out a battle cry and jumped
out..

chapters.title: Chapter 3687: Killing Niu Jianhua
paragraphs: Chapter 3687: Killing Niu Jianhua
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
What was going on?
Princess Bixiao and Niu Jianhua both turned to look at Ling Han.
It’s you!” After Niu Jianhua faltered for a moment, he immediately gritted his teeth.

He hated Ling Han very much, and recognized Ling Han with a single glance. That was because the latter was wearing his armor – Ling Han had worn his Battle Armor on the outside in order to attract animosity for Niu Jianhua.
Princess Bixiao faltered for a moment before revealing a pleasantly surprised expression.
She was confident in Ling Han’s talent, but there could be accidents in everything. It was only now that she saw Ling Han that she could finally relax. Yi, why had she recognized Ling Han?
He was wearing a mask!
Princess Bixiao was slightly dazed. Her understanding of Ling Han was so familiar that she didn’t even need to see his face, and would be able to recognize him just by looking at his figure?

Ling Han looked towards Niu Jianhua, killing intent flickering in his eyes. Previously, Niu Jianhua had led a few old servants to ambush him at the Primordial Sect, and he had almost really died at this person’s hands.
Of course, he had to avenge this.
“It’s you, and… you’re also that great thief!” Niu Jianhua’s reaction wasn’t slow at all. When he saw that Ling Han was wearing over a dozen Battle Armors, he immediately came to his senses.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Wrong, you are that great thief.”
“You, you dare frame me?” Niu Jianhua was quite smart.
“Clever!” Ling Han gave him a thumbs up, generously giving him approval.
“You deserve to die!” Niu Jianhua was furious. This person was too despicable. He actually impersonated him to rob others, smearing his reputation.
He roared, and paid no further attention to Princess Bixiao. He then charged towards Ling Han.

“Don’t even think about leaving!” Princess Bixiao hurriedly caught up to him. Now, though Ling Han had advanced into Foundation Building Tier, compared to people like them who had long since arrived at the Holy Land, after a year of hard cultivation, their cultivation level had advanced rapidly. For example, she and Niu Jianhua had both reached the peak stage of Foundation Building Tier. As for Ling Han?
Without such good conditions, he should be at the early stage of Human Dao Foundation.
She was naturally worried that Ling Han would be no match for him, and be wounded by Niu Jianhua.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The two of them battled all the way. Niu Jianhua was indeed unable to shake off Princess Bixiao, but Princess Bixiao was also unable to block Niu Jianhua and get in front of him.
“Leave quickly!” Princess Bixiao said to Ling Han through her divine sense.
Why was this guy still standing there?

Ling Han chuckled and said, “It’s fine. Leave this kind of degenerate to me.” “You dare to call me degenerate?” Niu Jianhua roared in fury. “No matter who you are, I’ll make you bleed all over today!”
Ling Han smiled, and snapped his fingers at Niu Jianhua. Xiu, a burst of energy shot out. It was Celestial Crossing Finger.
This was a very ordinary celestial technique, but from Ling Han’s hands, and being received by Niu Jianhua, it was completely different.
-For example, if a Saint moved, even if he did not use the celestial technique, that attack would still be able to destroy a planet.
The force was extremely fast, and Niu Jianhua couldn’t dodge it at all. With a pu, the force hit his chest, and a terrifying power surged out, sending him flying backwards.
Peng, Niu Jianhua fell heavily onto the ground, his expression completely dumbfounded.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
He, actually, could not block a single finger from Ling Han?
How was this possible?
He lowered his head and saw that there was a groove on the Battle Armor that was slowly recovering.

He was shocked. The power of Ling Han’s finger had actually caused the Battle Armor to cave in. Just how terrifying was this power? And if it was not for the fact that he still had the protection of this Battle Armor, then wouldn’t he have been insta-killed with a single strike?
What kind of terrifying monster was this?
When he broke through to Celestial Path, Ling Han was definitely still at the mortal level. Moreover, he hadn’t even arrived at the Mystery Realm yet, so how could he possess such battle prowess now?

He got back to his feet, and felt a great pain in his chest. Even if the Battle Armor had dispersed most of the might of Ling Han’s finger, there was still a portion that had taken effect on him, and he felt as if even his bones had been broken.
This gap in strength was really as wide as the sky.
Niu Jianhua did not hesitate any longer. Immediately, he turned around and broke into a run.
‘Ow, ow, ow!’
As he ran, he stumbled and almost fell. The bones in his chest really seemed to have broken, and he felt pain every time he moved.
However, for the sake of survival, he suppressed this urge and continued to flee.

Princess Bixiao was also dazed on the sidelines. She knew that Ling Han was freakish, but definitely did not think that Ling Han would still have such terrifying battle prowess after advancing into Celestial Path. After all, above Celestial Path, the gap among prodigies had actually shrunk considerably. Cultivation level was the main factor.
However, Ling Han’s actions had completely overturned this perception of hers.
Precisely because of this, it wasn’t until Niu Jianhua ran far away that she finally came to her senses.
They couldn’t allow this person to escape. Otherwise, if he asked the great elite of Spirit Transformation Tier to come out, that wouldn’t be a joke.
“Ling Han, chase after him!” she called out, as she too began her pursuit.
Ling Han smiled and said, “There’s no hurry.”
He strolled onwards, neither too fast nor too slow.
Princess Bixiao couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. ‘What are you still showing off for at this time? Hurry up and get rid of this future threat.’

Niu Jianhua also saw it, and he couldn’t help but smirk coldly. This time, as long as he managed to escape, he would immediately think of a way to return to the home planet, and then ask the elites to kill Ling Han.
-Killing a Foundation Building cultivator, a Cauldron Forging Tier was enough; there was absolutely no need to alert the old man.
Peng!
However, before he could finish his thought, he felt his body tremble. Then, he was sent flying, and crashed heavily into a large tree.
He fell down, and it was as if his whole body had fallen apart. He did not have the slightest bit of strength left.
What was going on here?
He shockingly discovered that Ling Han was presently standing next to him! Hiss, when did the other party catch up to him? How did he catch up to him? Impossible.

Xiu, at this moment, Princess Bixiao finally arrived gracefully. Her face was filled with shock, because she had seen very clearly just now. Ling Han had caught up to Niu Jianhua at an indescribable speed, and then sent the latter flying.
This terrifying speed, this terrifying power!
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said to Princess Bixiao, “I already said there’s no need to rush, right?”
Yes, you are awesome, so whatever you say is naturally right.
In any case, Princess Bixiao couldn’t speak, and could only feel deep shock.
Ling Han ransacked Niu Jianhua again, but this guy was really very poor now. Aside from the Battle Armor he was wearing, there was nothing else of value.
Niu Jianhua, on the other hand, felt so furious that he wanted to die. This was the second time, this was already the second time.
Ling Han smiled, and comforted him, “Don’t worry, there won’t be a third time.”
Niu Jianhua’s heart was filled with killing intent. He thought to himself that there naturally wouldn’t be a third time, because he would ask elites to kill Ling Han at all costs.
“Because you’re about to die,” Ling Han said seriously.
W-what?
Niu Jianhua was taken aback. The word ‘death’ seemed to be miles away from him.
He was too young, and the day that his lifespan would dry up was still far in sight. Furthermore, he was the descendant of a great elite of Spirit Transformation Tier, so who would dare kill him?
But now, when he saw Ling Han’s murderous and stern expression, he knew that Ling Han was definitely not just scaring him.

“Don’t-” he opened his mouth to call out, but he had not even finished his words, when pa, Ling Han had already sent out a palm strike. Destructive Energy surged from him, instantly turning him into nothing..

chapters.title: Chapter 3688: Toxic tongue
paragraphs: Chapter 3688: Toxic tongue
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
“Beauty, we haven’t seen each other for a year, and you seem to have become even more beautiful.” Ling Han waved a hand at Princess Bixiao.
Princess Bixiao humphed, “I haven’t seen you for a year, and you seem to have
become glib-tongued.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “One is in high spirits at a happy occasion,
so I’ll just banter with you for a while.”
What joyous occasion was this?
Princess Bixiao didn’t ask. She wasn’t the type to gossip, so she said with a
serious expression, “You go ahead first.”
“Yi, you dislike me so much?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Princess Bixiao shook her head, and said, “I’m too weak here, so I’ll only drag
you down.”
So that was how it was.
Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s fine. I’m very strong.
Princess Bixiao still shook her head, “I want to stand where I should be standing with my own strength, and sit where I should be sitting.
Ling Han remained silent for a moment before nodding and saying, “Alright,
then I’ll take my leave first.”
He respected the other’s thoughts. His figure soared, and xiu, he quickly left.
Princess Bixiao stared at his receding back, and did not withdraw her gaze even after Ling Han had disappeared. She was a little dazed, and a little dumb.
She wasn’t as proud as she said. She didn’t want to go with Ling Han, because she didn’t want to become a burden on him.
She was willing to stand in an inconspicuous corner, and watch Ling Han soar through the skies, dazzling the world.

In terms of understanding of women, Ling Han was still far from being as talented as he was in martial arts, alchemy, and formations. He really thought that Princess Bixiao had refused to go with him because of her pride.
“Really, we’re considered comrades, so there’s nothing wrong with helping
each other.”
He mumbled to himself as he climbed the mountain. Soon, he arrived at the summit, but the formation here had already dimmed. Obviously, the Ice Origin Stone had already been taken.
Ling Han didn’t stop, and he continued to advance.
He remembered that someone from the Holy Land of Metal Element had said that there was a Celestial Tree here, and its fruits just happened to ripen.
Where was it?
He quickened his pace. Previously, because he had been studying formation techniques, and had gone to catch fish in the lake, his position as first place had long since been lost.
He climbed one mountain after another, but the formations on them had all stopped, while the Ice Origin Stone had been taken away.
Half a day later, Ling Han arrived at a new mountain peak. Finally, the formation here was still channeling, and there were presently a great many people that were forcefully barging in.
Ling Han’S eyes swept over them, and immediately, an intent to kill appeared
in his eyes.
Hong Tianbu!
He hadn’t even made a move, and the Ice Origin Stone already belonged to someone else. It was snatched by a young man in green robes.

It wasn’t that his strength was invincible, but rather that he had drawn out an oil lamp. Under the enshrouding light, countless shadowy figures appeared, and the attacks that assaulted him were all dispersed, allowing him to rush to the front and take the Ice Origin Stone.
“Hahaha, a bunch of trash!” This green-robed young man immediately began
to mock them.
Ling Han was astonished. There was no shortage of elites here, so was it really good for you to have such a toxic tongue?

Sure enough, someone immediately humphed, and said, “Luo Xuan, you’re too conceited! This is only an Ice Origin Stone, so we might not take it seriously. What need is there for you to fight over it with all our might?

“You can’t win, so where do all these excuses come from?” The green-robed young man, Luo Xuan, laughed madly, “Come, come, come. Taking advantage of this opportunity, I will beat all of you to the ground. For this Metal Element Fruit Gathering, it will be enough for me to participate alone.”
“Idiot.” The person from before said coldly, “There should be a Celestial Tree ahead of us. At that time, I will let you have your wish, and have a contest with you.”
“An Jiuyue, if you’re afraid, then you’re afraid. Don’t find excuses,” Luo Xuan continued to mock him.
-With such a toxic mouth, it was really not easy for him to reach this age.
However, An Jiuyue didn’t pay him any heed. He simply activated his movement technique and continued to advance.

Once he left, everyone followed behind him. Indeed, to them, heirs of True Self Tier, Spirit Transformation Tier, and even Minor Advanced Tier elites, Ice Origin Stones couldn’t be considered precious treasures. Who would take this seriously?
Previously, they had only competed because they wanted to prove that they were stronger than others.

chapters.title: Chapter 3689: Ghostly Underworld Light
paragraphs: Chapter 3689: Ghostly Underworld Light
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

“Fortunately, I wore a few more clothes!” Ling Han lowered his head to look. This ray of light swept past, and the Battle Armor on his left arm was actually completely sliced open. There was even a gash on his skin, and blood was presently seeping out.
Thankfully, it was only a very thin wound. Otherwise, blood would not be oozing out, but rather gushing out.
F***, what a freak!

When Luo Xuan saw this, he was also startled. In his opinion, this slash was enough to cut off Ling Han’s arm, but now, it had actually only sliced off a little skin, and a little blood was seeping out.
Was there anyone as freakish as you, wearing so many Battle Armors on your body?

The Battle Armor’s main purpose wasn’t defense, but rather to borrow the Battle Armor’s energy to increase one’s battle prowess. This was because the Battle Armor’s defense had an obvious weakness. It couldn’t defend against shock-type attacks, and wearing too many would also affect one’s flexibility. The Battle Armor could spread out a shield, but the shield couldn’t be stacked, so the effect of wearing however many layers was the same.
However, the Battle Armor’s anti-cutting attacks were extremely effective. Just now, the dozen over layers of armor had all taken effect, blocking his celestial technique almost completely.
This was really a blind cat meeting a dead mouse?.

“Humph, you can block one strike from me, and can you block ten, or even a hundred strikes?” Luo Xuan smirked coldly. He only had to attack a few more times, and even if you had worn over a dozen Battle Armors, so what? He would still be able to destroy them all.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s expression was calm, and he asked calmly, “How many times can you use such a powerful move?”
Luo Xuan instantly faltered. The stronger the might of the celestial technique, the greater the burden would naturally be on him, and he would not be able to use it too many times.

He humphed, “It would not be a problem for me to deal with you.” “Then why don’t you give it a try?” Ling Han was naturally unafraid. He stretched out his right hand in front of him. Chi, a small flame immediately began to burn.
Heavenly Dao Flames.

This wasn’t the Heavenly Dao Flames that Ling Han had harvested from the Flaming Canyon. Instead, it was Ling Han’s comprehension of the Heavenly Dao Flames through the flame seals communicating with high-level energy. When Luo Xuan saw this, he couldn’t help but laugh loudly. This little flame wanted to oppose him?
However, it wasn’t long before he stopped laughing.
This little flame was not simple.
Luo Xuan was arrogant, but how could a two-star genius be an idiot? On the other hand, he was extremely smart and had good insight.
High-level energy was divided into grades, and the feeling that this flame gave him… seemed to be the strongest flame in the world, capable of burning even Saints to death.
Of course, he had never seen a Saint before, nor did he know the might of a Saint. However, these flames were far too powerful, so he couldn’t help but feel this way.
“Hand over the corresponding Fire Spirit Diagram!” he shouted at Ling Han, “I can spare your life.”
Ling Han smiled faintly, “In your dreams.”
“You’re not going to tell me? Then I’ll force you to tell me!” Luo Xuan charged over. He was going to capture Ling Han and force out the Spirit Diagram.

The level of this Spirit Diagram was definitely astonishingly high. If he could obtain it, it would allow his battle prowess to soar, and in future, his battle prowess would rise to another level. It was also possible for him to advance into the ranks of three-star geniuses.
Ling Han brandished his fists in response. Boom, boom, boom! The two of them were embroiled in an intense battle.

Without using the celestial technique, Luo Xuan was no stronger than Ling Han. Furthermore, Ling Han had also used the Heavenly Dao Flames. Even though it was just a small flame, Luo Xuan didn’t dare to touch it at all.
In this way, Luo Xuan was naturally at a disadvantage.

“Humph, don’t think that I have no way to deal with you.” Luo Xuan channelled out another celestial technique, and struck out rapidly with both palms. Seals spread out, and even the heaven and earth paled in colour.
He also used high-level energy. Though it was inferior to the Heavenly Dao Flames, it could also increase battle prowess.
The two of them battled fiercely, and for the moment, it was hard to decide who was stronger between them.
“Striking Celestial Technique!” Luo Xuan suddenly used this powerful move again. It was probably because the “cooldown time” had passed.
Ling Han humphed, “Do you think I’m afraid of you!”
Three Styles of the God of War!
He also channeled his own powerful move. Suddenly, it was as if he had become the center of heaven and earth. Endless energy surged out, converging in his body, allowing him to become a vessel.
Boom!
The power of heaven and earth was unleashed, and surged towards Luo Xuan. What was even more terrifying was the fact that there was Heavenly Dao Flames embedded in this terrifying energy!

And this was still because Ling Han’s understanding of the Three Styles of the God of War was limited by his cultivation level, and there was no way to turn force into a seal. Otherwise, this might would be even more terrifying.
The Three Styles of the God of War against Striking Celestial Technique!
Frightening energy collided, forming a small-scale mushroom cloud that rose into the air.
Luo Xuan was shocked. In this exchange, he actually did not get the upper hand. Instead, his hands were burnt by the power of the flames. Thankfully, it was only a slight wound to his flesh.
Xiu! Ling Han charged over, unleashing the second form of the Three Styles of God of War.
Luo Xuan gritted his teeth, and struck again with the Striking Celestial Technique.
Boom!

The astonishing power exploded once more, causing the entire mountain to rumble loudly. An unlucky fool just happened to walk up to the summit at this moment, and was immediately sent flying by the shockwave that had seeped out.
Ling Han was furious as he unleashed the third style of the Three Styles of the God of War.

Luo Xuan was shocked. Striking Celestial Technique could not be channelled continuously. He had used it twice consecutively, and his body was already boiling. A mouthful of blood was in his throat, and he was just about to spit it out.
However, faced with Ling Han’s attack, did he have a chance to dodge?
-It was as if he had been restrained by the heaven, and had nowhere to run at all.
Then, he would just fight him head-on!
Luo Xuan once again struck out with the Striking Celestial Technique towards Ling Han.
Boom! The two ultimate moves collided for the third time.

“F*ck!” The person who had been sent flying had just climbed back up. He was filled with anger. Who had he offended? He had just appeared, and he had already been sent flying. Naturally, he had to seek an explanation.
But he had just run back, and had not even finished his words, when he was sent flying again. The extent of the trauma in his heart at this moment could naturally be imagined.
Pu, Luo Xuan spat out a mouthful of blood. He could no longer suppress the boiling inside his body.
He didn’t want to be on the back foot any longer, so he hurriedly retrieved his precious tool.
An oil lamp. This was a precious tool of extremely high grade, especially the oil within. It had been refined by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and as flames spewed out, its might was boundless.

Using this to kill a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator was really like using a sledgehammer to kill a chicken, but aside from that, what else could match his opponent’s terrifying celestial technique?

He naturally did not know that Ling Han’s Three Styles of = the God of War was not much better than his Striking Celestial Technique. After using it once, it would take quite a while before he could use it a second time. Otherwise, it was possible that he would be the first to shatter.

“You should be proud of yourself for being able to force me to use the Ghostly Underworld Lamp!” Luo Xuan said proudly. With a thought, the oil lamp immediately lit up. Instantly, ghostly shadows appeared all around them, filled with a baleful and terrifying aura.
What a heavy evil Qi!
Ling Han’s heart clenched, and he felt his entire body go cold. It was as if countless cold hands were pressing down on him, wanting to extract his life essence and turn him into a dried corpse.
“An!” he shouted loudly. The Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse specialized in subduing evil beasts and suppressing internal demons.
Instantly, shrill ghostly wails rang out in the surroundings, as if those vengeful ghosts had been injured, and were wailing loudly.

“You are a member of the Buddhist Race?” Luo Xuan revealed an expression of shock. The Buddhist Race belonged to the Imperial Clan, one of the strongest forces in the world. For example, for those like him who cultivated an evil art, the greatest taboo was Buddhism.
