The Buddhist Race belonged to the Imperial Clan, one of the strongest forces in the world.
For example, for those like him who cultivated an evil art, the greatest taboo was Buddhism.

chapters.title: Chapter 3690: Forming a Corpse into a Tool
paragraphs: Chapter 3690: Forming a Corpse into a Tool
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han rubbed his head, and asked, “Do you have no eyes, or do I indeed have no hair?”

The Buddhist Race was not a bloodline-specific group. As long as one was willing to convert, anyone could become a member of the Buddhist Race. However, if one wanted to join the Buddhist Race, the first step was to shave, and sever all his mortal bonds, signifying that he had let go of everything in the past.
Luo Xuan stared at Ling Han’s hair. Who knows, Ling Han’s hair may have been expedited by mystical power.
“This is real!” Ling Han was furious, and shot out a murderous aura attack towards Luo Xuan.
Luo Xuan only felt a pain in his mind, and almost screamed out in pain. No matter how many times he sustained this kind of attack, he could not get used to it. It always caused him unbearable pain.
“I will make your death too horrible to look at!” he said through gritted teeth.
“Die!” He blew lightly at the oil lamp, and instantly, the flame that was originally only the size of a soybean suddenly shot up. A green flame burned towards Ling Han.
This was… ghost fire!
Ling Han saw very clearly. One after another, skulls popped out of the green flames, baring their mouths, as if they wanted to swallow him whole.
“An!”
The chant of the Buddhist Race was called out loudly, expelling evil and repelling demons.

The skulls were indeed affected, but this Ghostly Underworld Lamp was a replica of a precious treasure. Though its grade wasn’t high, the lamp oil used inside was personally refined by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, so its might was naturally extraordinary.

If Ling Han was in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, then he would be able to suppress evil even if it was just a single word “An”. However, the problem was that he was only in the Foundation Building Tier.
If a Foundation Building cultivator could eliminate the power of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, that would truly be illogical.

“Hahaha, ignorant fool!” Luo Xuan was proud. By now, the ghostly flames had already surrounded Ling Han. Ling Han had nowhere to go, and could only wait for death. “This lamp oil was refined by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and what ingredients are used? Cauldron Forging Tier corpse oil, at least!”
F***, no wonder it was so evil!
Ling Han’s eyes sharpened, and he said, “You actually refined a tool from a corpse? You truly deserve death!”

“Since they are already dead, it’s not a waste to make use of trash.” Luo Xuan chuckled, and said, “Don’t worry, even though you’re only at the Foundation Building Tier, I won’t waste it either. I’ll personally refine your corpse into corpse oil!”
“Refine your sister!” Ling Han roared loudly. Xiu! The Heavenly Pattern Jade shot out.
Luo Xuan was just smug, thinking that Ling Han was already a dead man. Who would have thought that Ling Han would have such a deadly weapon?
Under the impact of 30 times the speed of sound, with the distance between the two of them being only about 30 meters, how much time would it need?
As fast as lightning, Heavenly Pattern Jade passed through the sea of flames and arrived before Luo Xuan’s chest.
Luo Xuan was shocked, but did not take it to heart. What could a mere concealed weapon do to him?
He also activated his divine sense, transforming it into a net of Spiritual Power to block the Heavenly Pattern Jade.
This was a pure contest of Spiritual Power.
However, his expression immediately changed.
F***, this was too heavy. It was like a mountain was rolling over, and was not something that his divine sense could stop at all.
His divine sense was far too powerful, no?
Cauldron Forging Tier?
That’s right. At least, it had to be someone in the Cauldron Forging Tier that could deliver such terrifying power.
But how could a Foundation Building Tier cultivator possibly possess Cauldron Forging Tier-level Spiritual Power?
Realization dawned on him. This was not because Ling Han’s Spiritual Power was too strong, but rather that this was a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!

The strength of the Spiritual Power Spirit Tool was that it could use one’s Spiritual Power to first compress its weight. It clearly weighed 5,000kg, or even millions of kg, but could be compressed to a few grams. When it was shot out with Spiritual Power to reach its maximum speed, it recovered to its normal weight.
To block such an attack, just how strong would that Spiritual Power have to be?
It had to be 10,000 times stronger than the other, or even millions of times stronger!
They were both in the Foundation Building Tier, so how was this possible?
In this instant, countless thoughts flashed through Luo Xuan’s mind. He hurriedly pushed the oil lamp to block it, while he slanted his head to the side.
Pa, a crisp sound rang out, and blood gushed out. Luo Xuan’s right hand had been smashed into bits, and the oil lamp in his hand was naturally lost as well, drawing out an arc in the air.

“Ah—” Luo Xuan screamed in pain. One of his arms had been forcefully shattered, so it was naturally extraordinarily painful, and what pained him even more was the fact that losing a hand would cause his battle prowess to drop greatly. How would he be able to join the ranks of prodigies in future?
“Killing people to refine their corpses is unacceptable to the heaven and earth!” Ling Han charged over, “I’ll send you on your way!”
Luo Xuan hurriedly pulled himself together. Now was not the time to cry out in pain.

He set off in pursuit of the oil lamp. Now that he had lost a hand, his battle prowess had dropped drastically. He had to rely on the might of the Spirit Tool, or he would really be blasted into smithereens by Ling Han.
How could Ling Han allow him to succeed? He activated the Imminent Skyline, and peng, he crashed into Luo Xuan.
Luo Xuan looked at his fingertips that were about to touch the Ghostly Underworld Light, but a powerful force assaulted him, and his figure involuntarily flew out.
“No!” Seeing that he was getting further and further away from the Ghostly Underworld Light, he released a loud roar.
Ling Han humphed, and stretched out a hand to grab the Ghostly Underworld Light. However, he had just stretched out his hand, when a powerful feeling of danger rose up in his heart.
He hurriedly retracted his hand, and without the slightest hesitation, channeled the Starlight Screen.
Boom, a field of ghostly flames sprayed out, surrounding him.

The Starlight Screen very quickly melted. This ghostly flame was incredibly powerful. To say nothing of the might reaching Cauldron Forging Tier, its might definitely far surpassed the ordinary Ultimate Foundation Tier.
Ling Han had no choice but to summon the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The precious tower hovered above his head, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos aura.

“Hahahaha!” Luo Xuan laughed loudly. Previously, he had deliberately pretended to be furious. In truth, that Ghostly Underworld Lamp had already fused with his divine sense, and there was absolutely no need for actual contact to be able to unleash its might.
Ling Han’s body was surrounded by ghostly flames when he came into close contact with it, so he could only be burned into a dried corpse.
—Against the Ghostly Underworld Lamp, there was only one way to survive, and that was to run when he saw it, so that the Ghostly Underworld Lamp would not be given the chance to unleash its might.
However, his laughter soon came to an abrupt stop.
What was going on?
Ling Han summoned a precious tower, and it actually blocked the ghostly flames?

This was refined by a Spirit Transformation True Lord. The ghostly flames were enough to pose a threat to even those at Cauldron Forging Tier, and now it actually couldn’t burn a Foundation Building cultivator to death? No, it couldn’t burn through the defenses of a precious tool that belonged to a Foundation Building Tier cultivator?

Ling Han didn’t waste any time. Limited by his cultivation level, the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was also limited. It couldn’t resist the ghost flames for a long time, so he had to end the battle as soon as possible.
He charged out, and his terrifying battle prowess surged, launching a flurry of attacks at Luo Xuan.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

Luo Xuan was exhausted from parrying the attacks. He was severely wounded, and without a single arm, his battle prowess had naturally declined greatly, so how could he possibly withstand Ling Han’s barrage of attacks?
Zi, zi, zi! Lightning bolts shot out continuously from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and the air of Primal Chaos also descended. Every bolt of lightning was as heavy as a mountain.
Luo Xuan was astonished. What kind of precious tool was this? Wasn’t it a little too terrifying?
“I can’t accept this!” he roared at the sky, tears of blood streaming from his eyes.

In terms of true battle prowess, he thought that he was stronger than Ling Han, but because Ling Han had too many precious tools, he had first crippled one of his arms, and also blocked the Ghostly Underworld Light, causing him to fall into desperate straits.
Thus, he was unwilling to accept this..

chapters.title: Chapter 3691: Strange Tree
paragraphs: Chapter 3691: Strange Tree
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han naturally didn’t show any mercy.

Firstly, there was no need to talk about fairness to this kind of person who refined corpse oil into a precious tool. Secondly, wasn’t it also him who had used the precious tool first? Thirdly, what cultivation level was Ling Han?
It was already unfair for an Ultimate Dao Foundation against a Human Dao Foundation in the first place,so what if he used a precious tool?
He forcefully suppressed him, each strike fatal.
“Who are you? Who are you?” Luo Xuan roared in fury.

“The one who’s going to kill you is Niu Jianhua,” Ling Han said calmly. In any case, Niu Jianhua had already taken a lot of blame for him, so it didn’t matter if he took another. As for Ling Han… he had never been to the Black Moon Planet before.
There wouldn’t be anyone who would connect a Low Grade Human Tier alchemist, Ling Han, with a great thief in the Mystery Realm, right?

“Niu Jianhua! Niu Jianhua!” Luo Xuan gritted his teeth. He knew that he would definitely not be spared today, and was using a technique to carve the name of the culprit who had “killed” him. The instant he died, it would appear on his personal memorial tablet at his sect.
There would definitely be someone who would avenge him.
“Hahahaha, Niu Jianhua, do you think that you can kill me in this Mystery Realm and no one would know?” Luo Xuan laughed loudly, “You are wrong. I have my own means to inform my Master.”
“Are you threatening me?” Ling Han’s attacks didn’t stop. At this point, how could he give up halfway?

“That’s right.” Luo Xuan said coldly, “If you don’t want to be hunted down eternally by the Earth Ghost Sect, you had best stop immediately! The two of us are of the same generation, but if you kill me, then you would have formed a life-or-death enmity with the Earth Ghost Sect!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I am the Buddhist Race’s Dao Child, so why would I be afraid of demons and monsters like you?”
F***, didn’t you previously say that you weren’t a member of the Buddhist Race? Why have you now become the Dao Child of the Buddhist Race?
Luo Xuan was a little dazed, and even more swayed. Was the identity that Ling Han had previously revealed to him false?
Ling Han unleashed the Three Styles of the God of War again, launching a mad barrage of attacks at Luo Xuan.
Previously, when Luo Xuan was in his prime condition, he was already extremely strained to parry these three styles. Now that he had crippled one of his arms, how was he supposed to block?

He just barely managed to block the first two styles, but when he came to the third style, he was blasted violently, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also delivered a twofold attack. The power of lightning and the air of Primal Chaos intertwined, and this power was also incredibly terrifying.
Peng!
Luo Xuan fell onto the ground. A burnt smell wafted from his body, and several dozen of his bones had been broken.
“You, who exactly are you?” He forcibly raised his head, looking at Ling Han. “Niu Jianhua,” Ling Han said. He threw a punch, and the Heavenly Dao Flames swept over, burning Luo Xuan into ashes.

Ding, a ring landed on the ground. This was Luo Xuan’s Spatial Spirit Tool. Ling Han stowed it away without any reservations. Then, he suppressed it with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and also stored the Ghostly Underworld Light into his Spatial Spirit Tool.
—Since Luo Xuan was dead, the divine sense that he had left in the Ghostly Underworld Lamp was naturally destroyed as well, and could no longer pose a threat to Ling Han.
-How to deal with this evil weapon is a problem.” Ling Han frowned. This kind of evil thing naturally could not be sold, and he himself could not possibly use
it either.
Forget it. When he refined the ingredients in the future, he should be able to forge it into other precious tools.
Ling Han collected his emotions, and continued onwards, chasing after the rest.

His battle with Luo Xuan had indeed delayed some time. After advancing for about half an hour, he had also walked out of the mountains. A plain appeared ahead of him. He had not walked too far, and the plain had already reached its end.
There was a tree there, a very strange tree. Its leaves were pitifully small, only the size of soybeans, but there were a great many massive fruits borne on it.

These fruits were really huge, and came in all sorts of shapes and sizes. Some looked like humans, some looked like wolves, some looked like eagles, and some looked like fish. They hung from the tree, and were heavy, pressing down so hard that even the branches were bent, making one worry that they would
break from the strain.

The branches of the tree were as black as iron, and the leaves were crimson red, as if they were stained with blood, while the fruits were pure white. With such a comparison, it was extraordinarily clear which was which..
There were a great many people beneath the tree. Hong Tianbu, An Jiuyue and the people who had previously fought over the Ice Origin Stone.
They all sat on the ground, raising their heads to look at the tree. For a long time, they did not move, as if they were not afraid of having their necks broken.
Ling Han was extremely curious, and he strode over. However, no one paid him any attention.
Just at this moment, pa, a fruit on the tree broke off from the branch and landed heavily on the ground.
Yi, no one was fighting over it?
Ling Han looked to his left and right, only to see that everyone was seated firmly. They didn’t look like they were going to stand up and fight for the throne.
Pa! The fruit was far too ripe, and it instantly cracked apart. Boundless divine light instantly surged into the surroundings.
Looking closely, there were multiple seals in this light.
At this moment, everyone looked eager.
Xiu! A streak of divine light shot toward the northwest.
Instantly, the people in that direction began to compete. They all leaped towards that streak of light, as if they wanted to capture this streak of light.
Just as these people were locked in a fierce battle, another streak of divine light suddenly shot out, heading directly east.
Ling Han just happened to be in this direction, and seeing that everyone was fighting over it, he followed the trend and joined the ranks of those fighting over it.
“Get lost!”
“That’s mine!”
“Those who block me will be killed without mercy!”
Everyone roared in fury, unleashing powerful attacks one after another, attacking indiscriminately.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura. Weng! Everyone felt a pain in their minds, and their attacks instantly slowed down.

This was only an instant, but Ling Han only needed this instant. The Imminent Skyline was used, and his speed was extraordinarily fast. He had already collided with the divine light, and instantly, that light surged into his body. Endless enlightenment instantly arose in Ling Han’s mind. It was as if he had become a hundred times smarter. Things that he couldn’t figure out or understand under normal circumstances instantly became clear and simple.
Yi, this could help him comprehend Dao!
Ling Han was astounded. What kind of tree was this? It looked so strange, and the fallen fruits couldn’t be eaten, but they emitted divine light that could help one comprehend Dao.
No wonder everyone was fighting over it. This divine light was indeed a good thing.
Even though the fruit was astonishingly huge, in truth, it was completely exhausted after shooting out five flashes of light. The skin of the fruit collapsed, and it was completely empty.

Each of the five streaks of divine light had their own master. Ling Han managed to snatch one, Hong Tianbu managed to snatch one, An Jiuyue managed to snatch one, and Cheng Daohe and Hong Xinghan also managed to obtain one each. Ling Han found out the names of these two people when he heard them being called.
Whether it was those that had obtained the divine light or those that had not, they all sat down.
Since no one came to cause trouble, Ling Han was also happy to begin comprehension.
Multiple formation patterns appeared in his mind. Even if he was already at the beginner level, these formation patterns were too complex, and it was still incredibly difficult to grasp them.
Now, with the help of the divine light, his comprehension ability had an astonishing improvement, which was naturally used to study formation patterns.
-In alchemy and martial arts, he actually did not need this kind of additional help.
In less than ten minutes, this kind of strengthening effect disappeared, and Ling Han had only grasped one formation pattern.
Sigh, so slow..

break from the strain.
The branches of the tree were as black as iron, and the leaves were crimson red, as if they were stained with blood, while the fruits were pure white.
With such a comparison, it was extraordinarily clear which was which..
There were a great many people beneath the tree.
Hong Tianbu, An Jiuyue and the people who had previously fought over the Ice Origin Stone.
They all sat on the ground, raising their heads to look at the tree.
For a long time, they did not move, as if they were not afraid of having their necks broken.
Ling Han was extremely curious, and he strode over.
However, no one paid him any attention.
Just at this moment, pa, a fruit on the tree broke off from the branch and landed heavily on the ground.
Yi, no one was fighting over it?
Ling Han looked to his left and right, only to see that everyone was seated firmly.
They didn’t look like they were going to stand up and fight for the throne.
Pa!
The fruit was far too ripe, and it instantly cracked apart.
Boundless divine light instantly surged into the surroundings.
Looking closely, there were multiple seals in this light.
At this moment, everyone looked eager.
Xiu!
A streak of divine light shot toward the northwest.
Instantly, the people in that direction began to compete.
They all leaped towards that streak of light, as if they wanted to capture this streak of light.
Just as these people were locked in a fierce battle, another streak of divine light suddenly shot out, heading directly east.
Ling Han just happened to be in this direction, and seeing that everyone was fighting over it, he followed the trend and joined the ranks of those fighting over it.
“Get lost!”
“That’s mine!”
“Those who block me will be killed without mercy!”
Everyone roared in fury, unleashing powerful attacks one after another, attacking indiscriminately.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Weng!
Everyone felt a pain in their minds, and their attacks instantly slowed down.
This was only an instant, but Ling Han only needed this instant.
The Imminent Skyline was used, and his speed was extraordinarily fast.
He had already collided with the divine light, and instantly, that light surged into his body.
Endless enlightenment instantly arose in Ling Han’s mind.
It was as if he had become a hundred times smarter.
Things that he couldn’t figure out or understand under normal circumstances instantly became clear and simple.
Yi, this could help him comprehend Dao!
Ling Han was astounded.
What kind of tree was this?
It looked so strange, and the fallen fruits couldn’t be eaten, but they emitted divine light that could help one comprehend Dao.
No wonder everyone was fighting over it.
This divine light was indeed a good thing.
Even though the fruit was astonishingly huge, in truth, it was completely exhausted after shooting out five flashes of light.
The skin of the fruit collapsed, and it was completely empty.
Each of the five streaks of divine light had their own master.
Ling Han managed to snatch one, Hong Tianbu managed to snatch one, An Jiuyue managed to snatch one, and Cheng Daohe and Hong Xinghan also managed to obtain one each.
Ling Han found out the names of these two people when he heard them being called.
Whether it was those that had obtained the divine light or those that had not, they all sat down.
Since no one came to cause trouble, Ling Han was also happy to begin comprehension.
Multiple formation patterns appeared in his mind.
Even if he was already at the beginner level, these formation patterns were too complex, and it was still incredibly difficult to grasp them.
Now, with the help of the divine light, his comprehension ability had an astonishing improvement, which was naturally used to study formation patterns.
-In alchemy and martial arts, he actually did not need this kind of additional help.
In less than ten minutes, this kind of strengthening effect disappeared, and Ling Han had only grasped one formation pattern.
Sigh, so slow..

paragraphs: Chapter 3692: Seizing the divine light
Translator: Henyee Translations I Editor: Henyee Translations
If those Formation Masters heard Ling Han’s complaints, they would definitely be furious.
This was too infuriating.
Just to comprehend a single formation pattern, which of them hadn’t spent five years or even ten years? You grasped one in ten minutes, and you think it’s slow?

Why was it so difficult to become a Formation Master? This was one of the reasons. If you needed so much time to comprehend a formation pattern, then constructing a formation would need dozens or even hundreds of formation patterns, so how many years would that take?
Moreover, formation patterns also had the ability to evolve and change into thousands of different shapes, making it even more difficult to grasp.

Ling Han had always been accustomed to being fast, so he naturally felt that it had been more than half a year since he had advanced into Celestial Path, and only then did he manage to grasp a formation pattern. This was practically as slow as a snail.
He would just have to wait for another divine light.
Ling Han thought internally. One streak of divine light could increase his comprehension ability by ten minutes, then would two streaks be twenty minutes, and three streaks be thirty minutes?
En, next, he would have to snatch all the divine light.
However, this would make him a public enemy, right?
It was fine. He would just kill them all.
Ling Han thought. Killing intent surged, with a kind of madness.
Hold on, why had he become bloodthirsty?
Ling Han hurriedly recited the Six Characters Bright King Curse in his mind. An, instantly, a the Buddhist chant reverberated in his body, and his killing intent immediately retreated.
He couldn’t help but feel a chill run down his spine.
“I seem to have been unknowingly affected, and have become bloodthirsty.”
“Is it because of the side effects of that divine light?”
“Or is it this tree?”
“This thing definitely doesn’t exist among Celestial Plants that can be used as medicine.”

When this fruit falls to the ground, it shoots out divine light in all directions, but can increase one’s comprehension ability. Clearly, it could not possibly be’ used in medicine, so I did not see any corresponding Celestial Seed in the information on alchemy.”
“What’s the Holy Land of Metal Element doing?”
“This must be the Celestial Plant that they speak of, yet they want us to kill each other?”

Ling Han had long since suspected the actions of the Holy Land of Metal Element. Now, he was naturally even more apprehensive, but he was still unafraid, because the Primal Chaos Exreme Lightning Tower still contained the reaHeavenly Dao Flames. Though its current might had decreased to below the level of a Saint, the Holy Land of Metal Element no longer had a Saint either.
Worse come to worst, he would burn down the Holy Land!
Ling Han nodded. Then, it was even more necessary for him to keep his identity a secret. He did not want others to pursue him all the way to Celestial Sea Planet.
En, Niu Jianhua, you continue to show your remaining usefulness, and take the blame for him.
After half an hour, pa, a new fruit fell down.
“Mine!”
“Get lost!”
“Those who block me will die!”
Everyone came to blows, incredibly frenzied, drawing blood at every turn.
Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline, and coupled with the barrage of murderous aura, he successfully snatched the first streak of divine light.
And when the second divine light shot out, he snatched it again.
“B@stard!”
“You’ve gone too far!”
“Die!”
This enraged everyone in that direction, and they all directed their attacks at Ling Han.
Ling Han unleashed a murderous aura attack. Weng! Everyone felt a pain in their minds, and their attacks couldn’t help but slow down.
Ling Han activated the Imminent Skyline. His speed was incredible. Xiu! He faced the divine light head-on and caught hold of the second one.
“Damn it!”
This time, the remaining people were all furious. Even the people from the other directions moved one after another. This caused Ling Han to continue snatching; that divine light would also be his.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and streaked towards the third divine light that had just appeared. The Starlight Screen spread out, boosting his powerful defense. “Humph!” Hong Tianbu made a move. He tapped out a finger, and instantly, endless black light condensed, blasting towards Ling Han.

This attack was extraordinarily fast. Pu, it landed on the Starlight Screen, and actually created a hole in the light barrier. Thankfully, the power of the finger had also been exhausted, and it turned back into bits of light.
As expected of Hong Tianbu.
This guy was Heavenly Dao Foundation, and he himself was a super genius. Combined with the eye of the Primordial Beast, his battle prowess was truly unfathomable.
Ling Han ignored him. Right now, the most important thing was to contend for the divine light.
He sped up, unleashing the murderous aura and seizing the opportunity to snatch it.𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖
The third divine light had been successfully captured!
However, everyone was in a riot now, blasting towards Ling Han. With these people joining forces, even Ling Han didn’t dare to face them head-on. He hurriedly turned around and fled.
Three flashes of divine light… would be enough for half an hour.
Imminent Skyline was activated, and no one could catch up to him.
After Ling Han shook them off, he immediately stopped, channeled the power of divine light, and began to appreciate formations.
Sure enough, the three streaks of divine light gave him thirty minutes to comprehend.
He had mastered another three formation patterns, very good.
Ling Han quietly hid himself, waiting for the new fruit to fall.
In just over a minute, a fruit fell. Pa, divine light shone brilliantly.
Now was the time!
Ling Han charged out. Using the Imminent Skyline, he was as fast as lightning.
“Here it is again!”
“That great thief!”
“Niu Jianhua, f*ck your ancestors!”
Everyone was gritting their teeth, wanting nothing more than to tear him into pieces.
Ling Han laughed loudly. The barrage of murderous aura was time-tested, and no one could escape. Even if it was only for an instant, it was enough for Ling Han.???6
He was slightly faster than everyone else, and the divine light entered his body.
“Damn guy!”
Everyone’s anger soared, but what could they do?
Ling Han always had a way to paralyze their attacks, and his speed was slightly faster, so they could only watch helplessly as Ling Han snatched away the divine light.
This feeling was really too terrible.

Ling Han laughed loudly. He was like a soaring dragon in the sea, and his speed was extraordinarily fast. As he circled around the Celestial Tree at high speed, he waited for the second divine light to shoot out.
“In your dreams!” Everyone was enraged, and they all summoned their precious tools, launching a barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
However, there were far too many people at this moment, so the precious tools instantly unleashed an indiscriminate barrage of attacks, causing a huge commotion.
There was an indescribable aura affecting everyone here, causing them to become bloodthirsty. Now that the massacre had begun, no one could stop.
A chaotic battle broke out. Everyone’s eyes were red, seeing any one of them as an opponent, and attacked without any reservations.
However, even under such circumstances, there were still people who remained conscious.

Ling Han had the Six Characters Bright King Curse, and in addition, Hong Tianbu, An Jiuyue, and Cheng Daohe all had their own methods. There was a glimmer of precious light flickering on their bodies, resisting that thing that could make one lose their senses.
They continued to pursue the divine light, while they continued to defend against the frenzied attacks of the others.
However, in terms of speed, none of them could compare to Ling Han. Among the five flashes of divine light, Ling Han alone had three. This was already enough. It would be a waste even if he had more.
Ling Han didn’t linger in battle any longer. He turned around and left.

In the Holy Land of Metal Element, there were presently three youngsters with outstanding reputations stare at a jade wall, and the jade wall was actually showing the scene of Ling Han, Hong Tianbu and the others fighting beneath the Celestial Tree.
“Old Seventh, who do you think is the strongest among these people?” a white-robed man asked. His face was as fair as jade, and there was a small red mole between his brows.
The person he referred to as Seventh also had a handsome face. He wore a creamy yellow long robe, and carried a long sword on his back. He had a rather confident air.
If the other disciples of the Holy Land of Metal Element were here, they would definitely recognize that this was the well-known Twelve Star Envoys of the Holy Land.
The white-robed man, Hou Yongzheng, was ranked fifth. The yellow-robed young man, Shi An, was ranked seventh, and the third was Wen Feiwen, who was ranked ninth..

chapters.title: Chapter 3693: Twelve Candidates
paragraphs: Chapter 3693: Twelve Candidates
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Hong Tianbu, of course,” Shi An replied.
Hou Yongzheng was surprised, and asked, “Why are you not optimistic about that great thief?”
“Niu Jianhua?” Shi An shook his head, “Though his strength is not too bad, most of the time, he wins by depending on treasures and movement techniques. Thus, I think Hong Tianbu is still stronger.’1
“Then what about An Jiuyue?” Wen Feiwen interrupted, “There’s also Cheng Daohe. They’re all no weaker than Hong Tianbu, right?”
“Much weaker,” Shi An said with a shake of his head. “Ninth, your taste is still a little lacking.”

“Sigh, so what if we know who’s the strongest?” Shi An shook his head, and said, “Eldest Senior Brother, Second Senior Sister and the others would choose first. Whether it’s Hong Tianbu , or Niu Jianhua, An Jiuyue, or Cheng Daohe, it’s impossible that they will be left for us.”
“Hehe, these people are really stupid. Did they think that there would be great fortune waiting for them?” Wen Feiwen scoffed.

“Forget it. Being able to stand out from so many prodigies, every single one of them is a prodigy among prodigies.” Hou Yongzheng shook his head, his interest waning slightly. They were ranked at the bottom of the Twelve Stars Envoys, so they could only pick the “leftovers”.
“Heh, it’s a shame that we can only reveal the truth to them to years later. Just the thought of it makes me eager to see the expressions on their faces,” Shi An said with a hint of mockery.
Inside the Mystery Realm.

After Ling Han digested the three flashes of divine light, he grasped another three formation patterns. He quietly hid, and saw that under the Celestial Tree, there were already a dozen over people lying down, their blood dyeing the ground red.
This competition was really fierce, and under normal circumstances, would these prodigies fight so desperately for the sake of temporarily improving their comprehension ability?
It was obviously impossible.

It was as if the Holy Land of Metal Element was cultivating a parasite, using brutal slaughter to determine the limited victors. As for how great the losses would be, they did not take it to heart at all.
Ling Han waited, and when a new fruit fell, he charged out, snatching the divine light.

Time slowly passed, and there were fewer and fewer fruits on the tree, while the number of people at the bottom of the tree actually did not decrease because of the replenishment of those who came later.
Under such circumstances, elites naturally stood out.

Ling Han, Hong Tianbu, An Qiye, Cheng Daohe, and so on. Not only did the few powerful figures persist, but they also had their own gains. However, the others added together did not have as many gains as Ling Han alone?.
Seven days later, all the fruits on the tree had fallen.
The fruits were gone, so they naturally had to continue forward. However, everyone discovered that there was no path ahead of them.
This plain was the end of the Mystery Realm, and there was no way out.
How were they supposed to return?
Another half a day later, a change suddenly took place underneath the Celestial Tree. It was just a pillar of light soaring into the skies.
What was going on?
Everyone gathered around, only to see a complex formation appearing beneath the large tree.
“This is the Transfer Formation,” someone said.
“The way out!”

Quite a number of people were pleasantly surprised. Their speed was not very fast, and they had initially thought that there was no hope for them to charge into the top 12. They had not expected that the formation for them to leave would open so late.
This time, everyone was standing on the same starting line, and everyone had a chance.
Everyone was waiting. Once the formation activated, they would launch an attack. This was first come, first served, and those who were stronger might not have the last laugh.
Very soon, the formation patterns were all displayed, and lit up one after another.
They could leave now.
Instantly, everyone rushed forwards. There was no need to defeat others, as long as they were fast enough.
“A bunch of trash trying to reap without sowing?” An Jiuyue said with a cold chuckle. With a shake of her hands, energy surged into the surroundings, unleashing an indiscriminate barrage of attacks.
Peng, peng, peng! The people in the surroundings were all sent flying.
“Scram!” Hong Tianbu also roared loudly. The single eye of the Primordial Beast opened, and xiu, a ray of light shot out. Wherever it touched, everyone would be turned into stone.
Cheng Daohe slashed out with his sword, and Sword Qi danced, capable of striking the heavens. Everyone dodged.
Meanwhile, Ling Han shot out a murderous aura attack. Everyone was affected, but the stronger one’s strength and willpower, the shorter the time they would be affected.
With this wave, there were only less than twenty people that could continue forward.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
The 20 or so people continued to battle. Peng, peng, peng! Occasionally, someone would be sent flying.
There were fewer and fewer people, eighteen, fifteen, thirteen.
After another person left the battle, there were finally only 12 people left.
Everyone stopped attacking. The namelist of 12 people was out, and there was no need for them to continue fighting.
Xiu, a streak of light surged past, enveloping Ling Han and the others, and then they all disappeared.
They were the first to leave the Mystery Realm.

“Haha, congratulations on becoming the 12 people who were the first to fight out of the Mystery Realm, qualifying to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.” An elder walked out and said to the 12 people, “Come, follow me.” After they left, people gradually came out behind them, but they were immediately sent out of the Holy Land.
This was a Holy Land, and even a Sect Master-level great elite ordinarily did not have the right to enter here.
Led by the old man, Ling Han and the others arrived at a garden. The environment was beautiful, and a refreshing fragrance wafted.
There was a long table in the garden, and it was made up of six square tables that were laid out with white brocade.
“Come, sit,” the old man said, making a gesture of invitation.
Everyone sat down, one after another. Who knew what celestial fruits the Holy Land of Metal Element would offer to welcome them.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at the old man. This should be a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, or a Core Formation Tier elite, exuding an incredibly powerful aura of life.
In just a short while, a beautiful female attendant appeared gracefully, delivering a plate of fruits, which had an indescribable fragrance.
“Ten Star Fruit!” Everyone exclaimed in shock, unable to conceal their excitement.
The Ten Star Fruit was priceless, and it could fundamentally improve the physique of a cultivator. Even mediocre cultivators could possibly become prodigies.

The elder smiled, and said, “I’m Duanmu Xue, and you can all address me as Mr. Duanmu. I’m hosting the Metal Element Fruit Gathering this time, and aside from wanting to see the prodigies of the world, I also want to bestow upon all of you a great opportunity.”
The fortune of the Ten Star Fruit was indeed rare.

Duanmu Xue continued, “Aside from the Ten Star Fruit, there is also the Replenishing Source Fruit. The act of cultivation is heaven-defying. Though as the cultivation level increases, the lifespan would also increase, it would actually cause great wear and tear on the body.”
“For example, those in the Cauldron Forging Tier can theoretically live for around 2000 years, but there aren’t many that can truly live for 2000 years. Most can only live for about 1500 years.”
“Why?”
“It’s because the vitality in one’s body has been expended too much, causing one’s lifespan to greatly decrease.”

Duanmu Xue paused for a moment, then continued, “Thus, if you want to walk further on the path of cultivation, you would have to use the Treasured Fruit to compensate for the loss of vitality at every cultivation level.”
“The Replenishing Source Fruit is such a treasure.”

Everyone nodded one after another. Most of them came from forces of Spirit Transformation Tier or even Minor Advanced Tier, so they naturally had no shortage of understanding about this. However, treasures like the Replenishing Source Fruit and the Ten Star Fruit could only be possessed by the Holy Lands.
They all picked up the Treasured Fruit and ate it. This was indeed a great opportunity.

“Heh, it’s a shame that we can only reveal the truth to them to years later.
Just the thought of it makes me eager to see the expressions on their faces,” Shi An said with a hint of mockery.
Inside the Mystery Realm.
After Ling Han digested the three flashes of divine light, he grasped another three formation patterns.
He quietly hid, and saw that under the Celestial Tree, there were already a dozen over people lying down, their blood dyeing the ground red.
This competition was really fierce, and under normal circumstances, would these prodigies fight so desperately for the sake of temporarily improving their comprehension ability?
It was obviously impossible.
It was as if the Holy Land of Metal Element was cultivating a parasite, using brutal slaughter to determine the limited victors.
As for how great the losses would be, they did not take it to heart at all.
Ling Han waited, and when a new fruit fell, he charged out, snatching the divine light.

Time slowly passed, and there were fewer and fewer fruits on the tree, while the number of people at the bottom of the tree actually did not decrease because of the replenishment of those who came later.
Under such circumstances, elites naturally stood out.
Ling Han, Hong Tianbu, An Qiye, Cheng Daohe, and so on.
Not only did the few powerful figures persist, but they also had their own gains.
However, the others added together did not have as many gains as Ling Han alone?.
Seven days later, all the fruits on the tree had fallen.
The fruits were gone, so they naturally had to continue forward.
However, everyone discovered that there was no path ahead of them.
This plain was the end of the Mystery Realm, and there was no way out.
How were they supposed to return?
Another half a day later, a change suddenly took place underneath the Celestial Tree.
It was just a pillar of light soaring into the skies.
What was going on?
Everyone gathered around, only to see a complex formation appearing beneath the large tree.
“This is the Transfer Formation,” someone said.
“The way out!”
Quite a number of people were pleasantly surprised.
Their speed was not very fast, and they had initially thought that there was no hope for them to charge into the top 12.
They had not expected that the formation for them to leave would open so late.
This time, everyone was standing on the same starting line, and everyone had a chance.
Everyone was waiting.
Once the formation activated, they would launch an attack.
This was first come, first served, and those who were stronger might not have the last laugh.
Very soon, the formation patterns were all displayed, and lit up one after another.
They could leave now.
Instantly, everyone rushed forwards.
There was no need to defeat others, as long as they were fast enough.
“A bunch of trash trying to reap without sowing?” An Jiuyue said with a cold chuckle.
With a shake of her hands, energy surged into the surroundings, unleashing an indiscriminate barrage of attacks.
Peng, peng, peng!
The people in the surroundings were all sent flying.
“Scram!” Hong Tianbu also roared loudly.
The single eye of the Primordial Beast opened, and xiu, a ray of light shot out.
Wherever it touched, everyone would be turned into stone.
Cheng Daohe slashed out with his sword, and Sword Qi danced, capable of striking the heavens.
Everyone dodged.
Meanwhile, Ling Han shot out a murderous aura attack.
Everyone was affected, but the stronger one’s strength and willpower, the shorter the time they would be affected.
With this wave, there were only less than twenty people that could continue forward.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
The 20 or so people continued to battle.
Peng, peng, peng!
Occasionally, someone would be sent flying.
There were fewer and fewer people, eighteen, fifteen, thirteen.
After another person left the battle, there were finally only 12 people left.
Everyone stopped attacking.
The namelist of 12 people was out, and there was no need for them to continue fighting.
Xiu, a streak of light surged past, enveloping Ling Han and the others, and then they all disappeared.
They were the first to leave the Mystery Realm.

“Haha, congratulations on becoming the 12 people who were the first to fight out of the Mystery Realm, qualifying to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.” An elder walked out and said to the 12 people, “Come, follow me.” After they left, people gradually came out behind them, but they were immediately sent out of the Holy Land.
This was a Holy Land, and even a Sect Master-level great elite ordinarily did not have the right to enter here.
Led by the old man, Ling Han and the others arrived at a garden.
The environment was beautiful, and a refreshing fragrance wafted.
There was a long table in the garden, and it was made up of six square tables that were laid out with white brocade.
“Come, sit,” the old man said, making a gesture of invitation.
Everyone sat down, one after another.
Who knew what celestial fruits the Holy Land of Metal Element would offer to welcome them.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at the old man.
This should be a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, or a Core Formation Tier elite, exuding an incredibly powerful aura of life.
In just a short while, a beautiful female attendant appeared gracefully, delivering a plate of fruits, which had an indescribable fragrance.
“Ten Star Fruit!” Everyone exclaimed in shock, unable to conceal their excitement.
The Ten Star Fruit was priceless, and it could fundamentally improve the physique of a cultivator.
Even mediocre cultivators could possibly become prodigies.
The elder smiled, and said, “I’m Duanmu Xue, and you can all address me as Mr.
Duanmu.
I’m hosting the Metal Element Fruit Gathering this time, and aside from wanting to see the prodigies of the world, I also want to bestow upon all of you a great opportunity.”
The fortune of the Ten Star Fruit was indeed rare.
Duanmu Xue continued, “Aside from the Ten Star Fruit, there is also the Replenishing Source Fruit.
The act of cultivation is heaven-defying.
Though as the cultivation level increases, the lifespan would also increase, it would actually cause great wear and tear on the body.”
“For example, those in the Cauldron Forging Tier can theoretically live for around 2000 years, but there aren’t many that can truly live for 2000 years.
Most can only live for about 1500 years.”
“Why?”
“It’s because the vitality in one’s body has been expended too much, causing one’s lifespan to greatly decrease.”

Duanmu Xue paused for a moment, then continued, “Thus, if you want to walk further on the path of cultivation, you would have to use the Treasured Fruit to compensate for the loss of vitality at every cultivation level.”
“The Replenishing Source Fruit is such a treasure.”
Everyone nodded one after another.
Most of them came from forces of Spirit Transformation Tier or even Minor Advanced Tier, so they naturally had no shortage of understanding about this.
However, treasures like the Replenishing Source Fruit and the Ten Star Fruit could only be possessed by the Holy Lands.
They all picked up the Treasured Fruit and ate it.
This was indeed a great opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 3694: Purpose of the Holy Land
paragraphs: Chapter 3694: Purpose of the Holy Land
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

After everyone had finished eating, Duanmu Xue spoke again, and said, “Aside from the Treasured Fruit, I have another amazing cultivation technique here. As long as you all join the Holy Land and become registered disciples, I can teach it to you.”
Everyone was pleasantly surprised. Something that could be called an extraordinary cultivation technique by the Holy Land, what kind of cultivation technique was it?
Was this created by a Saint?

Meanwhile, Ling Han was surprised. Previously, the bloodshed in the Mystery Realm was so cruel, but now, they were given Treasured Fruits, and also given an amazing cultivation technique. The contrast was really too great.
Just look, he only had to be a registered disciple, so just how much freedom would he have?
However, the Holy Land of Metal Element had sacrificed so much just to obtain a few registered disciples? What was the point?
Ling Han didn’t believe that the Holy Land of Metal Element would be so kind, not giving benefits to their own people, and to outsiders instead. They weren’t fools.
Thus, he couldn’t understand why the Holy Land of Metal Element would be so generous.
“Dare I ask, Mr Duanmu, what is this amazing cultivation technique?” someone asked.

Duanmu Xue nodded, and said, “This is called Seven Saints Divine Art, and can increase your cultivation speed by more than ten times. Furthermore, the quality of mystical power would also be greatly improved. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, your power would clearly be stronger than your opponent.”

Everyone was both surprised and delighted. They were shocked that the Holy Land of Metal Element was actually willing to take out such an important cultivation technique and teach it to them. They were naturally delighted because after learning this cultivation technique, their futures would be bright and dazzling.
Not a single person was suspicious?
Ling Han was astonished. How could treasures fall from the sky for no reason? Were they all idiots?
No, not one of these people was an idiot. The reason why they all looked like they had been blinded by lard was probably because they had been affected by the Celestial Tree previously.
At that time, even he had almost transformed into a murderous demon. Thankfully, he had the Six Characters Bright King Curse to dispel the internal demon in his heart.
This wouldn’t change a person’s mind, but it would definitely have an effect, making them only see the benefits.
Alarm bells rang loudly in Ling Han’s mind. What was this Holy Land of Metal Element doing? They were definitely up to no good.
He remained calm and collected. Worse come to worst, he could just summon the Heavenly Dao Flames. In any case, he was “Niu Jianhua”, and they wouldn’t be able to find him.

“However, cultivating the Seven Saints Divine Art requires the cooperation of two people, one yin and one yang. As the saying goes, solitary yin doesn’t breed, and solitary yang doesn’t grow,” Duanmu Xue said seriously. He clapped his hands, and another twelve people walked over.
Hou Yongzheng, Shi An, and Wen Feiwen were among them. They were precisely the Twelve Star Envoys of the Holy Land of Metal Element.

“Let me introduce. These twelve people are the Twelve Star Envoys of the Holy Land, and they are also the twelve strongest members of the younger generation of our Holy Land,” Duanmu Xue said with a smile. “When one cultivates the Seven Saints Divine Art, the faster one’s partner can cultivate, the faster one’s own cultivation speed will also increase.”

“The Twelve Star Envoys have long since cultivated the Yang chapter of the Seven Saints Divine Art. Now, they will make their choice, and pass on the Yin chapter of the Seven Saints Divine Art. There are also some specific ceremonies that have to be carried out. These are all necessary.”
Hou Yongzheng and the others walked over, and didn’t spend much time either. It was as if they had long since decided, and had each found their own training partner.

Ling Han’s training partner was a woman. She was extremely beautiful, and was also the only female among the Twelve Star Envoys. Her figure was extremely tall, and she was dressed in a tight-fitting red outfit, completely highlighting her impressive figure.
She nodded at Ling Han, and said, “What a coincidence. Junior Brother Niu, my surname is Ma, and my name is Ma Fenyu.”
Was it really a coincidence between a bull and a horse??
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “I would have to disappoint Miss Ma. I have no plans to join a Holy Land, and cultivate this Seven Saints Divine Art.”
When these words fell, everyone was stunned.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
Not cultivating?
A cultivation technique that could increase the rate of cultivation by at least tenfold, and you won’t cultivate it?
This was the cultivation technique of a Holy Land!
Could it be that you don’t know what the Twelve Star Envoys represent?

In every generation, only extremely outstanding disciples would be qualified to become candidates for the position of Twelve Star Envoy, and they would have to go through countless competitions before they could officially become a Star Envoy.
Once he became a Star Envoy, this would be a lifetime position. Even if he disappeared or died, it would not be replaced or replenished.
In future, the Star Envoys would all be big shots of the Holy Land, and had hopes of becoming great elites on the level of Sect Master.
Thus, to be able to practice the Seven Saints Divine Art together with a Star Envoy, what kind of great fortune was that?
You actually refused?
Ma Fenyu had not expected this either. She stared blankly at Ling Han, and for a moment, did not know what to say.
“Hehe, I have no plans to cultivate this Seven Saints Divine Art either.” Another voice rang out.
Hong Tianbu!

Duanmu Xue’s expression was a little ugly. Ling Han and Hong Tianbu had the highest standing among this group of people, and they were also the ones he valued the most, yet now they were both saying no?

He humphed, and said, “What a joke. The teachings of the Holy Lands are not something that I would beg you all to learn.” He swept an eye over the others, and asked, “Is there anyone else that does not want to learn?”
No one spoke. Even if their divine sense wasn’t affected, they probably wouldn’t be able to resist the temptation of the Seven Saints Divine Art, right?
“All right, you guys can leave first.” Duanmu Xue waved her hand.
Everyone left, leaving only Ling Han, Hong Tianbu, Duanmu Xue, Ma Yufen, and Jiang Zhengping—Jiang Zhengping was Hong Tianbu’s training partner.
“You guys… really don’t want to learn?” Duanmu Xue’s previously gentle expression changed, and an ominous glint flashed across his face.
Ling Han smiled, “Didn’t Mr Duanmu just say that there is no need to beg us to cultivate the technique of the Holy Land? Then please send us off.”
He very much wanted to personally capture Hong Tianbu and bring him back to the Imperial Capital.
Duanmu Xue sneered, “After eating the Treasured Fruit of our Holy Land, you want to leave just like that?”
Hong Tianbu’s expression changed drastically, and he said, “As expected, there’s a conspiracy behind your teaching of the cultivation technique!”
He had fused with the eye of a Primordial Beast, so his willpower was naturally strong. Though his mind was also slightly affected, it was far better than others.
Duanmu Xue laughed loudly, and said, “Of course! We’re not a charity, specialized in doing good deeds.”
“But what conspiracy could there be in passing on cultivation techniques?” Ling Han asked.
“You don’t have to know that,” Jiang Zhengping said.
Yet Duanmu Xue smiled, and said, “It’s fine. Just tell him. In any case, he can’t possibly run out.”
He was an elite of the Core Formation Tier. So what if Ling Han was a 10-star genius? He could smack him to death with a single hand.
Since he had already said so, it would not be proper for Jiang Zhengping to object further. He only wore a dark expression, very displeased.
He had his eye on Hong Tianbu’s aptitude, but the latter objected. It would be difficult to find another high quality cauldron.

“It’s true that the Seven Saints Divine Art can increase your cultivation speed by 10 times,” Duanmu Xue said calmly. “However, this is at the cost of expending your lifespans. Thus, you can only live for 10 years at most.”
Both Ling Han and Hong Tianbu’s expressions changed drastically. This was far too devious.
“But what benefits do you have?” Hong Tianbu asked in a solemn voice.

“Of course there is,” Duanmu Xue said with a smile. “Have you forgotten that you guys still have a cultivation partner? Ten years later, your cultivation partner will completely absorb your fruits of cultivation, and it would not be a problem for them to charge up to the cultivation level of a major tier in one go, saving a few hundred years, or even a thousand years of hard cultivation in fact!”
F***, so ruthless!

chapters.title: Chapter 3695: Burning the Holy Land
paragraphs: Chapter 3695: Burning the Holy Land
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
“You guys are really ruthless!” Hong Tianbu said.
A noble Holy Land was actually so despicable!

“You guys only have two options. The first option is to die now, and the second option is to continue living for another ten years. I can guarantee you that you guys will have an extremely exciting life in these ten years,” Duanmu Xue said.

“Excitingyour sister!” Ling Han scoffed, “I’ll let you have this opportunity.” “Hehe, if I am talented enough, I would be willing to become a cauldron, and contribute to the Holy Land,” Duanmy Xue said calmly, “This is a great mission. Though there are only ten exciting years left of your lives, in future, your lives will continue on in the corresponding Star Envoy, dazzling the entire universe.”
This was really cheap talk; there was no need for you to sacrifice yourself.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “You’re merely a force of Saint-level, so why are you acting all high and mighty? Don’t forget, you people don’t even have a Saint. At most, you only have a few Venerate Tier elites standing guard, and you still say that you can illuminate the entire galaxy. This is practically hilarious.”
“How dare you!” Jiang Zhengping shouted harshly.
Duanmu Xue waved his hand, and said, “Young man, everyone has a predetermined fate, and your fate is to become the cauldron of the Twelve Star Envoys, burning your life force for their sake.”

“Humph!” Hong Tianbu smirked coldly. He had obtained the personal teachings of a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Moreover, his luck was heaven-defying, and he had even fused with the eye of a Primordial Beast. Thus, he had obtained countless rare treasures.
Now, could a Core Formation Tier cultivator trap him?
Meanwhile, Ling Han shook his head, “Old geezer, do you know that you are planting a calamity of destruction for the Holy Land!”
“Ha, hahaha!” Duanmu Xue laughed loudly.

Jiang Zhengping and Ma Yufen also bared their mouths and smirked coldly. A mere Foundation Building junior actually said that he would destroy the Holy Land; wasn’t that the biggest joke in the world?

To say nothing of the fact that the Holy Land still had a Saint Tool, with Venerate Tiers at the fourth pinnacle level standing by, even if a few Cauldron Forging Tier elites were dispatched, they would still be able to easily crush Ling Han into dust.
Threatening the Holy Land?
Hehe, they really did not know where he had gotten such courage from.
“Oh, what tricks do you have? Show me,” Duanmu Xue said. He was also bored, and that was why he had gone to tease such a minor character.
In any case, he had nothing else to do anyway.
Ling Han smiled, “You really want to see it?”
“Don’t hide it, use it,” Duanmu Xue said indifferently.
“You won’t regret it?” Ling Han asked again.
“You only know how to speak glibly, and I can’t be bothered to waste any more time on you.” Duanmu Xue smirked coldly. He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
A cultivator of Core Formation Tier moved. Boom, his aura was like a mountain, crushing everything in its path.

Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This time, the precious tool no longer kept a low profile. The air of Primal Chaos descended, and lightning flickered, exuding a powerful aura that could suppress the nine heavens and ten lands.
Duanmu Xue couldn’t help but pause in his attacks. He stared fixedly at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and his eyes were about to light up.
“This is… a Saint Tool?” His heart throbbed wildly. Aside from Saint Grade materials, how could there possibly be such an aura?

He couldn’t be blamed for being blind. He was only at the Core Formation Tier, so even if he were born in a Holy Land, he couldn’t possibly have seen a Saint Tool. After all, even Saint Tools couldn’t remain indestructible for eternity. Thus, in order to ensure that Saint Tools could last as long as possible, the power of heaven and earth was usually used to suppress and seal them, preventing them from ageing.

If he could obtain a Saint-level ingredient, just how strong would he become? Even if he handed it over to the higher-ups of the Holy Land, it would definitely be a great contribution and he could obtain unimaginable cultivation resources in exchange.
To say nothing of True Self Tier elites, even reaching Sect Master-level might not be an extravagant hope.
“Hahaha, I never thought that you would actually have such a treasure hidden on you!” Duanmu Xue laughed loudly, and continued to stretch out his hand, grabbing out at Ling Han.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “You’ve brought this upon yourself!” With a thought, the ninth level of the Primal Chaos Extreme LightningTower opened. Hong, the terrifying Heavenly Dao Flames surged out violently, turning into a wave of endless flames.

This was Heavenly Dao Flames. Even if it was slightly weaker than it had been in the Flaming Canyon, it was still capable of burning a Venerate Tier to death. What kind of terrifying existence was this?
Boom, the waves of fire surged rapidly, and instantly spread to Duanmu Xue,
Ma Yufen and Jiang Zhengping.
“Ah-”
“No!”
The three of them screamed in agony, their expressions filled with endless terror. However, what was the use? As the flames swept past them, they did not even leave behind the slightest bit of ash.

They were all extremely dissatisfied, especially Duanmu Xue. He was a Core Formation Tier elite, and his true battle prowess was enough to insta-kill Ling Han. However, in front of the Heavenly Dao Flames, he became a piece of trash that couldn’t be any weaker.

There was even less need to mention Ma Yufen and Jiang Zhengping. Though they were the Star Envoys of this generation, what were mere Foundation Building Tier cultivators worth in front of Heavenly Dao Flames?
On the other hand, Hong Tianbu was truly extraordinary.

Ling Han saw very clearly that when the Heavenly Dao Flames surged past, a massive single eye appeared above his head, emitting light. It actually turned the Heavenly Dao Flames into stone for a moment. Though it was only for an instant, it gave him a chance to escape.
He tore open a talisman, and with a ‘xiu’, it instantly disappeared.
This was probably something like Talisman Weapon, which could allow him to travel ten thousand miles.

Ling Han was slightly surprised. Looks like he had still underestimated Hong Tianbu. A noble Holy Land was actually so despicable!

I can guarantee you that you guys will have an extremely exciting life in these ten years,” Duanmu Xue said.

chapters.title: Chapter 3696: Return
paragraphs: Chapter 3696: Return
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
This was the Heaven Measuring Metal Ruler, and it had been forged by the Metal Element Saint all those years ago. It was a genuine Saint Tool!

The moment this ruler appeared, endless golden light descended. The great power of heaven and earth was also drawn, condensing the endless power of heaven and earth, which pressed down on the Heavenly Dao Flames.
If this Heavenly Dao Flames had not been weakened, then even the Saint Tool would not be able to suppress it. This was a terrifying flame that could burn a Saint to death in the first place.
However, the might of the Heavenly Dao Flames had already been weakened, so it was no match for the Saint Tool.

However, the Heavenly Dao Flames was still the Heavenly Dao Flames. Although the Heavenly Dao Flames could be suppressed, it wasn’t so easily extinguished. It could only extinguish the flames bit by bit. This wasn’t something that could be done in a short while, but would take at least eight to ten days, or even longer.
The only good news was that the flames had finally stopped spreading.
The members of the Holy Land of Metal Element were all furious and confused. What in the world was going on?
Had some Holy Land attacked?
Otherwise, how could even a Venerate Tier was not able to block these flames? Even the Heaven Measuring Golden Ruler had to expend so much effort to extinguish them?

As a noble Holy Land, two-thirds of its territory had actually been directly burnt down. For the moment, there was no way to keep track of how many people had died, but the Medicinal Gardens could not be moved. The losses could be said to be very direct.
There was only one word for it: disastrous!
Which force was it? They definitely had to take responsibility, and definitely had to pay compensation!
Every disciple of the Holy Land was incredibly furious. They would definitely not let this matter go, definitely not.
Ling Han had already ran out of the Holy Land. Now that the situation was so chaotic, who would care about a mere Human Dao Foundation like him?

Furthermore, he had already removed the Battle Armor and mask — the Battle Armor had long since been severely damaged, and he had directly thrown it away. The mask could also possibly expose his identity, and he too had thrown it aside.
Right now, he wasn’t “Niu Jianhua” who was participating in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering. Instead, he was a young Human Tier Low Grade alchemist.
He first found the empress and the others, and did not say anything else, leaving with them.
When they arrived at the next city, Ling Han went out to make enquiries, and soon found out.

—After the Holy Land of Metal Element was tossed around like this, the two Venerate Tier elites that had gone out had already been summoned back, and one Venerate Tier elite that had gone into seclusion had been woken up. Added with another overseer, the four Venerate Tier elites had all gone crazy, searching for the whereabouts of the attackers.
At first, they suspected that it was the doing of another Holy Land, especially the Holy Land of Crimson Fire. Their Flaming Mirror could spew out fiery flames that could kill Venerate Tier elites.
However, after carefully distinguishing the power of flames, it was very easy to discover that the flames blasted out by the Flaming Mirror were different from this.
Thus, this should have nothing to do with the Holy Land of Crimson Fire.

They traced the source of the flames, and finally discovered that the flames had started from the venue where the Metal Element Fruit Gathering was hosted. At that time, there had been 12 outsiders, and 10 of them had followed ten of the Star Envoys. Only two of them had stayed behind.
One was Hong Tianbu, and the other was called Niu Jianhua.
Thus, these terrifying flames must be related to these two people.
Find these two people!
The Holy Land of Metal Element issued a bounty for Hong Tianbu and Niu Jianhua.
Both of them had their names and origins, so it was naturally not difficult to find them.
“Yi, how did you become Niu Jianhua?” The little loli licked the candy, and suddenly gave an ‘oh’. “You screwed him over again!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “What nonsense are you spouting?”

Since he was sure that he wasn’t implicated in this matter, Ling Han decided to return to Celestial Sea Planet. In the case of Princess Bixiao, it was heard that those who had not made it into the top 12 had all been kicked out of the Holy Land, so she would have to think of a way to return on her own.
Then he would first find Princess Bixiao, and let her have a free ride. Otherwise, she really would not be able to return to Celestial Sea Planet.
…The Holy Land of Metal Element was presently burnt so badly, so how could they still be in the mood to send these people back?
“Yi, husband, is this your newly married wife?” the empress asked.

“Howcould that be!” Ling Han immediately shook his head, and said with a righteous expression, “Previously, there was only one thought in my head, and that was how to get you guys out. How could I be in the mood to flirt with others?”

“That may not be the case,” the empress said calmly. “Husband, you are so outstanding. There are too many women that have pounced over on their own.” The princess of the Demon Race? That couldn’t be, right?
“That’s right, Father is the most outstanding!” Third Baby nodded. Like the empress, she was also the proud type.
“Alright, stop sucking up. Let’s hurry up and find her, then return,” Ling Han said.
As the main culprit, Ling Han still felt a little guilty. Naturally, he had to leave as soon as possible to feel safe.

He went to find Princess Bixiao. She was in the Seven Void City, and all those who had come to attend the Metal Element Fruit Gathering were staying here. The Holy Land of Metal Element had said that it would send them back in the future, but it didn’t say how long.
Thus, Ling Han easily found Princess Bixiao.
“Yi, these two are—” When Princess Bixiao saw the empress and Hu Niu, she couldn’t help but feel surprised.
She didn’t remember that Ling Han had these two people by his side.
“Oh, they’re both my wives,” Ling Han said casually.
Princess Bixiao was instantly stunned. ‘Are you here to attend the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, or are you here to pick up girls?’ Moreover, there were two of them in one go.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “We’ve already married long ago. We’ve already had many children and grandchildren.”
This was the honest truth, but how could Princess Bixiao believe it?
Just look at him. He looked to be only twenty years old, and he actually had grandchildren?
Hehe!
Princess Bixiao shook her head internally. Pei, this fickle man!
If she had known earlier, she should have made a move earlier, and pushed Ling Han down. In that way, she would at least be First Madam.
Pei, pei, pei! What nonsense was she letting her imagination run wild for? She did not like this kind of fickle man.
They returned, and the shuttle streaked through the air, heading towards Celestial Sea Planet.
They traversed through the nodes, and this was another long journey of half a year.
Ling Han didn’t feel that time was hard to pass. Although he couldn’t cultivate, he could study formation patterns, and this would need to expend countless time and effort in the first place.
Unknowingly, half a year had passed, and the shuttle had finally returned to Celestial Sea Planet.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺

Ling Han couldn’t help but think that it would be great if there was a Transfer Formation that connected the Celestial Sea Planet directly to other planets. Then, with a xiu, he would be able to traverse the boundless galaxy, and reach his destination directly — at worst, he would just have to jump a few times between a few formations.
After returning to the Imperial Capital, Ling Han first went to visit Lin Luo and the others.

As expected of a great elite that could cultivate to the Seventh Tier in the Genesis World. Those few that had once been Seventh Tier Heavenly Venerates had now advanced into the Enlightenment Tier. Being able to reach such heights in a year and a half, even with the help of cultivation resources provided by Ling Han, the strength of their natural talent could still be seen.

In comparison, the empress and the others had lost a year’s time to cultivate on the Black Moon Planet because they had followed Ling Han to the Black Moon Planet. At present, they were still only Blood Transformation Tiers, which was considerably inferior.
Unfortunately, even Lin Luo and the others were unable to cultivate the Seventh Change, the Seventh Extreme, and the Seven Inscriptions.
Since Ling Han was the only one who could do it, a special case like him could be ignored.
He could break through his limits at every cultivation level. No matter where he was, he was a prodigy among prodigies.
After advancing into Celestial Path, all of them could become four-star geniuses, or perhaps even higher, right?
Before long, Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others would be able to share Ling Han’s burden.
Ling Han temporarily stayed low, studying formation techniques.

paragraphs: Chapter 3697: Celestial Sea Planet’s glory
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
With Wally’s help, Ling Han’s grasp of formation patterns became deeper and deeper. He believed that it wouldn’t take long for him to grasp enough formation patterns and lay out the first formation.

The large black dog finally advanced into the Blood Transformation Tier. After ingesting a Transformation Fruit, he could finally open his mouth to speak. Of course, he could also take human form, but he obviously preferred the form of a dog. He still maintained the form of a dog. Furthermore, he was wearing iron underwear again, always feeling that this would protect his vital points better.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel curious. Had this guy’s an*s been dug out by his own kind in his last life? Why was he so anxious about his behind?

“Grandpa Dog’s going to suffocate to death!” After the large black dogwas able to speak, he continued to speak for a whole three days, directly making the pervert pig pass out. It was clear how capable and annoying the large black dog was.??????????????????????5

Ling Han handed the Ice Origin Stones to the empress and Hu Niu. The large black dog also received a few, helping them quickly increase their cultivation. With Ice Origin Stones, Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, support cultivation technique, and large amounts of resources, the empress and the others’ cultivation levels were rapidly catching up.
In only half a month, the two people and one dog advanced into Extreme Bone Tier, and in another dozen over days, they broke through again, advancing into Inscription Tier at a chillingly fast speed.
Ling Han even stopped his comprehension of formation patterns, and deliberately came out to warn them not to break through so quicldy, or there would definitely be great problems.
Another half month passed, and Ling Han finally grasped enough formation patterns to construct the first Celestial level formation.

He walked casually, and his speed wasn’t fast. It looked ordinary, but with every step, Spiritual Power would change the power of heaven and earth. Multiple veined patterns that couldn’t be seen with the naked eye spread out on the ground.
