chapters.title: Chapter 3698: Inheritance of a Saint
paragraphs: Chapter 3698: Inheritance of a Saint
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han patted Xuanyuan Dingguo’s shoulder and said, “Be realistic. However, if it’s just this, it can’t be regarded as big news, right?”
It could only be said that Celestial Sea Planet had a glorious history.
Xuanyuan Dingguo glanced at him and said, “You’re a hot-tempered person. Can’t you wait patiently for me to finish?”
Ling Han raised his hands and said, “Fine, fine, fine. Just say it, I won’t interrupt.”
Xuanyuan Dingguo finally said, “Our Celestial Sea Planet has produced a Saint before, so it naturally has the inheritance of a Saint as well!”
Only now did Ling Han take him seriously, “Now, do we have the whereabouts of the inheritance of the Saint?”
“Look at you. You just said not to interrupt, so why are you interrupting again?” Xuanyuan Dingguo pointed out.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel speechless. ‘You’ll be beaten if you speak like this, do you know that?’

“During the great battle, the nearby galaxy had all become dead planets. Even in the tens of thousands of years after the battle ended, no one could enter, as they would be killed by the chaotic energy,” Xuanyuan Dingguo said again.
“When the chaotic energy dissipated a little, great elites entered to search for the inheritance of the Saint, but they still couldn’t find it.”
“After searching for tens of thousands of years, there was still no result. Everyone thought that the inheritance of the Saint had also been destroyed in the great battle.”
“From then onwards, Celestial Sea Planet became a small planet that no one took to heart.”
Xuanyuan Dingguo paused, then continued, “Until now.”
“What’s going on now?” Ling Han asked.

“Now, hehe.” Xuanyuan Dingguo kept Ling Han hanging for a while, then said, “Previously, didn’t our Celestial Sea Planet become a prison? Those like the Primordial True Lord and Nine Spirits True Lord were imprisoned for several thousand years and had nothing to do all day, so they did a lot of research, and actually discovered some information about the ancient times there.”
“Those are a few stone tablets. They record the inheritance of the Ancient Sun Saint.”

“It is said that the Ancient Sun Saint has not been able to find a suitable successor all this while, and was worried that when his lifespan had reached its end, his own Dao would be lost, so he set up a Mystery Realm as a test for descendants.”
“As long as you pass the test of this Mystery Realm, you will be able to obtain the inheritance of the Saint!”
Xuanyuan Dingguo was filled with envy. “If I can obtain the inheritance of a Saint, then what would a Spirit Transformation True Lord be worth? I can kill him with a single palm strike.”
Ling Han smiled, and did not strike a blow on him.

Even if he had obtained the inheritance of a Saint, the height that he could reach would still have to depend on his own natural talent. Otherwise, wouldn’t there be Venerate Tier elites everywhere in the Holy Land, and as many Sect Masters as dogs?

The inheritance of a Saint could indeed help a cultivator improve further, but if one’s original limit was Cauldron Forging Tier, then at most, hewould only reach the level of Core Formation Tier, and could not possibly break through the limits.

Xuanyuan Dingguo still hadn’t reached Mystery Realm Tier, so his natural talent could only be considered average. In the future, being able to leap over the Celestial Gate should be his limit. Wanting to kill a Spirit Transformation True Lord with a single palm strike was destined to only be a wonderful idea.

“At present, the four great True Lords are all searching for the location of that Mystery Realm.” Xuanyuan Dingguo said, “It is said that in the past tens of thousands of years, that Mystery Realm has also opened, but no one has passed the test. And now, it should be very close to the opening of this Mystery Realm.”
“I’m definitely going to seize this opportunity to soar into the sky,” Xuanyuan Dingguo said as he patted Ling Han’s shoulder. “In the future, I’ll protect you.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly, and nodded, “Sure.”

A thought flashed in his mind. Although he now had the Great Sun Lotus Technique, which allowed him to cultivate, that was a reward given through the lowest level of the nine-storey towers, the Black Iron Tower, so how much better could it be?
If he could obtain a Saint’s mental cultivation technique… then his cultivation speed would definitely increase to another level.
You see, more than a year had passed, and he had not advanced much in the stage of Human Dao Foundation. His cultivation technique was really too poor.
—There was naturally another reason for this. For example, there was a whole year’s time that he had spent traversing through the universe, and there was no way for him to cultivate at all.
Ling Han secretly decided that if this whatnot Mystery Realm opened, he would definitely interfere.

“Probably, this Mystery Realm is located in our Dark North Nation. Otherwise, it would be fine for the four Spirit Transformation True Lords to search on their own, so why do they need to spread the news? They definitely want His Majesty to cooperate,” Xuanyuan Dingguo said.
Ling Han thought so as well. Otherwise, the four Spirit Transformation True Lords could just silently make a fortune.

Could it be that the Primordial True Lord and the others had escaped from the prison, buthad not managed to escape far enough from Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, and that was for the sake of Ancient Sun Saint’s inheritance?

It was extremely possible. For the sake of obtaining the inheritance of the Saint, taking this kind of risk was definitely worth it. Who knows, they may even have a chance to become Saints. By then, they could seek out the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire for revenge, and that would be a small matter.
Even if they did not become Saints, if this allowed them to take another step further, and become great elites at the level of Sect Master, with how big the world was, where could they not go?

Ling Han wanted to concoct the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill. However, he couldn’t find Foxwood. This was in the hands of the five great Spirit Transformation Tier-level forces, and couldn’t be bought at all.

—The present Celestial Sea Planet seemed to be in the stage of enlightenment, and the market was not adequate. Probably, only Ling Han was the only alchemist above Celestial Path. In such an environment, how could Celestial level medicinal ingredients possibly circulate in the market?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel like he was about to leave the Celestial Sea Planet. In this place, his alchemy abilities wouldn’t be reflected at all.
However, he had best wait for that Mystery Realm first.

After a few days, Ling Han was studying formations, but a feeling of apprehension rose up in his heart. He opened the door and looked into the distance, only to see a pillar of light soaring into the sky, brighter than even the sun.
After a while, the pillar of light disappeared, but after an hour, the pillar of light reappeared, as if sending out a signal.
There were many theories about this light.

Some said that a precious tool was about to appear, while others thought that a great elite was concocting a Celestial pill, and its celestial light had soared into the skies. There were also some said that an Innate Divine Physique had appeared. There was a considerable number of believers for each theory.
However, in the end, these were all proven to be rumors.
This was the birth of a Mystery Realm, and this Mystery Realm was the Moon Occult Mystery Realm where one could obtain the inheritance of the Ancient Sun Saint!
Ling Han brought the empress and the others with him, and rushed to the place where the pillar of light had shot out at the first instant.

This was an ordinary place, a desolate plain. Occasionally, there would be a few weeds growing here and there, appearing to be very lifeless. However, every hour, a thick pillar of light would shoot up into the skies, directly sinking into the depths of the galaxy.
Where was the Mystery Realm?
It hadn’t officially opened yet, so the entrance couldn’t be seen?
Ling Han settled down nearby. Once the Mystery Realm opened, he would enter at the first instant.
And in the next few days, there was a storm brewing.

Because this Mystery Realm was located in the Dark North Nation, the Primordial True Lord and the others naturally wouldn’t stand by and watch. They all rushed over with a large number of elites, exerting pressure on Chen Fengyan. Obviously, once the Mystery Realm opened, they would also barge in.
Not only that, but flashes of light from Transfer Formations actually appeared in various places on the Celestial Sea Planet, and a considerable number of young prodigies poured in.

These young prodigies had brought with them a letter from a Sect Master-level elite at least, and “hoped” that elites like Chen Fengyan, Primordial True Lord and the other elites could give them some face and allow these youngsters to enter into the Moon Occult Mystery Realm.

Because this Mystery Realm was located in the Dark North Nation, the Primordial True Lord and the others naturally wouldn’t stand by and watch.
They all rushed over with a large number of elites, exerting pressure on Chen Fengyan.
Obviously, once the Mystery Realm opened, they would also barge in.
Not only that, but flashes of light from Transfer Formations actually appeared in various places on the Celestial Sea Planet, and a considerable number of young prodigies poured in.

These young prodigies had brought with them a letter from a Sect Master-level elite at least, and “hoped” that elites like Chen Fengyan, Primordial True Lord and the other elites could give them some face and allow these youngsters to enter into the Moon Occult Mystery Realm.

paragraphs: Chapter 3699: Small marketplace
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
How had it alerted so many extraterrestrial visitors?

As it turned out, the Mystery Realm’s light illuminated the galaxy. At least, the galaxies nearby could see it clearly. The great elites made some calculations, and discovered that the Moon Occult Mystery Realm had once again opened, so they activated the Transfer Formation, sending their descendants to the Celestial Sea Planet.

Because the Celestial Sea Planet was a great planet in the ancient times, there was naturally no shortage of Transfer Formations that transcended galaxies. However, after the Celestial Sea Planet disintegrated, its level dropped drastically, so no one was teleported here again.
— Transferring once would consume a great amount of resources, and even the Holy Lands would feel the pinch.

But this time was different. The Moon Occult Mystery Realm was directly related to the inheritance of a Saint, and even Spiritual Transformation Tier forces would grit their teeth and teleport their juniors over.
Those extraterrestrial visitors knew even more about the Moon Occult Mystery Realm.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

It would only open once every 10,000 years, and the entry condition was Foundation Building Tier—Cauldron Forging Tier elites and above could also enter, but their cultivation level would be suppressed to Foundation Building Tier.
10,000 years ago, the Moon Occult Mystery Realm had actually opened as well. However, no one had obtained the inheritance of the Saint.

This time, the Moon Occult Mystery Realm was about to open. Thus, those forces that knew of the existence of the Moon Occult Mystery Realm immediately sent people over to contend for the great opportunity.
This was the inheritance of a Saint, so who wouldn’t be tempted?

However, because the higher one’s cultivation level was teleported, the greater the price one would have to pay. In any case, those with the cultivation level of Sect Master-level would also be weakened when he entered into the Mystery Realm, so what was the point of such a mighty figure coming?
Thus, they had only sent their juniors over, who brought a letter with them. By now, there was probably no one on the Celestial Sea Planet that would dare not give them face.
If they were really angered, and spared no expense to teleport here, wouldn’t Celestial Sea Planet be instantly destroyed?

Previously, when Celestial Sea Planet revived, a great many well-known figures of the younger generation came, such as Niu Jianhua and the others. They even wanted to obtain top-grade Foundation Building Divine Stones her, snatching the great opportunities.
However, in comparison, the group of people from before could only be considered… ordinary.
Would a prodigy from a true great sect lack such low-level materials?
Hence, right until this time, when it involved the inheritance of the Saint, true prodigies finally came.

It was said that the prodigies that had come this time were really extraordinary. There was no shortage of three-star geniuses. It was said that they were also four-star geniuses, which was very amazing.

Because the basic requirement for entering into the Mystery Realm was Foundation Building, Ling Han first sent the empress, Hu Niu and the others back to the Imperial Capital. That was Dark North Nation’s base camp, and for the moment, no one dared to mess around, so it was quite safe.
When Ling Han returned, only Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby were left by his side.

Princess Bixiao had advanced into the Foundation Building Tier, so she naturally had to enter into the Moon Occult Mystery Realm. Meanwhile, Sixth Baby’s invisibility technique had great uses, so Ling Han kept her with him. The other babies were in the Imperial Capital protecting the empress and the others.

Tang Yun’er also stayed in the Imperial Capital. She had already been conquered by the empress’s charms, and stuck to the empress every day like a bug. Since the empress didn’t come, she naturally couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to Ling Han.
Moreover, she wouldn’t be able to enter the Mystery Realm either.
Everyone was waiting. Since the Mystery Realm was glowing, it meant that it was close to opening.

Some people were very low-key, and simply waited in secret, but there were some people who were very arrogant. They were born on a high-tier planet, and had a Sect Master, or even great elites like Venerate Tier, backing them up. Now that they had come to such a backward planet, how could they possibly know how to behave?
Who dared to touch them? Who dared to punish them? Wouldn’t they be afraid that the big shots behind them would immediately come over through the Transfer Formation and flatten Celestial Sea Planet?

In the past few days, there had been an endless stream of fights and scuffles. There had also been a banquet hosted by well-connected extraterrestrial prodigies, who had established a wide network, in preparation for entering into the Mystery Realm.
Though Ling Han was the number one prodigy among the natives, he had been completely overlooked.
—On such a backward planet, what prodigy could there be?
Even the strongest was only a Spirit Transformation Tier.

In the eyes of these prodigies, the inheritance of the Saint in the Moon Occult Mystery Realm was completely prepared for them. They only had to enter, and stretch out a hand, and they would be able to obtain the inheritance of the Saint.

And coming out of the Mystery Realm was the real difficulty, because there was no force that would allow anyone to easily take away the inheritance of the Saint. A great battle would definitely break out.

A large number of people had gathered here, and it was possible that they would not be spending just a day or two here. Thus, there were a great many tents erected nearby, and there were some that were even more exaggerated. The Spatial Celestial Spirit Tool actually contained a small courtyard, and tossed there, it was like they were the locals.

There were all kinds of people, even if they were prodigies. There were those who were hardworking, and there were also those who were laidback. There were those who were pure-hearted and had few desires, and there were also those who were lustful.
Recently, there had been cases of women being molested, and there was more than one pervert, causing everyone to be anxious. A great many women no longer dared to go out.

Once there were many people, a small marketplace was formed here. After all, every planet had its own specialty products, and very rarely could they be sold across galaxies. This time was a very good opportunity.
Ling Han and Princess Bixiao were also very interested, so they brought Sixth Baby along with them to join in on the excitement.
There were a lot of these things, and there was also quite a lot of good stuff. Unfortunately, they all had to be traded with Dao Stones, and no one accepted jade seeds at all.
Ling Han only had three Dao Stones on him, but there was quite a lot of One or Two Star-level materials. Previously, he had robbed so many people, so his gains were naturally considerable.
He had also set up a street stall, and Princess Bixiao was responsible for the flow of customers. A great beauty was always capable of attracting the eyes of others.

As expected, there were endless people coming over, but after seeing the beauty, the majority would also look at the goods on the street stall in passing. If they had their eye on them, they would naturally make a move.

In fact, the best seller was naturally the Silver Dragon Fish. This kind of treasure was exclusive to the Holy Land, but there were only so many Silver Dragon Fish, so how could Ling Han possibly take them out? There wasn’t even enough to share among his own people.
After selling for an entire morning, the number of Dao Stones in Ling Han’s possession had also reached several hundred.

He decided to close up the stall first and see if there was any Foxwood. He would then refine the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill. Combined with the Silver Dragon Fish, his cultivation would definitely advance by a significant amount.

He turned around, and he really found Foxwood. It was very mature, and was sold for thirty Dao Stones each. However, he only needed one tenth of it every time he concocted an alchemical pill, so he could concoct the alchemical pill a great many times.
“Friend, did you buy Foxwood to concoct the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill?” the stall keeper asked.
“En.” Ling Han nodded.
The stall keeper looked surprised, “You know how to concoct alchemical pills?”
“A little.” Ling Han was very modest.
“Then if you refine Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills, can you sell me a few?” the stall keeper said. “In return, I can sell you even older Foxwood.”

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He was naturally filled with confidence in his ability to concoct alchemical pills. If there was a large supply of Foxwood, then the people by his side would have a guaranteed rate of cultivation when they set foot on Celestial Path in the future.
“Deal.”
Ling Han handed the Dao Stones over, and was just about to tell Princess Bixiao to leave, but when he looked left and right, this Demon Race princess was nowhere to be seen.
“Yi, where is he?” He couldn’t help but find it strange.
“Father, that monkey princess went over there. She said that it’s very strange that someone is selling a rock over there so she’ll go and take a look,” Sixth Baby said.
Monkey princess?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel annoyed and amused. When had the seven babies given Princess Bixiao such a nickname?
Hugging the Sixth Baby, he walked towards where Princess Bixiao was. She wasn’t far from him.
However, before he arrived, he heard a commotion..

chapters.title: Chapter 3700: Hou Qingbai
paragraphs: Chapter 3700: Hou Qingbai
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Scram!” Princess Bixiao’s sharp voice rang out.
“What a hot beauty, but I like her!” A man’s voice rang out, appearing to be very shameless, “Beauty, follow me in the future. Whatever you want, I will buy for you!”
“I already said, scram!” Princess Bixiao shouted again. There was a powerful fury in her voice.
“Tsk, this face is so fair. Come, let me touch it,” the man continued.
Boom!
The sound of battle rang out, and a wave of energy surged over.
Ling Han couldn’t help as his eyes became sharp. This was someone teasing Princess Bixiao.𝕗𝐫𝐞𝕖𝕨𝐞𝗯𝚗𝕠𝘃𝐞𝚕.𝐜𝗼𝚖
Though he did not have any ideas about this princess of the Demon Race, there was no reason for him to allow others to bully her.
“Haha, she is indeed a rose with thorns. Brother likes her!”
“Pervert!”

Ling Han walked over, only to see that Princess Bixiao was presently engaged in a fierce battle with a man in green robes. That man looked to be around 25 or 26 years old, and had a sloppy expression on his face. His attacks were even more despicable, and his eyes were focused on Princess Bixiao’s face, breasts, and thighs, as he stretched out his claws.
This caused Princess Bixiao to feel very wary. Even if she could knock him down with a single strike, she did not want to take the risk of him touching her jade body.

She could only draw out the distance between them, and use her power to attack from afar. However, the man in green was closing in on her step by step, every move despicable, causing Princess Bixiao to rebuke him furiously, but she could do nothing.
This meant that though the man in green was shameless, his abilities were very strong. Otherwise, he could not have possibly forced Princess Bixiao into such a sorry state.

Now, this batch of extraterrestrial visitors had come to conspire for the inheritance of the Saint. To say nothing of Sect Master, Venerate Tier-level forces, even the heirs of the Holy Lands would be tempted — to be able to grasp two ultimate techniques of Saints, wasn’t that better than one?
Thus, the overall strength of this group of young people was much stronger than before, whether it was their cultivation level or natural talent.
Ling Han naturally couldn’t bear to watch on. With a leap, he had already arrived between Princess Bixiao and the man in green.

“Scram!” The man in green frowned, and revealed an expression of disgust. His right hand formed into a palm, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han. Boom, there was actually a strange phenomenon of the moon hanging in the middle of the sky, illuminating all ages.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his Demonic Monkey Fists.
Boom!

The man in green’s expression changed immediately, and he couldn’t help but step back continuously. He only steadied his footing after taking nine steps back, but his face was completely flushed. With a ‘wah’, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
“Yi, Hou Qingbai was actually wounded!” someone immediately shouted from the sidelines.
“Hou Qingbai is a two-star genius who has reached Heavenly Dao Foundation. The only person who can defeat him should be an Ultimate Dao Foundation.”

“That person should be a native of the Celestial Sea Planet. I have seen a holographic image of him before. I think his name is Ling Han, and together with another prodigy, Hong Tianbu, they are known as the Twin Prodigies of the Imperial City.”
“Two prodigies of the Imperial Capital? Haha, I’m about to die of laughter. A mere native dares to boast like this.”
“Don’t forget, Hou Qingbai has just been defeated by him.”
“It’s probably a one-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation. It wouldn’t be strange for him to defeat Hou Qingbai.”

At first, everyone had not taken it to heart. They were all looking at their own merchandise, but Hou Qingbai was actually sent flying with a single punch from a native. This naturally attracted everyone’s attention, and they all walked over.
“Yi, this person’s life force isn’t very strong.” Someone sensed Ling Han’s life force, and immediately revealed an expression of shock.
“It seems like he’s only a Human Dao Foundation!”
“Haha, how could that be possible? A Human Dao Foundation cultivator wants to defeat a two-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation, then what kind of battle prowess does he have to be?”
“It has to be four stars, at least.”
“Four stars? How could that be possible for such a backward planet?”
“It is indeed impossible!”

Everyone shook their heads. They looked down on Celestial Sea Planet 1000 times over, so they naturally wouldn’t believe that Ling Han was a four-star genius. This was like someone saying that a Saint had been born on a small planet.
What a colossal joke.

Hou Qingbai rubbed his chest to soothe the discomfort in his body. His eyes burned as he stared at Ling Han and said, “You actually dare to interfere in my matters, and you even dare to wound me. You’re truly tired of living.”
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back and said calmly, “Kneel down and apologize to my friend, and I’ll spare your life.”
“Haha!” Hou Qingbai couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. This was really too ridiculous. A native actually dared to make him kneel down and beg for mercy?

“Pretty boy, you have absolutely no idea who I am, right?” Hou Qingbai smirked coldly. He was not an idiot. Before teasing Princess Bixiao, he had already investigated the latter’s identity. After all, it was very possible that she was really the Holy Daughter of a great sect, or the princess of a Majestic Empire Then, he would be seeking death.
But Princess Bixiao was a native, so what kind of background could she have?
Only now was he completely unrestrained, treating Princess Bixiao like a meal on a plate.
But who would have expected that another native would jump out, and actually dare to ruin his plans, and even in fact injure him in public?
He could not tolerate this.
“I am Hou Qingbai, and my father is Hou Longsheng, the Sect Master of the Pleasure Forest Sect, a great elite of Minor Advanced Tier!” he declared proudly.
What cultivation level was the Minor Advanced Tier? A great elite of Sect Master-level!
As long as one such existence was dispatched, they would be able to sweep aside all opposition in Celestial Sea Planet, suppressing a planet single-handedly!
“Don’t blame me for not giving you a chance to live,” Hou Qingbai said calmly. “Kneel down and kowtow a hundred times, and I can consider sparing your life.”
This was called giving someone a taste of their own medicine, and you want me to kneel? Hehe, I will make you kneel until your bones break.
Hearing Hou Qingbai’s words, the people in the area all crossed their arms over their chests and sneered.
Regardless of the truth of the matter, as extraterrestrial visitors, they were naturally on Hou Qingbai’s side. They all looked down on the natives.
You see, even the strongest elite was only a Spirit Transformation Tier. Too weak, so how could they possibly take him seriously?
If they were weak, they would be beaten and bullied. This was an iron rule of the cultivation world.
No one would sympathize with the weak. Elites could do as they pleased.
Ling Han smiled calmly and said, “My patience is limited. If you don’t kneel within 10 or so minutes, I’ll kill you!”
His tone was very ordinary, as if he was talking about something that could not be more ordinary.
Hou Qingbai felt humiliated. Ling Han actually dared to disrespect him?
He had already revealed his identity.
Damn it!

“Are you so determined to seek death?” Hou Qingbai sneered. He pressed lightly on his chest, and a brilliant light surged out, covering his entire body. Instantly, a green Battle Armor appeared on his body.
“This is the Soaring Cloud Battle Armor, which can increase battle prowess by one star!” he declared proudly.
In the previous attack, Ling Han had only been slightly stronger than him. There was definitely not as big a gap as a single star.
“One, two, three…” Ling Han began counting.
Hou Qingbai almost exploded in fury. Ling Han was completely looking down on him!
Why was this native so despicable?
“I’m going to tear you into pieces, and feed every bit of your flesh and blood to the dogs,” he said through gritted teeth.
“Six, seven, eight…” Ling Han continued to count.
Everyone couldn’t help but laugh in spite of themselves. This native really had a personality, and was very courageous.
This scene was going to be quite interesting..

“Two prodigies of the Imperial Capital?
Haha, I’m about to die of laughter.
A mere native dares to boast like this.”
“Don’t forget, Hou Qingbai has just been defeated by him.”
“It’s probably a one-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation.
It wouldn’t be strange for him to defeat Hou Qingbai.”
At first, everyone had not taken it to heart.
They were all looking at their own merchandise, but Hou Qingbai was actually sent flying with a single punch from a native.
This naturally attracted everyone’s attention, and they all walked over.
“Yi, this person’s life force isn’t very strong.” Someone sensed Ling Han’s life force, and immediately revealed an expression of shock.
“It seems like he’s only a Human Dao Foundation!”
“Haha, how could that be possible?
A Human Dao Foundation cultivator wants to defeat a two-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation, then what kind of battle prowess does he have to be?”
“It has to be four stars, at least.”
“Four stars?
How could that be possible for such a backward planet?”
“It is indeed impossible!”
Everyone shook their heads.
They looked down on Celestial Sea Planet 1000 times over, so they naturally wouldn’t believe that Ling Han was a four-star genius.
This was like someone saying that a Saint had been born on a small planet.
What a colossal joke.
Hou Qingbai rubbed his chest to soothe the discomfort in his body.
His eyes burned as he stared at Ling Han and said, “You actually dare to interfere in my matters, and you even dare to wound me.
You’re truly tired of living.”
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back and said calmly, “Kneel down and apologize to my friend, and I’ll spare your life.”
“Haha!” Hou Qingbai couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
This was really too ridiculous.
A native actually dared to make him kneel down and beg for mercy?
“Pretty boy, you have absolutely no idea who I am, right?” Hou Qingbai smirked coldly.
He was not an idiot.
Before teasing Princess Bixiao, he had already investigated the latter’s identity.
After all, it was very possible that she was really the Holy Daughter of a great sect, or the princess of a Majestic Empire Then, he would be seeking death.

What cultivation level was the Minor Advanced Tier?
A great elite of Sect Master-level!
As long as one such existence was dispatched, they would be able to sweep aside all opposition in Celestial Sea Planet, suppressing a planet single-handedly!
“Don’t blame me for not giving you a chance to live,” Hou Qingbai said calmly.
“Kneel down and kowtow a hundred times, and I can consider sparing your life.”
This was called giving someone a taste of their own medicine, and you want me to kneel?
Hehe, I will make you kneel until your bones break.

Regardless of the truth of the matter, as extraterrestrial visitors, they were naturally on Hou Qingbai’s side.
They all looked down on the natives.
You see, even the strongest elite was only a Spirit Transformation Tier.
Too weak, so how could they possibly take him seriously?

This was an iron rule of the cultivation world.
No one would sympathize with the weak.
Elites could do as they pleased.

His tone was very ordinary, as if he was talking about something that could not be more ordinary.
Hou Qingbai felt humiliated.
Ling Han actually dared to disrespect him?
He had already revealed his identity.
Damn it!
“Are you so determined to seek death?” Hou Qingbai sneered.

Instantly, a green Battle Armor appeared on his body.
“This is the Soaring Cloud Battle Armor, which can increase battle prowess by one star!” he declared proudly.
In the previous attack, Ling Han had only been slightly stronger than him.
There was definitely not as big a gap as a single star.
“One, two, three…” Ling Han began counting.
Hou Qingbai almost exploded in fury.
Ling Han was completely looking down on him!
Why was this native so despicable?
“I’m going to tear you into pieces, and feed every bit of your flesh and blood to the dogs,” he said through gritted teeth.
“Six, seven, eight…” Ling Han continued to count.
Everyone couldn’t help but laugh in spite of themselves.
This native really had a personality, and was very courageous.
This scene was going to be quite interesting..
